private theorem target_subset_iff_required_subset (A : B → Finset X)
    (W : Finset X) (c b : B) :
    A b ⊆ resamplingY A W c ↔ A b \ A c ⊆ W := by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (h (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx).1) with hW | hc
    · exact hW
    · exact ((Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx).2 hc).elim
  · intro h x hx
    by_cases hc : x ∈ A c
    · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hc)
    · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (h (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hx, hc⟩)))

private theorem fragment_subset_inter_of_target_subset (A : B → Finset X)
    (W : Finset X) (c b : B) (h : A b ⊆ resamplingY A W c) :
    A b \ W ⊆ A c ∩ A b := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨hb, hW⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (h hb) with hxW | hc
  · exact (hW hxW).elim
  · exact Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hc, hb⟩

private theorem inverse_power_card_cancel (A : B → Finset X) {ρ : ℝ}
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (c b : B) :
    (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A b).card * ρ ^ (A b \ A c).card =
      (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A c ∩ A b).card := by
  have hc : (A b).card = (A b \ A c).card + (A c ∩ A b).card := by
    simpa only [Finset.inter_comm] using (Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_inter (A b) (A c)).symm
  rw [hc, pow_add]
  calc
    ((ρ⁻¹) ^ (A b \ A c).card * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A c ∩ A b).card) *
        ρ ^ (A b \ A c).card =
      ((ρ⁻¹) ^ (A b \ A c).card * ρ ^ (A b \ A c).card) *
        (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A c ∩ A b).card := by ring
    _ = (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A c ∩ A b).card := by simp [inv_pow, hρ.ne']

/-- At a large denominator, the actual large-fragment weight is bounded by
an intersection-tail indicator and the required-coordinate indicator. -/
theorem resampling_large_fragment_term_le (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (m : ℕ) (W : Finset X) (c b : B) :
    (if Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ)) ≤ resamplingZ ν A ρ (resamplingY A W c) ∧
          m / 2 < (A b \ W).card then resamplingWeight ν A ρ W (c, b) else 0) ≤
      if m < 2 * (A c ∩ A b).card ∧ A b \ A c ⊆ W then
        Real.exp (10 * (m : ℝ)) * ν.weight c * ν.weight b * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A b).card
      else 0 := by
  classical
  have hrhs : 0 ≤
      if m < 2 * (A c ∩ A b).card ∧ A b \ A c ⊆ W then
        Real.exp (10 * (m : ℝ)) * ν.weight c * ν.weight b * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A b).card
      else 0 := by
    split_ifs
    · exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (ν.nonneg c))
        (ν.nonneg b)) (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ.le) _)
    · exact le_rfl
  by_cases he : Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ)) ≤ resamplingZ ν A ρ (resamplingY A W c) ∧
      m / 2 < (A b \ W).card
  · rw [ite_eq_left he]
    by_cases hs : A b ⊆ resamplingY A W c
    · have hfrag := Finset.card_le_card (fragment_subset_inter_of_target_subset A W c b hs)
      have hlarge : m < 2 * (A c ∩ A b).card := by omega
      have hreq := (target_subset_iff_required_subset A W c b).mp hs
      rw [ite_eq_left ⟨hlarge, hreq⟩]
      have hZpos : 0 < resamplingZ ν A ρ (resamplingY A W c) :=
        (Real.exp_pos _).trans_le he.1
      have hscale : 1 ≤ Real.exp (10 * (m : ℝ)) *
          resamplingZ ν A ρ (resamplingY A W c) := by
        calc
          1 = Real.exp (10 * (m : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ)) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
          _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he.1 (Real.exp_pos _).le
      have hnum : 0 ≤ ν.weight b * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A b).card :=
        mul_nonneg (ν.nonneg b) (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ.le) _)
      have hdiv : (ν.weight b * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A b).card) /
          resamplingZ ν A ρ (resamplingY A W c) ≤
          Real.exp (10 * (m : ℝ)) * (ν.weight b * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A b).card) := by
        apply (div_le_iff₀ hZpos).mpr
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale hnum]
      unfold resamplingWeight resamplingTargetWeight
      rw [resamplingNumerator, ite_eq_left hs]
      calc
        ν.weight c * ((ν.weight b * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A b).card) /
            resamplingZ ν A ρ (resamplingY A W c)) ≤
          ν.weight c * (Real.exp (10 * (m : ℝ)) *
            (ν.weight b * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A b).card)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiv (ν.nonneg c)
        _ = _ := by ring
    · rw [resamplingWeight_eq_zero_of_not_subset ν A ρ W c b hs]
      exact hrhs
  · rw [ite_eq_right he]
    exact hrhs

    (ρ : ℝ) (f : ι → Finset X → ℝ) :

theorem resampling_large_fragment_pair_bound (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (m : ℕ) (c b : B) :
    bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun W =>
      if Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ)) ≤ resamplingZ ν A ρ (resamplingY A W c) ∧
          m / 2 < (A b \ W).card then resamplingWeight ν A ρ W (c, b) else 0) ≤
      if m < 2 * (A c ∩ A b).card then
        Real.exp (10 * (m : ℝ)) * ν.weight c * ν.weight b * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A c ∩ A b).card
      else 0 := by
  classical
  let μ : FiniteLaw (Finset X) := bernoulliLaw ρ hρ.le hρ1.le
  by_cases hlarge : m < 2 * (A c ∩ A b).card
  · rw [ite_eq_left hlarge]
    calc
      _ ≤ μ.expectation (fun W =>
          (Real.exp (10 * (m : ℝ)) * ν.weight c * ν.weight b * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A b).card) *
            (if A b \ A c ⊆ W then 1 else 0)) := by
        apply μ.expectation_mono
        intro W
        simpa only [hlarge, true_and, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero] using
          resampling_large_fragment_term_le ν A hρ m W c b
      _ = (Real.exp (10 * (m : ℝ)) * ν.weight c * ν.weight b * (ρ⁻¹) ^ (A b).card) *
          ρ ^ (A b \ A c).card := by
        rw [FiniteLaw.expectation_smul]
        congr 1
        change bernoulliExpectation ρ (fun W => if A b \ A c ⊆ W then 1 else 0) = _
        rw [← bernoulliProbability_subset ρ (A b \ A c)]
        simp only [bernoulliExpectation, bernoulliProbability, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro W _
        by_cases hW : A b \ A c ⊆ W <;> simp [hW]
      _ = Real.exp (10 * (m : ℝ)) * ν.weight c * ν.weight b *
          ((ρ⁻¹) ^ (A b).card * ρ ^ (A b \ A c).card) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [inverse_power_card_cancel A hρ c b]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hlarge]
    calc
      _ ≤ μ.expectation (fun _ => 0) := by
        apply μ.expectation_mono
        intro W
        simpa only [hlarge, false_and, ite_false] using
          resampling_large_fragment_term_le ν A hρ m W c b

/-!
# Outside-coordinate change of measure for the actual resampling transition

The observable may depend on the same Bernoulli set used at every other tree
node.  The only locality required here is that it ignores the fixed target's
incoming label.  No independence between different tree nodes is assumed.
-/

noncomputable section

variable {X B : Type*} [DecidableEq X] [Fintype B]

/-- Actual target marginal restricted to the event that the density is at least `δ`. -/
def cutoffTargetMass (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X) (p δ : ℝ)
    (W : Finset X) (b : B) : ℝ :=
  ∑ c, if δ ≤ resamplingZ ν A p (resamplingY A W c)
    then resamplingWeight ν A p W (c, b) else 0

theorem cutoffTargetMass_nonneg (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (δ : ℝ) (W : Finset X) (b : B) :
    0 ≤ cutoffTargetMass ν A p δ W b := by
  unfold cutoffTargetMass
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro c _
  split_ifs
  · exact resamplingWeight_nonneg ν A hp W (c, b)
  · exact le_rfl

/-- This marginal is the literal conditional expectation of the target-and-density event. -/
theorem cutoffTargetMass_mul_eq_expectation (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {p : ℝ} (hν : ν.IsPositive) (hp : 0 < p) (δ : ℝ)
    (W : Finset X) (b : B) (f : Finset X → ℝ) :
    cutoffTargetMass ν A p δ W b * f W =
      (resamplingLaw ν A p W hν hp).expectation
        (fun cb => if cb.2 = b ∧ δ ≤ resamplingZ ν A p (resamplingY A W cb.1)
          then f W else 0) := by
  classical
  simp only [cutoffTargetMass, FiniteLaw.expectation, resamplingLaw_weight,
    Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  by_cases hc : δ ≤ resamplingZ ν A p (resamplingY A W c)
  · simp [hc, mul_ite]
  · simp [hc]

theorem subset_union_iff_sdiff_subset (S T W : Finset X) :
    S ⊆ W ∪ T ↔ S \ T ⊆ W := by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    obtain ⟨hxS, hxT⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx
    exact (Finset.mem_union.mp (h hxS)).resolve_right hxT
  · intro h x hxS
    by_cases hxT : x ∈ T
    · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hxT)
    · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (h (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hxS, hxT⟩)))

/-- Modifying only coordinates inside the ignored label leaves the observable unchanged. -/
theorem dependsOutside_union {β : Type*} (A S : Finset X) (f : Finset X → β)
    (hf : DependsOutside A f) (hSA : S ⊆ A) (W : Finset X) :
    f (W ∪ S) = f W := by
  apply hf
  ext x
  simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx | hx, hn⟩
    · exact ⟨hx, hn⟩
    · exact (hn (hSA hx)).elim
  · rintro ⟨hx, hn⟩
    exact ⟨Or.inl hx, hn⟩

theorem inv_pow_card_mul_pow_sdiff (p : ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (S T : Finset X) :
    (p⁻¹) ^ S.card * p ^ (S \ T).card = (p⁻¹) ^ (T ∩ S).card := by
  have hc : (S \ T).card + (T ∩ S).card = S.card := by
    simpa only [Finset.inter_comm] using Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_inter S T
  rw [← hc, pow_add]
  calc
    (p⁻¹) ^ (S \ T).card * (p⁻¹) ^ (T ∩ S).card * p ^ (S \ T).card =
        ((p⁻¹) ^ (S \ T).card * p ^ (S \ T).card) * (p⁻¹) ^ (T ∩ S).card := by ring
    _ = (p⁻¹) ^ (T ∩ S).card := by rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hp, one_pow, one_mul]

/-- The only pointwise change of density is the reciprocal cutoff.
The remaining event uses coordinates inside the fixed target label. -/
theorem cutoff_source_weight_le (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X)
    {p δ : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hδ : 0 < δ) (W : Finset X) (c b : B) :
    (if δ ≤ resamplingZ ν A p (resamplingY A W c)
      then resamplingWeight ν A p W (c, b) else 0) ≤
      if A b \ A c ⊆ W then δ⁻¹ * ν.weight c * ν.weight b * (p⁻¹) ^ (A b).card
      else 0 := by
  have hnum : 0 ≤ ν.weight b * (p⁻¹) ^ (A b).card :=
    mul_nonneg (ν.nonneg b) (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hp) _)
  by_cases he : A b \ A c ⊆ W
  · have he' : A b ⊆ resamplingY A W c :=
      (subset_union_iff_sdiff_subset (A b) (A c) W).mpr he
    rw [ite_eq_left he]
    by_cases hz : δ ≤ resamplingZ ν A p (resamplingY A W c)
    · rw [ite_eq_left hz]
      simp only [resamplingWeight, resamplingTargetWeight, resamplingNumerator, ite_eq_left he']
      calc
        ν.weight c * (ν.weight b * (p⁻¹) ^ (A b).card /
            resamplingZ ν A p (resamplingY A W c)) ≤
            ν.weight c * (ν.weight b * (p⁻¹) ^ (A b).card / δ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum hδ hz) (ν.nonneg c)
        _ = _ := by ring
    · rw [ite_eq_right hz]
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hδ.le) (ν.nonneg c))
        (ν.nonneg b)) (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hp) _)
  · have he' : ¬ A b ⊆ resamplingY A W c :=
      fun h => he ((subset_union_iff_sdiff_subset (A b) (A c) W).mp h)
    simp [he, resamplingWeight, resamplingTargetWeight, resamplingNumerator, he']

variable [Fintype X]

/-- A containment event on ignored coordinates is independent of the observable.
This is derived from the fixed-union formula for the actual Bernoulli product weights. -/
theorem bernoulli_subset_expectation_of_dependsOutside
    {p : ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (A S : Finset X) (f : Finset X → ℝ)
    (hf : DependsOutside A f) (hSA : S ⊆ A) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => if S ⊆ W then f W else 0) =
      p ^ S.card * bernoulliExpectation p f := by
  have hu : bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => f (W ∪ S)) =
      bernoulliExpectation p f := by
    congr 1
    funext W
    exact dependsOutside_union A S f hf hSA W
  have hd : bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => if S ⊆ W then f W / p ^ S.card else 0) =
      bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => if S ⊆ W then f W else 0) / p ^ S.card := by
    unfold bernoulliExpectation
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro W _
    by_cases hW : S ⊆ W <;> simp [hW, mul_div_assoc]
  have h := bernoulliExpectation_union_fixed (p := p) hp S f
  rw [hu, hd] at h
  have he := (eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero _ hp)).mp h
  simpa only [mul_comm] using he.symm

namespace OAI

/-!
# Covering a probability tree by iterative reductions

Recovery keeps the original and retained path histories distinct, even when
their labels agree. All draws are retained in the accumulating union.
-/

noncomputable section
open Classical

namespace LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai

/-- A nondecreasing finite list of capacities has a zero prefix followed by
strictly positive capacities. The empty positive suffix is permitted. -/
theorem exists_zero_prefix_positive_suffix (m : ℕ → ℕ) (d : ℕ)
    (hmono : MonotoneOn m (Set.Iio d)) :
    ∃ k, k ≤ d ∧ (∀ i, i < k → m i = 0) ∧
      (∀ i, i < d - k → 0 < m (i + k)) := by
  classical
  by_cases h : ∃ k, k < d ∧ 0 < m k
  · let k := Nat.find h
    have hk : k < d ∧ 0 < m k := Nat.find_spec h
    refine ⟨k, hk.1.le, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i hi
      by_contra hzero
      have hip : 0 < m i := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
      have hki : k ≤ i := Nat.find_min' h ⟨lt_trans hi hk.1, hip⟩
      omega
    · intro i hi
      have hik : i + k < d := by omega
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hk.2 (hmono hk.1 hik (by omega))
  · refine ⟨d, le_rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i hi
      by_contra hzero
      exact h ⟨i, hi, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero⟩
    · intro i hi
      omega

theorem capacityReserve_div_sampling_le {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (m : ℕ) :
    capacityReserve σ m / (Real.exp 50 * (4 * σ)) ≤ Real.exp (-50) := by
  have hp : 0 < Real.exp 50 * (4 * σ) := by positivity
  calc
    _ ≤ (4 * σ) / (Real.exp 50 * (4 * σ)) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (capacityReserve_upper hσ.le m) hp.le
    _ = Real.exp (-50) := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg]
      field_simp

theorem sampling_budget_le {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (L : ℕ) :
    ((4 * successesNeeded L : ℕ) : ℝ) * (Real.exp 50 * (4 * σ)) ≤
      16 * Real.exp 50 * σ * (1 + Real.logb 2 (L : ℝ)) := by
  calc
    _ = (16 * Real.exp 50 * σ) * (successesNeeded L : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (successesNeeded_le_logb L) (by positivity)

namespace ProbabilityTree

variable {X : Type} [DecidableEq X]

/-- Each path of a retained tree recovers a path of the original tree after
the already collected coordinates are added. -/
def Recovers {d e : ℕ} (T : ProbabilityTree X d) (S : ProbabilityTree X e)
    (W : Finset X) : Prop :=
  ∀ q : S.Path, ∃ p : T.Path, T.pathUnion p ⊆ W ∪ S.pathUnion q

theorem Recovers.refl {d : ℕ} (T : ProbabilityTree X d) : Recovers T T ∅ := by
  intro p
  exact ⟨p, by simp⟩

theorem Recovers.mono {d e : ℕ} {T : ProbabilityTree X d} {S : ProbabilityTree X e}
    {W V : Finset X} (h : Recovers T S W) (hWV : W ⊆ V) : Recovers T S V := by
  intro q
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := h q
  exact ⟨p, hp.trans (Finset.union_subset_union hWV (Finset.Subset.refl _))⟩

/-- Recovery composes through the union of the independent draws. -/
theorem Recovers.trans {d e f : ℕ}
    {T : ProbabilityTree X d} {S : ProbabilityTree X e} {U : ProbabilityTree X f}
    {W V : Finset X} (hTS : Recovers T S W) (hSU : Recovers S U V) :
    Recovers T U (W ∪ V) := by
  intro r
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hSU r
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hTS q
  refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
  simpa only [Finset.union_assoc] using
    hp.trans (Finset.union_subset_union (Finset.Subset.refl W) hq)

/-- A covered retained path yields a covered original path. -/
theorem Recovers.coveredBy {d e : ℕ} {T : ProbabilityTree X d} {S : ProbabilityTree X e}
    {W V : Finset X} (h : Recovers T S W) (hS : S.CoveredBy V) :
    T.CoveredBy (W ∪ V) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hS
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := h q
  exact ⟨p, hp.trans (Finset.union_subset_union (Finset.Subset.refl W) hq)⟩

/-- When no levels remain, recovery is already a covering certificate. -/
theorem Recovers.coveredBy_of_depth_zero {d : ℕ} {T : ProbabilityTree X d}
    {S : ProbabilityTree X 0} {W : Finset X} (h : Recovers T S W) : T.CoveredBy W := by
  cases S
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := h PUnit.unit
  exact ⟨p, by simpa only [pathUnion, Finset.union_empty] using hp⟩

theorem Recovers.coveredBy_of_depth_eq_zero {d e : ℕ} {T : ProbabilityTree X d}
    {S : ProbabilityTree X e} {W : Finset X} (h : Recovers T S W) (he : e = 0) :
    T.CoveredBy W := by
  subst e
  exact h.coveredBy_of_depth_zero

/-- Removing empty initial labels preserves recovery without adding any
coordinates. The path lifting premise is supplied by deterministic prefix
removal. -/
theorem Recovers.of_pathUnion_eq {d e : ℕ}
    {T : ProbabilityTree X d} {S : ProbabilityTree X e}
    (h : ∀ q : S.Path, ∃ p : T.Path, T.pathUnion p = S.pathUnion q) :
    Recovers T S ∅ := by
  intro q
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := h q
  exact ⟨p, by simp [hp]⟩

/-- Increasing each nonnegative level spread parameter preserves spread. -/
theorem HasSpread.mono {d : ℕ} {T : ProbabilityTree X d} {a b : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hT : T.HasSpread a) (ha : ∀ i, i < d → 0 ≤ a i)
    (hab : ∀ i, i < d → a i ≤ b i) : T.HasSpread b := by
  induction T generalizing a b with
  | leaf => trivial
  | @node d B inst law positive label child ih =>
      constructor
      · intro J hJ
        exact (hT.1 J hJ).trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (ha 0 (by omega)) (hab 0 (by omega)) _)
      · intro c
        exact ih c (hT.2 c) (fun i hi => ha (i + 1) (by omega))
          (fun i hi => hab (i + 1) (by omega))

theorem coveredBy_probability_one [Fintype X] {d : ℕ} (T : ProbabilityTree X d) :
    bernoulliProbability 1 T.CoveredBy = 1 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (bernoulliLaw 1 (by norm_num) le_rfl).prob_le_one T.CoveredBy
  · have h := (bernoulliLaw (X := X) 1 (by norm_num) le_rfl).prob_mono
      (P := fun W => Finset.univ ⊆ W) (Q := T.CoveredBy)
      (fun _ hW => coveredBy_mono (coveredBy_univ T) hW)
    change bernoulliProbability 1 (fun W => Finset.univ ⊆ W) ≤
      bernoulliProbability 1 T.CoveredBy at h
    simpa only [bernoulliProbability_subset, one_pow] using h

/-- The actual retained tree, its spread budget, and recovery to the fixed
original tree. Only positive-capacity levels are stored. -/
structure CoverState {k : ℕ} (original : ProbabilityTree X k) (σ : ℝ) where
  depth : ℕ
  tree : ProbabilityTree X depth
  capacity : ℕ → ℕ
  disjoint : tree.IsDisjoint
  capacities : tree.HasCapacities capacity
  spread : tree.HasSpread (fun i => capacityReserve σ (capacity i))
  positive : ∀ i, i < depth → 0 < capacity i
  growth : ∀ i, i + 1 < depth → 16 * capacity i ≤ capacity (i + 1)
  seen : Finset X
  recovery : Recovers original tree seen

namespace CoverState

variable {k : ℕ} {original : ProbabilityTree X k} {σ : ℝ}

def initial (original : ProbabilityTree X k) (σ : ℝ) (m : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hdisjoint : original.IsDisjoint)
    (hcapacity : original.HasCapacities m)
    (hspread : original.HasSpread (fun _ => σ))
    (hpositive : ∀ i, i < k → 0 < m i)
    (hgrowth : ∀ i, i + 1 < k → 16 * m i ≤ m (i + 1)) : CoverState original σ :=
  { depth := k
    tree := original
    capacity := m
    disjoint := hdisjoint
    capacities := hcapacity
    spread := hspread.mono (fun _ _ => hσ.le) (fun i _ => capacityReserve_lower hσ.le (m i))
    positive := hpositive
    growth := hgrowth
    seen := ∅
    recovery := Recovers.refl original }

def rank (state : CoverState original σ) : ℕ :=
  if state.depth = 0 then 0 else successesNeeded (state.capacity (state.depth - 1))

@[simp] theorem rank_eq_zero_iff (state : CoverState original σ) :
    state.rank = 0 ↔ state.depth = 0 := by
  unfold rank
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h, ne_of_gt (successesNeeded_pos _)]

theorem coveredBy_of_rank_zero (state : CoverState original σ) (h : state.rank = 0) :
    original.CoveredBy state.seen :=
  state.recovery.coveredBy_of_depth_eq_zero ((rank_eq_zero_iff state).mp h)

/-- Every draw is retained even when the reduction attempt fails. -/
def accumulate (state : CoverState original σ) (W : Finset X) : CoverState original σ :=
  { state with
    seen := state.seen ∪ W
    recovery := state.recovery.mono Finset.subset_union_left }

@[simp] theorem accumulate_rank (state : CoverState original σ) (W : Finset X) :
    (state.accumulate W).rank = state.rank := rfl

def Advances (state : CoverState original σ) (W : Finset X)
    (next : CoverState original σ) : Prop :=
  next.rank < state.rank ∧ next.seen = state.seen ∪ W

/-- Choose a strict improvement when one exists; otherwise keep the tree.
Existence of improvements will be supplied by the actual good-tree reduction. -/
def step (state : CoverState original σ) (W : Finset X) : CoverState original σ :=
  if h : ∃ next, state.Advances W next then Classical.choose h else state.accumulate W

theorem step_seen (state : CoverState original σ) (W : Finset X) :
    (state.step W).seen = state.seen ∪ W := by
  unfold step
  split_ifs with h
  · exact (Classical.choose_spec h).2
  · rfl

theorem step_rank_le (state : CoverState original σ) (W : Finset X) :
    (state.step W).rank ≤ state.rank := by
  unfold step
  split_ifs with h
  · exact (Classical.choose_spec h).1.le
  · exact le_rfl

theorem step_rank_lt_of_exists (state : CoverState original σ) (W : Finset X)
    (h : ∃ next, state.Advances W next) : (state.step W).rank < state.rank := by
  unfold step
  rw [dite_eq_left h]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec h).1

theorem biUnion_fin_succ {n : ℕ} (draws : Fin (n + 1) → Finset X) :
    Finset.univ.biUnion draws = draws 0 ∪ Finset.univ.biUnion (fun i : Fin n => draws i.succ) := by
  ext x
  simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    refine Fin.cases (fun hx => Or.inl hx) (fun j hx => Or.inr ⟨j, hx⟩) i hi
  · rintro (h | ⟨i, hi⟩)
    · exact ⟨0, h⟩
    · exact ⟨i.succ, hi⟩

/-- The recorded set is exactly the union of all draws, including failures. -/
theorem run_seen (n : ℕ) (state : CoverState original σ) (draws : Fin n → Finset X) :
    (adaptiveRun step n state draws).seen = state.seen ∪ Finset.univ.biUnion draws := by
  induction n generalizing state with
  | zero => simp [adaptiveRun]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [adaptiveRun, ih, step_seen, biUnion_fin_succ, Finset.union_assoc]

/-- The finite adaptive theorem transfers actual strict advances to covering.
The good-tree probability estimate supplies the premise in the final theorem. -/
theorem prob_covered_of_advance_probability [Fintype X] (μ : FiniteLaw (Finset X))
    (hprogress : ∀ state : CoverState original σ, state.rank ≠ 0 →
      (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ μ.prob (fun W => ∃ next, state.Advances W next))
    (s : ℕ) (state : CoverState original σ) (hrank : state.rank ≤ s) :
    (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ (μ.iid (4 * s)).prob
      (fun draws => original.CoveredBy (state.seen ∪ Finset.univ.biUnion draws)) := by
  have hp : ∀ st : CoverState original σ, st.rank ≠ 0 →
      (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ μ.prob (fun W => (st.step W).rank < st.rank) := by
    intro st hst
    exact (hprogress st hst).trans (μ.prob_mono fun W hW => st.step_rank_lt_of_exists W hW)
  have hcomplete := adaptive_rank_completion μ rank step step_rank_le hp s state hrank
  apply hcomplete.trans

/-!
# The bad-node potential for simultaneous tree reduction

All nodes in a reduction use the same random set. The expectation argument
uses an outside-coordinate change of measure, rather than independence of
node outcomes.
-/

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators
open Classical

namespace LeanBlast.SecondKahnKalai

/-- One step of the actual recursive bad-node potential. -/
def nodePotential {B : Type*} [Fintype B] (m : ℕ) (failure : ℝ)
    (target childPotential : B → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (failure + ∑ b, target b * childPotential b) / Real.exp (-(m : ℝ))

theorem nodePotential_nonneg {B : Type*} [Fintype B] (m : ℕ) (failure : ℝ)
    (target childPotential : B → ℝ) (hf : 0 ≤ failure)
    (ht : ∀ b, 0 ≤ target b) (hc : ∀ b, 0 ≤ childPotential b) :
    0 ≤ nodePotential m failure target childPotential := by
  exact div_nonneg (add_nonneg hf (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => mul_nonneg (ht b) (hc b))))
    (Real.exp_pos _).le

/-- A failed good-mass threshold forces the recursively defined potential
above one. Children with zero target mass require no special treatment. -/
theorem one_lt_nodePotential_of_bad {B : Type*} [Fintype B]
    (m : ℕ) (failure : ℝ) (target childPotential : B → ℝ) (good : B → Prop)
    (ht : ∀ b, 0 ≤ target b) (hc : ∀ b, 0 ≤ childPotential b)
    (hmass : failure + ∑ b, target b = 1)
    (hchild : ∀ b, ¬good b → 1 < childPotential b)
    (hbad : (∑ b, if good b then target b else 0) < 1 - Real.exp (-(m : ℝ))) :
    1 < nodePotential m failure target childPotential := by
  classical
  have hsplit : (∑ b, if good b then target b else 0) +
      (∑ b, if good b then 0 else target b) = ∑ b, target b := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    by_cases hb : good b <;> simp [hb]
  have hsum : (∑ b, if good b then 0 else target b) ≤
      ∑ b, target b * childPotential b := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro b _
    by_cases hb : good b
    · simpa only [ite_eq_left hb] using mul_nonneg (ht b) (hc b)
    · simpa only [ite_eq_right hb, mul_one] using
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hchild b hb).le (ht b)
  unfold nodePotential
  apply (lt_div_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos _)).mpr
  nlinarith

theorem bernoulliExpectation_nodePotential {X B : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    [Fintype B] (p : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (failure : Finset X → ℝ)
    (target childPotential : B → Finset X → ℝ) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => nodePotential m (failure W)
      (fun b => target b W) (fun b => childPotential b W)) =
      (bernoulliExpectation p failure +
        ∑ b, bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => target b W * childPotential b W)) /
        Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)) := by
  unfold bernoulliExpectation nodePotential
  dsimp only
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro W _
  rw [← mul_div_assoc, mul_add, Finset.mul_sum]

/-- The expectation recursion uses one change-of-measure estimate per child;
it does not factor a product of dependent random variables. -/
theorem bernoulliExpectation_nodePotential_le {X B : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    [Fintype B] (p : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (ν : FiniteLaw B) (failure : Finset X → ℝ)
    (target childPotential : B → Finset X → ℝ)
    (hfailure : bernoulliExpectation p failure ≤ Real.exp (-9 * (m : ℝ)))
    (hchild : ∀ b,
      bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => target b W * childPotential b W) ≤
        Real.exp (11 * (m : ℝ)) * ν.weight b * bernoulliExpectation p (childPotential b)) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => nodePotential m (failure W)
      (fun b => target b W) (fun b => childPotential b W)) ≤
      Real.exp (-8 * (m : ℝ)) + Real.exp (12 * (m : ℝ)) *
        ν.expectation (fun b => bernoulliExpectation p (childPotential b)) := by
  rw [bernoulliExpectation_nodePotential]
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b (_ : b ∈ Finset.univ) => hchild b)
  have hsum : (∑ b, Real.exp (11 * (m : ℝ)) * ν.weight b *
      bernoulliExpectation p (childPotential b)) =
      Real.exp (11 * (m : ℝ)) * ν.expectation
        (fun b => bernoulliExpectation p (childPotential b)) := by
    unfold FiniteLaw.expectation
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    ring
  have hbound := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (add_le_add hfailure hs) (Real.exp_pos (-(m : ℝ))).le
  rw [hsum] at hbound
  refine hbound.trans_eq ?_
  have hfirst : Real.exp (-9 * (m : ℝ)) / Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)) =
      Real.exp (-8 * (m : ℝ)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_sub]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hsecond : Real.exp (11 * (m : ℝ)) / Real.exp (-(m : ℝ)) =
      Real.exp (12 * (m : ℝ)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_sub]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [add_div, hfirst, mul_div_right_comm, hsecond]

/-- Deterministic envelope obtained by iterating the expectation recursion. -/
def potentialEnvelope : ℕ → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 0
  | d + 1, m => Real.exp (-8 * (m 0 : ℝ)) + Real.exp (12 * (m 0 : ℝ)) *
      potentialEnvelope d (fun j => m (j + 1))

theorem potentialEnvelope_eq_sum (d : ℕ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) :
    potentialEnvelope d m =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range d,
        Real.exp (12 * (∑ h ∈ Finset.range j, (m h : ℝ)) - 8 * (m j : ℝ)) := by
  induction d generalizing m with
  | zero => simp [potentialEnvelope]
  | succ d ih =>
    rw [potentialEnvelope, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ']
    simp only [Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, mul_zero, zero_sub, neg_mul]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [add_comm]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [← Real.exp_add, Finset.sum_range_succ']
    congr 1
    ring

section Trees

variable {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]

def treePotential (p : ℝ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (W : Finset X) {d : ℕ}
    (T : ProbabilityTree X d) : ℝ :=
  match T with
  | .leaf => 0
  | @ProbabilityTree.node _ _ B inst ν hν A child =>
      nodePotential (m 0) (localFailureMass ν A p (m 0) W)
        (successfulTargetMass ν A p (m 0) W)
        (fun b => treePotential p (fun j => m (j + 1)) W (child b))
termination_by d

omit [Fintype X] in
theorem treePotential_nonneg {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (W : Finset X)
    {d : ℕ} (T : ProbabilityTree X d) : 0 ≤ treePotential p m W T := by
  induction T generalizing m with
  | leaf => simp only [treePotential, le_refl]
  | @node d B inst ν hν A child ih =>
      simp only [treePotential]
      exact nodePotential_nonneg (m 0) _ _ _ (localFailureMass_nonneg ν A hp (m 0) W)
        (fun b => successfulTargetMass_nonneg ν A hp (m 0) W b)
        (fun b => ih b (fun j => m (j + 1)))

omit [Fintype X] in
theorem one_lt_treePotential_of_not_good {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (m : ℕ → ℕ)
    (W : Finset X) {d : ℕ} (T : ProbabilityTree X d) (hbad : ¬Good p m W T) :
    1 < treePotential p m W T := by
  induction T generalizing m with
  | leaf => simp only [Good, not_true_eq_false] at hbad
  | @node d B inst ν hν A child ih =>
      simp only [treePotential]
      simp only [Good] at hbad
      apply one_lt_nodePotential_of_bad (m 0) _ _ _
        (fun b => Good p (fun j => m (j + 1)) W (child b))
      · exact fun b => successfulTargetMass_nonneg ν A hp.le _ W b
      · exact fun b => treePotential_nonneg hp.le _ W (child b)
      · exact localFailureMass_add_successfulTargetMass ν A hν hp (m 0) W
      · exact fun b hb => ih b _ hb
      · exact lt_of_not_ge hbad

omit [Fintype X] in
/-- The potential only inspects the labels belonging to the fixed subtree. -/
theorem treePotential_dependsOnlyOn (p : ℝ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) {d : ℕ}
    (T : ProbabilityTree X d) : DependsOnlyOn T.support (fun W => treePotential p m W T) := by
  induction T generalizing m with
  | leaf => intro W V _; simp only [treePotential]
  | @node d B inst ν hν A child ih =>
      intro W V hWV
      have hd := ((localFailureMass_dependsOnlyOn ν A p (m 0)).mono
        (ProbabilityTree.labels_support_subset ν hν A child)) W V hWV
      have ht (b : B) := ((successfulTargetMass_dependsOnlyOn ν A p (m 0) b).mono
        (ProbabilityTree.labels_support_subset ν hν A child)) W V hWV
      have hc (b : B) := ((ih b (fun j => m (j + 1))).mono
        (ProbabilityTree.child_support_subset ν hν A child b)) W V hWV
      dsimp only at hd ht hc
      simp only [treePotential, nodePotential]
      rw [hd]
      congr 2
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      rw [ht b, hc b]

omit [Fintype X] in
/-- Path disjointness makes a descendant potential insensitive to its
incoming label; this is the locality needed by the change of measure. -/
theorem child_treePotential_dependsOutside {d : ℕ} {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (ν : FiniteLaw B) (hν : ν.IsPositive) (A : B → Finset X)
    (child : B → ProbabilityTree X d)
    (hdis : (ProbabilityTree.node B ν hν A child).IsDisjoint)
    (p : ℝ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (b : B) :
    DependsOutside (A b) (fun W => treePotential p m W (child b)) :=
  ProbabilityTree.child_dependsOutside hdis b (treePotential_dependsOnlyOn p m (child b))

theorem bad_probability_le_expected_treePotential {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (m : ℕ → ℕ) {d : ℕ} (T : ProbabilityTree X d) :
    bernoulliProbability p (fun W => ¬Good p m W T) ≤
      bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => treePotential p m W T) := by
  exact (bernoulliLaw p hp.le hp1).prob_le_expectation (fun W => ¬Good p m W T)
    (fun W => treePotential p m W T) (fun W => treePotential_nonneg hp.le m W T)
    (fun W hW => (one_lt_treePotential_of_not_good hp m W T hW).le)

omit [Fintype X] in
private theorem localFailureMass_eq_probability {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (ν : FiniteLaw B) (hν : ν.IsPositive) (A : B → Finset X)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (m : ℕ) (W : Finset X) :
    localFailureMass ν A p m W =
      (resamplingLaw ν A p W hν hp).prob (fun cb => LocalFailure ν A p m W cb.1 cb.2) := by
  simp only [localFailureMass, FiniteLaw.prob, resamplingLaw_weight, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

omit [Fintype X] in
theorem successfulTargetMass_le_cutoff {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (ν : FiniteLaw B) (A : B → Finset X) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (m : ℕ) (W : Finset X) (b : B) :
    successfulTargetMass ν A p m W b ≤
      cutoffTargetMass ν A p (Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ))) W b := by
  unfold successfulTargetMass cutoffTargetMass
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro c _
  by_cases hsuccess : LocalSuccess ν A p m W c b
  · have hcut : Real.exp (-10 * (m : ℝ)) ≤ resamplingZ ν A p (resamplingY A W c) :=
      hsuccess.1
    simp only [ite_eq_left hsuccess, ite_eq_left hcut, le_refl]
  · simp only [ite_eq_right hsuccess]
    split_ifs
    · exact resamplingWeight_nonneg ν A hp W (c, b)
    · exact le_rfl

theorem treePotential_expectation_node_le {d : ℕ} {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (ν : FiniteLaw B) (hν : ν.IsPositive) (A : B → Finset X)
    (child : B → ProbabilityTree X d) (m : ℕ → ℕ)
    {p a : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hspread : IsSpread ν A a) (hm : 1 ≤ m 0)
    (hsize : ∀ b, (A b).card ≤ m 0) (hsmall : a / p ≤ Real.exp (-50))
    (hdis : (ProbabilityTree.node B ν hν A child).IsDisjoint) :
    bernoulliExpectation p (fun W => treePotential p m W (ProbabilityTree.node B ν hν A child)) ≤
      Real.exp (-8 * (m 0 : ℝ)) + Real.exp (12 * (m 0 : ℝ)) *
        ν.expectation (fun b => bernoulliExpectation p
          (fun W => treePotential p (fun j => m (j + 1)) W (child b))) := by
  simp only [treePotential]
  apply bernoulliExpectation_nodePotential_le p (m 0) ν
  · have h := local_failure_bound ν A hν hp hp1 (m 0) hm hsize hspread ha hsmall
    simpa only [← localFailureMass_eq_probability ν hν A hp (m 0)] using h
  · intro b
    exact outside_change_of_measure_of_le ν A hp hp1.le ha hspread (m 0) b (hsize b) hsmall
      (fun W => treePotential p (fun j => m (j + 1)) W (child b))
      (fun W => treePotential_nonneg hp.le _ W (child b))
      (child_treePotential_dependsOutside ν hν A child hdis p _ b)
      (fun W => successfulTargetMass ν A p (m 0) W b)
      (fun W => successfulTargetMass_le_cutoff ν A hp.le (m 0) W b)

namespace OAI

/-! Reversal involutions on partners of a fixed incidence state. -/

namespace Barnette

open Fin.NatCast

variable {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V}

theorem cycleCoordinates_of_not_acyclic (hG : ¬G.IsAcyclic) :
    Nonempty (CycleCoordinates G) := by
  classical
  simp only [SimpleGraph.IsAcyclic, not_forall, not_not] at hG
  obtain ⟨v, p, hp⟩ := hG
  have hlen : 3 ≤ p.length := hp.isCircuit.three_le_length
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := (SimpleGraph.cycleGraph_isContained_iff (show 2 < p.length by omega)).mpr
    ⟨v, p, hp, rfl⟩
  have heq : p.length = (p.length - 3) + 3 := by omega
  rw [heq] at f
  refine ⟨⟨p.length - 3, ⟨f.toHom, f.injective⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  intro i
  apply f.toHom.map_adj
  apply SimpleGraph.cycleGraph_adj'.mpr
  right
  simp

namespace TriangleSystem

variable {A : Type*} (T : TriangleSystem A V) {X : Set V}

theorem opposite_indices : ∀ i j k l s : Fin 3,
    i ≠ j → k ≠ l → i ≠ s → j ≠ s → k ≠ s → l ≠ s →
    (i = k ∧ j = l) ∨ (i = l ∧ j = k) := by decide

structure OppositeCycle (s : T.State X) where
  cycle : CycleCoordinates (T.oppositeGraph s)
  face : Fin (cycle.n + 3) ↪ A
  leftCorner : Fin (cycle.n + 3) → Fin 3
  rightCorner : Fin (cycle.n + 3) → Fin 3
  left_eq : ∀ i, T.vertex (face i) (leftCorner i) = cycle.vertex i
  right_eq : ∀ i, T.vertex (face i) (rightCorner i) = cycle.vertex (i + 1)
  left_ne : ∀ i, leftCorner i ≠ s.val (face i)
  right_ne : ∀ i, rightCorner i ≠ s.val (face i)

theorem oppositeCycle_nonempty (s : T.State X) (hc : ¬(T.oppositeGraph s).IsAcyclic) :
    Nonempty (T.OppositeCycle s) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C⟩ := cycleCoordinates_of_not_acyclic hc
  choose face l r hl hr hls hrs using fun i => (C.adjacent i).2
  have hlr (i) : l i ≠ r i := by
    intro h
    have hh : C.vertex i = C.vertex (i + 1) := (hl i).symm.trans (h ▸ hr i)
    have heq := C.vertex.injective hh
    apply cyclic_one_ne_zero C.n
    exact add_left_cancel (by simpa using heq.symm : i + 1 = i + 0)
  have hface : Function.Injective face := by
    intro i j hij
    have hls' := hls j
    have hrs' := hrs j
    rw [← hij] at hls' hrs'
    have h := opposite_indices (l i) (r i) (l j) (r j) (s.val (face i))
      (hlr i) (hlr j) (hls i) (hrs i) hls' hrs'
    apply C.edge_indices_unique i j
    rcases h with ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ | ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    · left
      exact ⟨(hl i).symm.trans (by rw [hij, h₁, hl]),
        (hr i).symm.trans (by rw [hij, h₂, hr])⟩
    · right
      exact ⟨(hl i).symm.trans (by rw [hij, h₁, hr]),
        (hr i).symm.trans (by rw [hij, h₂, hl])⟩
  exact ⟨⟨C, ⟨face, hface⟩, l, r, hl, hr, hls, hrs⟩⟩

namespace OppositeCycle

variable {T} {s r : T.State X} (C : T.OppositeCycle s)

theorem corner_ne (i : Fin (C.cycle.n + 3)) : C.leftCorner i ≠ C.rightCorner i := by
  intro h
  have heq : C.cycle.vertex i = C.cycle.vertex (i + 1) :=
    (C.left_eq i).symm.trans (h ▸ C.right_eq i)
  apply cyclic_one_ne_zero C.cycle.n
  exact add_left_cancel (by simpa using (C.cycle.vertex.injective heq).symm : i + 1 = i + 0)

theorem partner_endpoints (hrs : T.Partner r s) (i : Fin (C.cycle.n + 3)) :
    (r.value (C.face i) = C.cycle.vertex i ∧

lemma restrict_star_image (S : Finset E) (v : V) :
    ((N.restrict (Subtype.val : S → E)).star v).image Subtype.val =
      (N.star v).filter (· ∈ S) := by
  ext e
  simp only [Finset.mem_image,Finset.mem_filter,mem_star]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k,hk,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hk,k.property⟩
  · rintro ⟨he,hs⟩
    exact ⟨⟨e,hs⟩,he,rfl⟩

lemma matching_complement_two (hN : N.Simple) (hc : N.graph.IsRegularOfDegree 3)
    (P : Finset E) (hP : ∀ v, ((N.star v).filter (· ∈ P)).card = 1) :
    (N.restrict (Subtype.val : ↥Pᶜ → E)).graph.IsRegularOfDegree 2 := by
  intro v
  rw [← card_star _ (hN.restrict N _ Subtype.val_injective),
    ← Finset.card_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective,N.restrict_star_image]
  have he := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := N.star v) (p := fun e => e ∈ P)
  rw [hP v,N.card_star hN,hc v] at he
  simpa only [Finset.mem_compl] using (show ((N.star v).filter (fun e => e ∉ P)).card = 2 by omega)

lemma cap_matching_some (A : Finset V) (P : Finset (N.regionEdges A)) (v : A) :
    (((N.cap A).star (some v)).filter (· ∈ P)).image Subtype.val =
      (N.star v.val).filter (· ∈ P.image Subtype.val) := by
  rw [Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter,Finset.image_inter _ _ Subtype.val_injective,
    N.cap_star_some,Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter]

omit [Fintype V] in
lemma cap_matching_none (A : Finset V) (P : Finset (N.regionEdges A)) :
    (((N.cap A).star none).filter (· ∈ P)).image Subtype.val =
      (N.cut A).filter (· ∈ P.image Subtype.val) := by
  rw [Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter,Finset.image_inter _ _ Subtype.val_injective,
    N.cap_star_none,Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter]

omit [Fintype V] in
lemma cap_matching_boundary (A : Finset V) (P : Finset (N.regionEdges A))
    (hP : ∀ v, (((N.cap A).star v).filter (· ∈ P)).card = 1) :
    ∃ c : E, c ∈ N.cut A ∧ c ∈ P.image Subtype.val ∧
      ∀ e ∈ N.cut A, e ∈ P.image Subtype.val ↔ e = c := by
  have hh := hP none
  rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective,N.cap_matching_none] at hh
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hh
  have hmem : c ∈ (N.cut A).filter (· ∈ P.image Subtype.val) := by rw [hc]; simp
  refine ⟨c,(Finset.mem_filter.mp hmem).1,(Finset.mem_filter.mp hmem).2,?_⟩
  intro e he
  have heq : e ∈ (N.cut A).filter (· ∈ P.image Subtype.val) ↔ e = c := by rw [hc]; simp

lemma cap_image_subset (A : Finset V) (P : Finset (N.regionEdges A)) :
    P.image Subtype.val ⊆ N.regionEdges A := by
  rintro e he
  obtain ⟨k,_,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
  exact k.property

lemma region_pair_inter (A : Finset V) (e : E) :
    e ∈ N.regionEdges A → e ∈ N.regionEdges Aᶜ → e ∈ N.cut A := by
  simp only [mem_regionEdges,mem_cut,Finset.mem_compl]
  tauto

lemma cap_glue_agrees (A : Finset V) (P : Finset (N.regionEdges A))
    (Q : Finset (N.regionEdges Aᶜ))
    (hcut : ∀ e ∈ N.cut A, e ∈ P.image Subtype.val ↔ e ∈ Q.image Subtype.val)
    (e : E) (he : e ∈ N.regionEdges A) :
    e ∈ P.image Subtype.val ∪ Q.image Subtype.val ↔ e ∈ P.image Subtype.val := by
  rw [Finset.mem_union,or_iff_left_iff_imp]
  intro hq
  exact (hcut e (N.region_pair_inter A e he (N.cap_image_subset Aᶜ Q hq))).mpr hq

    (Q : Finset (N.regionEdges Aᶜ))
    (hcut : ∀ e ∈ N.cut A, e ∈ P.image Subtype.val ↔ e ∈ Q.image Subtype.val)
    (e : E) (he : e ∈ N.regionEdges Aᶜ) :
    e ∈ P.image Subtype.val ∪ Q.image Subtype.val ↔ e ∈ Q.image Subtype.val := by
  rw [Finset.mem_union,or_iff_right_iff_imp]
  intro hp
  exact (hcut e (N.region_pair_inter A e (N.cap_image_subset A P hp) he)).mp hp

    (Q : Finset (N.regionEdges Aᶜ))
    (hP : ∀ v, (((N.cap A).star v).filter (· ∈ P)).card = 1)
    (hQ : ∀ v, (((N.cap Aᶜ).star v).filter (· ∈ Q)).card = 1)
    (hcut : ∀ e ∈ N.cut A, e ∈ P.image Subtype.val ↔ e ∈ Q.image Subtype.val) :
    ∀ v, ((N.star v).filter (· ∈ P.image Subtype.val ∪ Q.image Subtype.val)).card = 1 := by
  have side (B : Finset V) (P : Finset (N.regionEdges B)) (R : Finset E)
      (hP : ∀ v, (((N.cap B).star v).filter (· ∈ P)).card = 1)
      (hR : ∀ e ∈ N.regionEdges B, e ∈ R ↔ e ∈ P.image Subtype.val)
      (v : B) : ((N.star v.val).filter (· ∈ R)).card = 1 := by
    have heq : (N.star v.val).filter (· ∈ R) = (N.star v.val).filter (· ∈ P.image Subtype.val) := by
      apply Finset.filter_congr
      intro e he
      apply hR e
      rcases (N.mem_star e v.val).mp he with ht|hh
      · exact (N.mem_regionEdges B e).mpr (Or.inl (ht ▸ v.property))
      · exact (N.mem_regionEdges B e).mpr (Or.inr (hh ▸ v.property))
    rw [heq,← N.cap_matching_some B P v,Finset.card_image_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective]
    exact hP (some v)
  intro v
  by_cases hv : v ∈ A
  · exact side A P _ hP (N.cap_glue_agrees A P Q hcut) ⟨v,hv⟩
  · exact side Aᶜ Q _ hQ (N.cap_glue_agrees_right A P Q hcut) ⟨v,Finset.mem_compl.mpr hv⟩
end

lemma cap_complement_reachable (A : Finset V) (P : Finset (N.regionEdges A))
    (R : Finset E)
    (hc : ((N.cap A).restrict (Subtype.val : ↥Pᶜ → N.regionEdges A)).graph.Connected)
    (hd : ((N.cap A).restrict (Subtype.val : ↥Pᶜ → N.regionEdges A)).graph.IsRegularOfDegree 2)
    (hR : ∀ e ∈ N.regionEdges A, e ∈ R ↔ e ∈ P.image Subtype.val)
    (v w : A) : (N.restrict (Subtype.val : ↥Rᶜ → E)).graph.Reachable v.val w.val := by
  let C := ((N.cap A).restrict (Subtype.val : ↥Pᶜ → N.regionEdges A)).graph
  have hC : (C.induce {x | x ≠ none}).Connected :=
    Barnette.SimpleCycle.delete_vertex_connected C hc hd none
  let f : (C.induce {x | x ≠ none}) →g (N.restrict (Subtype.val : ↥Rᶜ → E)).graph := {
    toFun := fun x => (x.val.getD v).val
    map_rel' := by
      rintro ⟨x,hx⟩ ⟨y,hy⟩ hxy
      cases x with
      | none => exact (hx rfl).elim
      | some x =>
        cases y with
        | none => exact (hy rfl).elim
        | some y =>
          obtain ⟨hne,k,hk⟩ := hxy
          have hxy' : x.val ≠ y.val := by
            intro hh
            have hh' : x = y := Subtype.ext hh
            subst y
            exact hne rfl
          have hk' : (N.tail k.val.val = x.val ∧ N.head k.val.val = y.val) ∨
              (N.tail k.val.val = y.val ∧ N.head k.val.val = x.val) := by
            change (N.capMap A (N.tail k.val.val) = some x ∧ N.capMap A (N.head k.val.val) = some y) ∨
              (N.capMap A (N.tail k.val.val) = some y ∧ N.capMap A (N.head k.val.val) = some x) at hk
            simpa only [capMap_eq_some] using hk
          have hnot : k.val.val ∉ P.image Subtype.val := by
            intro hm
            obtain ⟨e,he,hee⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
            have hee' : e = k.val := Subtype.ext hee
            exact (Finset.mem_compl.mp k.property) (hee' ▸ he)
          have hkR : k.val.val ∈ Rᶜ :=
            Finset.mem_compl.mpr (hnot ∘ (hR k.val.val k.val.property).mp)
          exact ⟨hxy',⟨k.val.val,hkR⟩,hk'⟩ }
  exact (hC ⟨some v,by simp⟩ ⟨some w,by simp⟩).map f

namespace Barnette

open scoped BigOperators Polynomial
open Polynomial

theorem common_phase_sum_ne_zero {D : Type*} (s : Finset D) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (c : D → ℕ) (p : D → ℂ[X]) (a : D → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ d ∈ s, 0 < a d)
    (hp : ∀ d ∈ s, (p d).coeff 0 = (a d : ℂ)) :
    (∑ d ∈ s, C ((-Complex.I) ^ c d) * (X ^ c d * p d)) ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨d₀, hd₀, hmin⟩ := s.exists_min_image c hs
  let m := c d₀
  let t := s.filter (fun d => c d = m)
  have ht : t.Nonempty := ⟨d₀, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hd₀, rfl⟩⟩
  have hpos : 0 < ∑ d ∈ t, a d := by
    exact Finset.sum_pos (fun d hd => ha d (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd).1) ht
  have hterm (d : D) (hd : d ∈ s) :
      (C ((-Complex.I) ^ c d) * (X ^ c d * p d)).coeff m =
        if c d = m then (-Complex.I) ^ m * (a d : ℂ) else 0 := by
    rw [coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow_mul']
    by_cases heq : c d = m
    · simp only [heq, le_refl, ite_true, Nat.sub_self, hp d hd]
    · have hlt : m < c d := lt_of_le_of_ne (hmin d hd) (Ne.symm heq)
      simp only [heq, not_le.mpr hlt, ite_false, mul_zero]
  have hcoeff :
      (∑ d ∈ s, C ((-Complex.I) ^ c d) * (X ^ c d * p d)).coeff m =
        (-Complex.I) ^ m * (∑ d ∈ t, a d : ℝ) := by
    rw [finsetSum_coeff]
    calc
      _ = ∑ d ∈ s, if c d = m then (-Complex.I) ^ m * (a d : ℂ) else 0 :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [t, Finset.sum_filter, Complex.ofReal_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro d _
        split_ifs <;> simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero, mul_zero]
  intro hz
  have hnz : (-Complex.I) ^ m * ((∑ d ∈ t, a d : ℝ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (neg_ne_zero.mpr Complex.I_ne_zero))
      (by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hpos)
  apply hnz
  rw [← hcoeff, hz, coeff_zero]

noncomputable def linearProduct {A R : Type*} [CommRing R] (s : Finset A) (a : A → R) : R[X] :=
  ∏ t ∈ s, (1 + C (a t) * X)

@[simp] theorem linearProduct_coeff_zero {A R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (s : Finset A) (a : A → R) : (linearProduct s a).coeff 0 = 1 := by
  simp [linearProduct, coeff_zero_prod]

theorem linearProduct_coeff_one {A R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (s : Finset A) (a : A → R) : (linearProduct s a).coeff 1 = ∑ t ∈ s, a t := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [linearProduct, coeff_one]
  | @insert t s ht ih =>
    rw [linearProduct, Finset.prod_insert ht, mul_coeff_one]
    change (1 + C (a t) * X).coeff 0 * (linearProduct s a).coeff 1 +
      (1 + C (a t) * X).coeff 1 * (linearProduct s a).coeff 0 = _
    simp [ih, Finset.sum_insert ht, add_comm, coeff_one]

theorem cycle_difference_divX_coeff_zero {A R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (s : Finset A) (a b : A → R) :
    (divX (linearProduct s a - linearProduct s b)).coeff 0 =
      (∑ t ∈ s, a t) - ∑ t ∈ s, b t := by
  rw [coeff_divX, zero_add, coeff_sub, linearProduct_coeff_one, linearProduct_coeff_one]

theorem cycle_difference_eq_X_mul_divX {A R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (s : Finset A) (a b : A → R) :
    linearProduct s a - linearProduct s b =
      X * divX (linearProduct s a - linearProduct s b) := by
  have h := X_mul_divX_add (linearProduct s a - linearProduct s b)
  simpa using h.symm

theorem cycle_group_polynomials_ne_zero {D A : Type*}
    (s : Finset D) (hs : s.Nonempty) (cycles : D → Finset A)
    (q : D → A → ℂ[X]) (a : D → A → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ d ∈ s, ∀ t ∈ cycles d, 0 < a d t)
    (hq : ∀ d ∈ s, ∀ t ∈ cycles d, (q d t).coeff 0 = (a d t : ℂ)) :
    (∑ d ∈ s, ∏ t ∈ cycles d, C (-Complex.I) * (X * q d t)) ≠ 0 := by
  have h := common_phase_sum_ne_zero s hs (fun d => (cycles d).card)
    (fun d => ∏ t ∈ cycles d, q d t) (fun d => ∏ t ∈ cycles d, a d t)
    (fun d hd => Finset.prod_pos (ha d hd)) (by
      intro d hd
      rw [coeff_zero_prod, Complex.ofReal_prod]
      exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (hq d hd))
  convert h using 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _
  simp only [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const, ← map_pow]

open scoped BigOperators Polynomial
open Polynomial

theorem phase_sum {K : Type*} (s : Finset K) (a : K → ℤ)
    (ha : ∀ k ∈ s, 3 ∣ a k) : phase (∑ k ∈ s, a k) = ∏ k ∈ s, phase (a k) := by
  classical
  unfold phase
  rw [Int.sum_div ha]
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert k s hk ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hk, Finset.prod_insert hk, zpow_add₀ Complex.I_ne_zero]
    congr 1
    exact ih (fun i hi => ha i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

@[simp] theorem phase_three : phase 3 = Complex.I := by norm_num [phase]
@[simp] theorem phase_neg_three : phase (-3) = -Complex.I := by norm_num [phase, Complex.inv_I]

theorem phase_neg_of_disk {n : ℤ} (hn : n = 3 ∨ n = -3) : phase (-n) = -phase n := by
  rcases hn with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num

namespace TriangleSystem.Pair

variable {A V : Type*} [Fintype A] {T : TriangleSystem A V} {X : Set V}

noncomputable def cycleFaces (P : @Pair A V T X) (c : CycleClass P.next) : Finset A := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun t => classOf P.next t = c)

@[simp] theorem mem_cycleFaces (P : @Pair A V T X) (c : CycleClass P.next) (t : A) :
    t ∈ P.cycleFaces c ↔ classOf P.next t = c := by
  classical
  simp [cycleFaces]

noncomputable def cycleDelta (P : @Pair A V T X) (c : CycleClass P.next) : ℤ :=
  ∑ t ∈ P.cycleFaces c, indexDelta (P.left.val t) (P.right.val t)

omit [Fintype A] in
@[simp] theorem orient_left_val (P : @Pair A V T X) (b : CycleClass P.next → Bool) (t : A) :
    (P.orient b).val.left.val t =
      if b (classOf P.next t) then P.right.val t else P.left.val t := rfl

omit [Fintype A] in
@[simp] theorem orient_right_val (P : @Pair A V T X) (b : CycleClass P.next → Bool) (t : A) :
    (P.orient b).val.right.val t =
      if b (classOf P.next t) then P.left.val t else P.right.val t := rfl

theorem orient_delta_sum (P : @Pair A V T X) (b : CycleClass P.next → Bool)
    (c : CycleClass P.next) :
    (∑ t ∈ P.cycleFaces c, indexDelta ((P.orient b).val.left.val t)
        ((P.orient b).val.right.val t)) =
      if b c then -P.cycleDelta c else P.cycleDelta c := by
  classical
  rw [cycleDelta]
  cases hb : b c
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t ht
    rw [orient_left_val, orient_right_val, (P.mem_cycleFaces c t).mp ht, hb]
    rfl
  · simp only [↓reduceIte, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t ht
    rw [orient_left_val, orient_right_val, (P.mem_cycleFaces c t).mp ht, hb]
    exact indexDelta_antisymm _ _

theorem orient_rawIndexSum (P : @Pair A V T X) (b : CycleClass P.next → Bool) :
    rawIndexSum (P.orient b).val.left (P.orient b).val.right =
      ∑ c, if b c then -P.cycleDelta c else P.cycleDelta c := by
  classical
  unfold rawIndexSum
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ (classOf P.next)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  exact P.orient_delta_sum b c

theorem orient_phase (P : @Pair A V T X)
    (hdisk : ∀ c, P.cycleDelta c = 3 ∨ P.cycleDelta c = -3)
    (b : CycleClass P.next → Bool) :
    phase (rawIndexSum (P.orient b).val.left (P.orient b).val.right) =
      ∏ c, if b c then -phase (P.cycleDelta c) else phase (P.cycleDelta c) := by
  classical
  rw [P.orient_rawIndexSum b, phase_sum]
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro c _
    cases hb : b c <;> simp [phase_neg_of_disk (hdisk c)]
  · intro c _
    rcases hdisk c with h | h <;> cases b c <;> simp [h]

noncomputable def stateWeight (w : A → Fin 3 → ℝ) (s : T.State X) : ℂ[X] :=
  linearProduct Finset.univ (fun t => (w t (s.val t) : ℂ))

noncomputable def cycleLeftWeight (P : @Pair A V T X) (w : A → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (c : CycleClass P.next) : ℂ[X] :=
  linearProduct (P.cycleFaces c) (fun t => (w t (P.left.val t) : ℂ))

noncomputable def cycleRightWeight (P : @Pair A V T X) (w : A → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (c : CycleClass P.next) : ℂ[X] :=
  linearProduct (P.cycleFaces c) (fun t => (w t (P.right.val t) : ℂ))

theorem orient_weight (P : @Pair A V T X) (w : A → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (b : CycleClass P.next → Bool) : stateWeight w (P.orient b).val.right =
      ∏ c, if b c then P.cycleLeftWeight w c else P.cycleRightWeight w c := by
  classical
  unfold stateWeight linearProduct
  rw [← Finset.prod_fiberwise Finset.univ (classOf P.next)]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro c _
  change (∏ t ∈ P.cycleFaces c, _) = _
  cases hb : b c
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, cycleRightWeight, linearProduct]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro t ht
    rw [orient_right_val, (P.mem_cycleFaces c t).mp ht, hb]
    rfl
  · simp only [↓reduceIte, cycleLeftWeight, linearProduct]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro t ht
    rw [orient_right_val, (P.mem_cycleFaces c t).mp ht, hb]
    rfl

noncomputable def term (w : A → Fin 3 → ℝ) (P : @Pair A V T X) : ℂ[X] :=
  C (phase (rawIndexSum P.left P.right)) * stateWeight w P.right

theorem orient_term (P : @Pair A V T X) (w : A → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hdisk : ∀ c, P.cycleDelta c = 3 ∨ P.cycleDelta c = -3)
    (b : CycleClass P.next → Bool) : term w (P.orient b).val =
      ∏ c, if b c then -C (phase (P.cycleDelta c)) * P.cycleLeftWeight w c
        else C (phase (P.cycleDelta c)) * P.cycleRightWeight w c := by
  classical
  rw [term, P.orient_phase hdisk, P.orient_weight, map_prod, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro c _
  cases b c <;> simp

theorem group_sum_product (P : @Pair A V T X) (w : A → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hdisk : ∀ c, P.cycleDelta c = 3 ∨ P.cycleDelta c = -3) :
    (∑ Q : P.Group, term w Q.val) =
      ∏ c, C (phase (P.cycleDelta c)) *
        (P.cycleRightWeight w c - P.cycleLeftWeight w c) := by
  classical
  rw [← Fintype.sum_equiv P.groupEquiv _ (fun Q : P.Group => term w Q.val)
    (fun _ => rfl)]
  calc
    _ = ∑ b : CycleClass P.next → Bool,
        ∏ c, if b c then -C (phase (P.cycleDelta c)) * P.cycleLeftWeight w c
          else C (phase (P.cycleDelta c)) * P.cycleRightWeight w c := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      exact P.orient_term w hdisk b
    _ = ∏ c, ∑ b : Bool, if b then -C (phase (P.cycleDelta c)) * P.cycleLeftWeight w c
          else C (phase (P.cycleDelta c)) * P.cycleRightWeight w c :=
      (Fintype.prod_sum (ι := CycleClass P.next) (κ := fun _ => Bool)
        (fun c b => if b then -C (phase (P.cycleDelta c)) * P.cycleLeftWeight w c
          else C (phase (P.cycleDelta c)) * P.cycleRightWeight w c)).symm
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro c _
      rw [Fintype.sum_bool]
      simp only [↓reduceIte, Bool.false_eq_true]
      ring

end TriangleSystem.Pair

variable {A V : Type*} [Fintype A] {T : TriangleSystem A V} {X : Set V}

noncomputable def cycleSlope (P : @Pair A V T X) (w : A → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (c : CycleClass P.next) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t ∈ P.cycleFaces c, w t (P.right.val t)) -
    ∑ t ∈ P.cycleFaces c, w t (P.left.val t)

theorem cycle_diff_coeff_one (P : @Pair A V T X) (w : A → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (c : CycleClass P.next) :
    (divX (P.cycleRightWeight w c - P.cycleLeftWeight w c)).coeff 0 =
      (P.cycleSlope w c : ℂ) := by
  rw [cycleRightWeight, cycleLeftWeight, cycle_difference_divX_coeff_zero]
  simp only [cycleSlope, Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.ofReal_sum]

theorem cycle_factor_witness (P : @Pair A V T X) (w : A → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (c : CycleClass P.next)
    (hsign : (P.cycleDelta c = -3 ∧ 0 < P.cycleSlope w c) ∨
      (P.cycleDelta c = 3 ∧ P.cycleSlope w c < 0)) :
    ∃ (q : ℂ[X]) (a : ℝ), 0 < a ∧ q.coeff 0 = (a : ℂ) ∧
      C (phase (P.cycleDelta c)) * (P.cycleRightWeight w c - P.cycleLeftWeight w c) =
        C (-Complex.I) * (Polynomial.X * q) := by

open scoped Classical
variable {V E F : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype F]
  (N : Network V E) (D : Network F E)

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype F] in
lemma Duality.symm (h : N.Duality D) : D.Duality N :=
  ⟨h.dual_connected,h.connected,h.dual_cycles_eq_cuts,h.cycles_eq_cuts⟩

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype F] in

lemma Duality.vertex_flow_circuit (h : N.Duality D) (z : F)
    (hz : (D.graph.induce {v | v ≠ z}).Connected) :
    N.FlowCircuit (D.gradient (fun w => if w = z then 1 else 0)) := by
  obtain ⟨r⟩ := hz.nonempty
  let x := D.gradient (fun w => if w = z then (1:ℝ) else 0)
  have hx : N.boundary x = 0 := (h.symm N D).dual_conserved_gradient D N _
  have hn : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    have hh := D.gradient_zero_reachable he (h.dual_connected z r.val)
    norm_num at hh
    exact r.property hh
  refine ⟨hx,hn,?_⟩
  intro y hy hs
  by_cases hy0 : y = 0
  · exact Or.inl hy0
  right
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := (h.symm N D).gradient_of_dual_conserved D N hy
  have fstep {v w : {v // v ≠ z}}
      (hvw : (D.graph.induce {v | v ≠ z}).Adj v w) : f v.val = f w.val := by
    obtain ⟨_,e,he⟩ := hvw
    have hxe : x e = 0 := by
      dsimp only [x,gradient_apply]
      rcases he with he | he <;> rw [he.1,he.2] <;> simp [v.property,w.property]
    have hye : y e = 0 := by
      by_contra he
      exact (N.mem_flowSupport x e).mp (hs ((N.mem_flowSupport y e).mpr he)) hxe
    have heq := congrFun hf e
    rw [hye,gradient_apply,sub_eq_zero] at heq
    exact he.elim (fun he => by rw [he.1,he.2] at heq; exact heq.symm)
      (fun he => by rwa [he.1,he.2] at heq)
  have fconstant (v : {v // v ≠ z}) : f v.val = f r.val := by
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := hz v r
    induction p with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons h p ih => exact (fstep h).trans ih
  have hne : f z ≠ f r.val := by
    intro he
    apply hy0
    rw [← hf]
    apply (D.gradient_eq_zero_iff f).mpr
    have hall (v : F) : f v = f r.val := by
      by_cases hv : v = z
      · rwa [hv]
      · exact fconstant ⟨v,hv⟩
    intro e
    exact (hall _).trans (hall _).symm
  apply Finset.Subset.antisymm hs
  intro e he
  apply (N.mem_flowSupport y e).mpr
  rw [← hf,gradient_apply]
  have hxe := (N.mem_flowSupport x e).mp he
  dsimp only [x,gradient_apply] at hxe
  by_cases ht : D.tail e = z <;> by_cases hh : D.head e = z
  · simp [ht,hh] at hxe
  · rw [ht,fconstant ⟨D.head e,hh⟩]
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hne.symm
  · rw [hh,fconstant ⟨D.tail e,ht⟩]
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
  · simp [ht,hh] at hxe

omit [Fintype V] in

lemma cut_restrict_conserved (x : E → ℝ) (hx : N.boundary x = 0) (A : Finset V)
    (hcut : ∀ e ∈ N.cut A, x e = 0) :
    N.boundary (fun e => if N.tail e ∈ A then x e else 0) = 0 := by
  ext v
  have hb : N.boundary (fun e => if N.tail e ∈ A then x e else 0) v =
      if v ∈ A then N.boundary x v else 0 := by
    simp only [boundary_apply]
    trans ∑ e, if v ∈ A then
      ((if N.head e = v then x e else 0) - (if N.tail e = v then x e else 0)) else 0
    swap
    · by_cases hv : v ∈ A <;> simp [hv]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro e _
    have hcross : N.tail e ∈ A ∨ N.head e ∈ A →
        ¬(N.tail e ∈ A ∧ N.head e ∈ A) → x e = 0 := by
      intro h1 h2
      apply hcut e
      rw [N.mem_cut]
      tauto
    by_cases ht : N.tail e = v <;> by_cases hh : N.head e = v <;>
      by_cases ha : N.tail e ∈ A <;> by_cases hb : N.head e ∈ A <;>
      by_cases hv : v ∈ A <;> simp_all
  rw [hb,hx]
  simp

omit [Fintype V] in

lemma FlowCircuit.no_split (x : E → ℝ) (hx : N.FlowCircuit x) (A : Finset V)
    (hcut : ∀ e ∈ N.cut A, x e = 0)
    {e : E} (he : x e ≠ 0) (heA : N.tail e ∈ A) :
    ∀ k, x k ≠ 0 → N.tail k ∈ A := by
  let y : E → ℝ := fun k => if N.tail k ∈ A then x k else 0
  have hy := N.cut_restrict_conserved x hx.conserved A hcut
  have hs : N.flowSupport y ⊆ N.flowSupport x := by
    intro k hk
    simp only [mem_flowSupport,y] at hk ⊢
    split_ifs at hk <;> tauto
  have hyn : y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hy0
    have hh := congrFun hy0 e
    apply he
    simpa [y,heA] using hh
  have hEq := (hx.minimal y hy hs).resolve_left hyn
  intro k hk
  have hyk := (N.mem_flowSupport y k).mp (by rw [hEq]; exact (N.mem_flowSupport x k).mpr hk)
  by_contra hn
  exact hyk (by simp [y,hn])

theorem mixed_corner_on_boundary (h : N.Duality D) (sD : D.Simple)
    (face : ∀ v, D.Triangle (N.star v)) (A : Finset V) {z : F}
    (hzin : z ∈ N.regionVertices D A) (hzout : z ∈ N.regionVertices D Aᶜ) :
    ∃ e ∈ N.cut A, D.Incident e z := by
  by_contra hn
  have hc := h.vertex_flow_circuit N D z
    (faces_vertex_deleted_connected N D h.connected h.dual_connected sD face z)
  let x := D.gradient (fun w => if w = z then (1:ℝ) else 0)
  have hs : N.flowSupport x = D.star z := D.gradient_indicator_support N sD z
  have hcut : ∀ e ∈ N.cut A, x e = 0 := by
    intro e he
    by_contra hx
    have hh : D.Incident e z := (D.mem_star e z).mp (by
      rw [← hs]; exact (N.mem_flowSupport x e).mpr hx)
    exact hn ⟨e,he,hh⟩
  obtain ⟨e,he,hez⟩ := (N.mem_regionVertices D A z).mp hzin
  have hex : x e ≠ 0 := (N.mem_flowSupport x e).mp (by rw [hs]; exact (D.mem_star e z).mpr hez)
  have heA : N.tail e ∈ A := by
    rcases (N.mem_regionEdges A e).mp he with ht | hh
    · exact ht
    · by_contra ht
      exact hex (hcut e ((N.mem_cut A e).mpr (Or.inr ⟨hh,ht⟩)))
  have hall := hc.no_split N x A hcut hex heA
  obtain ⟨k,hk,hkz⟩ := (N.mem_regionVertices D Aᶜ z).mp hzout
  have hkx : x k ≠ 0 := (N.mem_flowSupport x k).mp (by rw [hs]; exact (D.mem_star k z).mpr hkz)
  have hkA := hall k hkx
  rcases (N.mem_regionEdges Aᶜ k).mp hk with ht | hh
  · exact (Finset.mem_compl.mp ht) hkA
  · exact hkx (hcut k ((N.mem_cut A k).mpr (Or.inl ⟨hkA,Finset.mem_compl.mp hh⟩)))

end

variable {V E F : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype F]
  (N : Network V E) (D : Network F E)

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] in
def cycleVertices (C : Barnette.CycleCoordinates D.graph) : Finset F :=
  Finset.univ.image C.vertex

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype F] in
lemma mem_cycleVertices (C : Barnette.CycleCoordinates D.graph) (z : F) :
    z ∈ D.cycleVertices C ↔ ∃ i, C.vertex i = z := by
  simp [cycleVertices]

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype F] in
lemma incident_cycle_iff (C : Barnette.CycleCoordinates D.graph) (z : F) :
    (∃ e ∈ D.cycleEdges C, D.Incident e z) ↔ z ∈ D.cycleVertices C := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e,he,hz⟩
    obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := (D.mem_cycleEdges C e).mp he
    rw [D.incident_iff_mem_pair,D.cycleEdge_ends,Sym2.mem_iff] at hz
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl
    · exact (D.mem_cycleVertices C _).mpr ⟨i,rfl⟩
    · exact (D.mem_cycleVertices C _).mpr ⟨i+1,rfl⟩
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := (D.mem_cycleVertices C z).mp hz
    refine ⟨D.cycleEdge C i,(D.mem_cycleEdges C _).mpr ⟨i,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    rw [D.incident_iff_mem_pair,D.cycleEdge_ends]; simp

omit [Fintype V] in
lemma regionVertices_iff_face (face : ∀ v, D.Triangle (N.star v))
    (A : Finset V) (z : F) :
    z ∈ N.regionVertices D A ↔ ∃ v ∈ A, z ∈ Set.range (face v).corner := by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨e,he,hez⟩ := (N.mem_regionVertices D A z).mp hz
    rcases (N.mem_regionEdges A e).mp he with ht | hh
    · exact ⟨N.tail e,ht,((face _).corner_iff_incident D z).mpr
        ⟨e,(N.mem_star e _).mpr (Or.inl rfl),hez⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨N.head e,hh,((face _).corner_iff_incident D z).mpr
        ⟨e,(N.mem_star e _).mpr (Or.inr rfl),hez⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨v,hv,hz⟩
    obtain ⟨e,he,hez⟩ := ((face v).corner_iff_incident D z).mp hz
    refine (N.mem_regionVertices D A z).mpr ⟨e,?_,hez⟩
    rcases (N.mem_star e v).mp he with ht | hh
    · exact (N.mem_regionEdges A e).mpr (Or.inl (ht ▸ hv))
    · exact (N.mem_regionEdges A e).mpr (Or.inr (hh ▸ hv))

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype F] in
def blackEndpoint (black : V → Prop) (e : E) : V :=
  if black (N.tail e) then N.tail e else N.head e

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype F] in
lemma blackEndpoint_spec (black : V → Prop)
    (hc : ∀ e, black (N.tail e) ↔ ¬black (N.head e)) (e : E) :
    black (N.blackEndpoint black e) ∧ N.Incident e (N.blackEndpoint black e) := by
  by_cases ht : black (N.tail e)
  · simp only [blackEndpoint,ite_eq_left ht]; exact ⟨ht,Or.inl rfl⟩
  · simp only [blackEndpoint,ite_eq_right ht]
    exact ⟨not_not.mp (fun hh => ht ((hc e).mpr hh)),Or.inr rfl⟩

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype E] [Fintype F] in
lemma blackEndpoint_eq (black : V → Prop)
    (hc : ∀ e, black (N.tail e) ↔ ¬black (N.head e))
    {e : E} {v : V} (hv : black v) (he : N.Incident e v) :
    N.blackEndpoint black e = v := by
  rcases he with ht | hh
  · simp [blackEndpoint,ht,hv]
  · have hnt : ¬black (N.tail e) := fun ht => (hc e).mp ht (hh ▸ hv)
    simp [blackEndpoint,hnt,hh]

omit [Fintype V] [Fintype F] in
def blackCut (black : V → Prop) (A : Finset V) : Finset E :=
  (N.cut A).filter fun e => N.blackEndpoint black e ∈ A

omit [Fintype F] in
lemma cubic_black_region_count (sN : N.Simple) (hdeg : N.graph.IsRegularOfDegree 3)
    (black : V → Prop) (hc : ∀ e, black (N.tail e) ↔ ¬black (N.head e))
    (A : Finset V) :
    3 * (A.filter black).card + (N.cut A).card =
      (N.regionEdges A).card + (N.blackCut black A).card := by
  have hs := N.sum_stars sN (A.filter black)
  have hd : ∀ v, N.graph.degree v = 3 := hdeg
  have hh : (∑ v ∈ A.filter black, (N.star v).card) = 3 * (A.filter black).card := by
    simp only [N.card_star sN,hd]
    simp [Nat.mul_comm]
  rw [hh] at hs
  rw [hs]
  simp only [cut,regionEdges,blackCut,Finset.card_filter,Finset.mem_filter,
    Finset.sum_filter,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
