section

open Set Filter Finset
open scoped Topology symmDiff

namespace InfiniteMatroidCounterexample

noncomputable def dBlock (m : ℕ) : Finset D :=
  Finset.univ.map ⟨fun f ↦ ⟨m, f⟩, fun _ _ h ↦ by simpa using h⟩

noncomputable def wBlock (m : ℕ) : Finset E0 := (dBlock m).product Finset.univ

@[simp] lemma mem_dBlock (x : D) (m : ℕ) : x ∈ dBlock m ↔ x.1 = m := by
  classical
  rcases x with ⟨k, f⟩
  simp only [dBlock, Finset.mem_map, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, h⟩
    exact congrArg Sigma.fst h.symm
  · intro h
    subst k
    exact ⟨f, rfl⟩

@[simp] lemma mem_wBlock (x : E0) (m : ℕ) : x ∈ wBlock m ↔ x.1.1 = m := by
  simp [wBlock]

@[simp] lemma card_dBlock (m : ℕ) : (dBlock m).card = 2 ^ (2 ^ m) := by
  simp [dBlock]

@[simp] lemma card_wBlock (m : ℕ) : (wBlock m).card = 2 * 2 ^ (2 ^ m) := by
  simp [wBlock, mul_comm]

lemma dBlock_disjoint : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (dBlock i) (dBlock j)) := by
  intro i j hij
  classical
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hxi hxj ↦ hij ((mem_dBlock x i).mp hxi |>.symm.trans ((mem_dBlock x j).mp hxj))

lemma wBlock_disjoint : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (wBlock i) (wBlock j)) := by
  intro i j hij
  classical
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hxi hxj ↦ hij ((mem_wBlock x i).mp hxi |>.symm.trans ((mem_wBlock x j).mp hxj))

noncomputable def blockPrefix (n : ℕ) : Finset E0 :=
  (Finset.range n).biUnion wBlock

@[simp] lemma mem_prefix (x : E0) (n : ℕ) : x ∈ blockPrefix n ↔ x.1.1 < n := by
  classical
  simp [blockPrefix]

lemma prefix_mono {n k : ℕ} (hnk : n ≤ k) : blockPrefix n ⊆ blockPrefix k := by
  intro x hx
  exact (mem_prefix x k).mpr ((mem_prefix x n).mp hx |>.trans_le hnk)

lemma card_prefix (n : ℕ) : (blockPrefix n).card = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, (wBlock m).card := by
  classical
  exact Finset.card_biUnion (fun i _ j _ hij ↦ wBlock_disjoint hij)

lemma block_growth (m : ℕ) : 2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, 2 ^ (2 ^ j) ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ m) := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, pow_succ, pow_mul]
    by_cases hm : m = 0
    · subst m
      norm_num
    · have h4 : 4 ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ m) := by
        calc
          4 = 2 ^ (2 ^ 1) := by norm_num
          _ ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ m) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega))
      nlinarith

lemma block_prefix_growth {n k : ℕ} (hnk : n ≤ k) :
    2 * (blockPrefix n).card ≤ (wBlock k).card := by
  rw [card_prefix, card_wBlock]
  simp only [card_wBlock, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hsum : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, 2 ^ (2 ^ j) ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, 2 ^ (2 ^ j) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_mono hnk) (by intros; positivity)
  have hg := block_growth k
  nlinarith

noncomputable def traceFinset {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (X : Set α) : Finset α := by
  classical
  exact s.filter (· ∈ X)

@[simp] lemma mem_traceFinset {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (X : Set α) (x : α) :
    x ∈ traceFinset s X ↔ x ∈ s ∧ x ∈ X := by
  classical
  exact Finset.mem_filter

lemma traceFinset_subset {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (X : Set α) : traceFinset s X ⊆ s := by
  intro x hx
  exact (mem_traceFinset s X x).mp hx |>.1

lemma traceFinset_mono {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) {X Y : Set α} (h : X ⊆ Y) :
    traceFinset s X ⊆ traceFinset s Y := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨hxs, hxX⟩ := (mem_traceFinset s X x).mp hx
  exact (mem_traceFinset s Y x).mpr ⟨hxs, h hxX⟩

@[simp] lemma traceFinset_empty {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) : traceFinset s ∅ = ∅ := by
  ext x
  simp

@[simp] lemma traceFinset_univ {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) : traceFinset s univ = s := by
  ext x
  simp

lemma traceFinset_union {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) (X Y : Set α) :
    traceFinset s (X ∪ Y) = traceFinset s X ∪ traceFinset s Y := by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_traceFinset, Set.mem_union, Finset.mem_union]
  tauto

lemma traceFinset_disjoint {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) {X Y : Set α} (h : Disjoint X Y) :
    Disjoint (traceFinset s X) (traceFinset s Y) := by
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hx hy ↦
    Set.disjoint_left.mp h ((mem_traceFinset s X x).mp hx).2 ((mem_traceFinset s Y x).mp hy).2

/-- Counting density inside a finite block. -/
noncomputable def finiteDensity {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (X : Set α) : ℝ :=
  ((traceFinset s X).card : ℝ) / s.card

lemma finiteDensity_nonneg {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (X : Set α) :
    0 ≤ finiteDensity s X := by
  unfold finiteDensity
  positivity

lemma finiteDensity_le_one {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (X : Set α) :
    finiteDensity s X ≤ 1 := by
  unfold finiteDensity
  exact div_le_one_of_le₀ (by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (traceFinset_subset s X)) (by positivity)

lemma finiteDensity_mono {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) {X Y : Set α} (h : X ⊆ Y) :
    finiteDensity s X ≤ finiteDensity s Y := by
  unfold finiteDensity
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
  exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (traceFinset_mono s h)

lemma finiteDensity_union_le {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (X Y : Set α) :
    finiteDensity s (X ∪ Y) ≤ finiteDensity s X + finiteDensity s Y := by
  classical
  unfold finiteDensity
  rw [← add_div]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
  rw [traceFinset_union]
  exact_mod_cast Finset.card_union_le (traceFinset s X) (traceFinset s Y)

lemma finiteDensity_compl {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (X : Set α) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    finiteDensity s Xᶜ = 1 - finiteDensity s X := by
  classical
  have hc : (traceFinset s X).card + (traceFinset s Xᶜ).card = s.card := by
    rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (traceFinset_disjoint s disjoint_compl_right),
      ← traceFinset_union, union_compl_self, traceFinset_univ]
  have hs0 : (s.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hs.card_pos.ne'
  unfold finiteDensity
  have hc' : ((traceFinset s X).card : ℝ) + ((traceFinset s Xᶜ).card : ℝ) = s.card :=
    by exact_mod_cast hc
  field_simp
  linarith

lemma finiteDensity_union {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) {X Y : Set α} (h : Disjoint X Y) :
    finiteDensity s (X ∪ Y) = finiteDensity s X + finiteDensity s Y := by
  classical
  simp only [finiteDensity, traceFinset_union,
    Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (traceFinset_disjoint s h), Nat.cast_add, add_div]

noncomputable def density (X : Set E0) (m : ℕ) : ℝ := finiteDensity (wBlock m) X

def Small (X : Set E0) : Prop := Tendsto (density X) atTop (𝓝 0)

lemma small_empty : Small ∅ := by
  have heq : density ∅ = fun _ ↦ 0 := by ext m; simp [density, finiteDensity]
  rw [Small, heq]
  exact tendsto_const_nhds

lemma small_subset {X Y : Set E0} (hY : Small Y) (hXY : X ⊆ Y) : Small X := by
  exact squeeze_zero (fun m ↦ finiteDensity_nonneg _ _) (fun m ↦ finiteDensity_mono _ hXY) hY

lemma small_union {X Y : Set E0} (hX : Small X) (hY : Small Y) : Small (X ∪ Y) := by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun m ↦ density X m + density Y m) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using hX.add hY
  exact squeeze_zero (fun m ↦ finiteDensity_nonneg _ _) (fun m ↦ finiteDensity_union_le _ _ _) ht

lemma finite_subset_prefix {X : Set E0} (hX : X.Finite) : ∃ n, X ⊆ ↑(blockPrefix n) := by
  induction X, hX using Set.Finite.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨0, empty_subset _⟩
  | @insert x X hx hX ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨max n (x.1.1+1), Set.insert_subset ?_ (hn.trans (prefix_mono (le_max_left _ _)))⟩
    exact (mem_prefix _ _).mpr (by omega)

lemma small_finite {X : Set E0} (hX : X.Finite) : Small X := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := finite_subset_prefix hX
  have heq : density X =ᶠ[atTop] fun _ ↦ 0 := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N] with m hm
    have hempty : traceFinset (wBlock m) X = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro x hx
      have h1 := (mem_prefix x N).mp (hN ((mem_traceFinset (wBlock m) X x).mp hx).2)
      have h2 := (mem_wBlock x m).mp ((mem_traceFinset (wBlock m) X x).mp hx).1
      omega
    simp [density, finiteDensity, hempty]
  exact (tendsto_congr' heq).mpr tendsto_const_nhds

lemma small_univ_false : ¬ Small (univ : Set E0) := by
  have h1 : density univ = fun _ ↦ 1 := by
    ext m
    have hc : ((wBlock m).card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by simp
    simp only [density, finiteDensity, traceFinset_univ, div_self hc]
  intro h
  rw [Small, h1] at h
  have : (1 : ℝ) = 0 := tendsto_nhds_unique tendsto_const_nhds h
  norm_num at this

def SameClass (T X : Set E0) : Prop := Small (X ∆ T)

lemma sameClass_refl (T : Set E0) : SameClass T T := by
  simpa [SameClass] using small_empty

lemma sameClass_symm {T X : Set E0} (h : SameClass T X) : SameClass X T := by
  simpa [SameClass, symmDiff_comm] using h

lemma sameClass_trans {T X Y : Set E0} (hX : SameClass T X) (hY : SameClass X Y) : SameClass T Y := by
  exact small_subset (small_union hX hY) (by intro x; simp only [mem_symmDiff, mem_union]; tauto)

lemma sameClass_interval {T I X Y : Set E0} (hI : SameClass T I) (hY : SameClass T Y)
    (hIX : I ⊆ X) (hXY : X ⊆ Y) : SameClass T X := by
  apply small_subset (small_union hI hY)
  intro x hx
  simp only [mem_symmDiff, mem_union] at hx ⊢
  have hi := @hIX x
  have hy := @hXY x
  tauto

noncomputable def tailSup (u : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := sSup (u '' Ici n)
noncomputable def tailInf (u : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := sInf (u '' Ici n)

lemma tail_nonempty (u : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : (u '' Ici n).Nonempty :=
  ⟨u n, mem_image_of_mem u (mem_Ici.mpr le_rfl)⟩

lemma le_tailSup {u : ℕ → ℝ} (hu : BddAbove (Set.range u)) {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) :
    u m ≤ tailSup u n :=
  le_csSup (hu.mono (image_subset_range _ _)) (mem_image_of_mem u hnm)

lemma tailInf_le {u : ℕ → ℝ} (hu : BddBelow (Set.range u)) {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) :
    tailInf u n ≤ u m :=
  csInf_le (hu.mono (image_subset_range _ _)) (mem_image_of_mem u hnm)

lemma tailSup_le_add {u v : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} {δ : ℝ}
    (hv : BddAbove (Set.range v)) (h : ∀ m ≥ n, u m ≤ v m + δ) :
    tailSup u n ≤ tailSup v n + δ := by
  apply csSup_le (tail_nonempty u n)
  rintro x ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  have hh := le_tailSup hv hm
  linarith [h m hm]

lemma tailInf_le_add {u v : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} {δ : ℝ}
    (hu : BddBelow (Set.range u)) (h : ∀ m ≥ n, u m ≤ v m + δ) :
    tailInf u n ≤ tailInf v n + δ := by
  have hh : tailInf u n - δ ≤ tailInf v n := by
    apply le_csInf (tail_nonempty v n)
    rintro x ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    have h1 := tailInf_le hu hm
    have h2 := h m hm
    linarith
  linarith

lemma tailSup_mono {u v : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hv : BddAbove (Set.range v)) (h : ∀ m ≥ n, u m ≤ v m) :
    tailSup u n ≤ tailSup v n := by
  simpa using tailSup_le_add hv (δ := 0) (by simpa using h)

lemma tailInf_mono {u v : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hu : BddBelow (Set.range u)) (h : ∀ m ≥ n, u m ≤ v m) :
    tailInf u n ≤ tailInf v n := by
  simpa using tailInf_le_add hu (δ := 0) (by simpa using h)

lemma tailSup_lipschitz {u v : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} {δ : ℝ}
    (hu : BddAbove (Set.range u)) (hv : BddAbove (Set.range v))
    (h : ∀ m ≥ n, |u m - v m| ≤ δ) : |tailSup u n - tailSup v n| ≤ δ := by
  have hle : ∀ m ≥ n, u m ≤ v m + δ := by
    intro m hm
    have hh := (abs_le.mp (h m hm)).2
    linarith
  have hge : ∀ m ≥ n, v m ≤ u m + δ := by
    intro m hm
    have hh := (abs_le.mp (h m hm)).1
    linarith
  have h1 := tailSup_le_add hv hle
  have h2 := tailSup_le_add hu hge
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

lemma tailInf_lipschitz {u v : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} {δ : ℝ}
    (hu : BddBelow (Set.range u)) (hv : BddBelow (Set.range v))
    (h : ∀ m ≥ n, |u m - v m| ≤ δ) : |tailInf u n - tailInf v n| ≤ δ := by
  have hle : ∀ m ≥ n, u m ≤ v m + δ := by
    intro m hm
    have hh := (abs_le.mp (h m hm)).2
    linarith
  have hge : ∀ m ≥ n, v m ≤ u m + δ := by
    intro m hm
    have hh := (abs_le.mp (h m hm)).1
    linarith
  have h1 := tailInf_le_add hu hle
  have h2 := tailInf_le_add hv hge
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

lemma tailSup_neg (u : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : tailSup (-u) n = -tailInf u n := by
  open scoped Pointwise in
    have heq : (-u) '' Ici n = -(u '' Ici n) := by
      ext x
      simp [neg_eq_iff_eq_neg]
  unfold tailSup tailInf
  rw [heq, Real.sSup_neg]

lemma tailInf_neg (u : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : tailInf (-u) n = -tailSup u n := by
  open scoped Pointwise in
    have heq : (-u) '' Ici n = -(u '' Ici n) := by
      ext x
      simp [neg_eq_iff_eq_neg]
  unfold tailSup tailInf
  rw [heq, Real.sInf_neg]

/-- The block-density difference d_m^T(X). -/
noncomputable def dProbe (T X : Set E0) (m : ℕ) : ℝ := density X m - density T m

/-- The finite-prefix count difference p_n^T(X). -/
noncomputable def pProbe (T X : Set E0) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (traceFinset (blockPrefix n) X).card - ((traceFinset (blockPrefix n) T).card : ℝ)

noncomputable def fProbe (T : Set E0) (n : ℕ) (X : Set E0) : ℝ :=
  pProbe T X n + (blockPrefix n).card * (tailSup (dProbe T X) n + tailInf (dProbe T X) n)

lemma dProbe_bounds (T X : Set E0) (m : ℕ) : -1 ≤ dProbe T X m ∧ dProbe T X m ≤ 1 := by
  have hX0 := finiteDensity_nonneg (wBlock m) X
  have hX1 := finiteDensity_le_one (wBlock m) X
  have hT0 := finiteDensity_nonneg (wBlock m) T
  have hT1 := finiteDensity_le_one (wBlock m) T
  dsimp [dProbe, density]
  constructor <;> linarith

lemma dProbe_bddAbove (T X : Set E0) : BddAbove (Set.range (dProbe T X)) := by
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  rintro x ⟨m, rfl⟩
  exact (dProbe_bounds T X m).2

lemma dProbe_bddBelow (T X : Set E0) : BddBelow (Set.range (dProbe T X)) := by
  refine ⟨-1, ?_⟩
  rintro x ⟨m, rfl⟩
  exact (dProbe_bounds T X m).1

lemma dProbe_mono (T : Set E0) {X Y : Set E0} (h : X ⊆ Y) (m : ℕ) :
    dProbe T X m ≤ dProbe T Y m := sub_le_sub_right (finiteDensity_mono _ h) _

lemma pProbe_mono (T : Set E0) {X Y : Set E0} (h : X ⊆ Y) (n : ℕ) :
    pProbe T X n ≤ pProbe T Y n := by
  classical
  apply sub_le_sub_right
  exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (traceFinset_mono (blockPrefix n) h)

lemma fProbe_mono (T : Set E0) {X Y : Set E0} (h : X ⊆ Y) (n : ℕ) :
    fProbe T n X ≤ fProbe T n Y := by
  apply add_le_add (pProbe_mono T h n)
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
  exact add_le_add (tailSup_mono (dProbe_bddAbove T Y) (fun m _ ↦ dProbe_mono T h m))
    (tailInf_mono (dProbe_bddBelow T X) (fun m _ ↦ dProbe_mono T h m))

lemma traceFinset_insert {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) (X : Set α)
    (e : α) (he : e ∈ s) : traceFinset s (insert e X) = insert e (traceFinset s X) := by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_traceFinset, Set.mem_insert_iff, Finset.mem_insert]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxs, rfl | hx⟩
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hxs, hx⟩
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨hxs, hx⟩)
    · exact ⟨he, Or.inl rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨hxs, Or.inr hx⟩

lemma traceFinset_insert_of_notMem {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (X : Set α)
    (e : α) (he : e ∉ s) : traceFinset s (insert e X) = traceFinset s X := by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_traceFinset, Set.mem_insert_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxs, rfl | hx⟩
    · exact (he hxs).elim
    · exact ⟨hxs, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨hxs, hx⟩
    exact ⟨hxs, Or.inr hx⟩

lemma traceFinset_of_agree {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) {X Y : Set α}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, (x ∈ X ↔ x ∈ Y)) : traceFinset s X = traceFinset s Y := by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_traceFinset]
  exact and_congr_right (h x)

lemma trace_card_insert_le {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (X : Set α) (e : α) :
    (traceFinset s (insert e X)).card ≤ (traceFinset s X).card + 1 := by
  classical
  by_cases he : e ∈ s
  · rw [traceFinset_insert s X e he]
    exact Finset.card_insert_le _ _
  · rw [traceFinset_insert_of_notMem s X e he]
    omega

lemma finiteDensity_insert_le {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (X : Set α) (e : α) :
    finiteDensity s (insert e X) ≤ finiteDensity s X + 1 / s.card := by
  rw [finiteDensity, finiteDensity, ← add_div]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
  exact_mod_cast trace_card_insert_le s X e

lemma fProbe_insert_le (T X : Set E0) (e : E0) (n : ℕ) :
    fProbe T n (insert e X) ≤ fProbe T n X + 1 := by
  classical
  by_cases hen : e.1.1 < n
  · have ht : dProbe T (insert e X) '' Ici n = dProbe T X '' Ici n := by
      apply Set.image_congr
      intro m hm
      change n ≤ m at hm
      have he : e ∉ wBlock m := by simp only [mem_wBlock]; omega
      simp [dProbe, density, finiteDensity, traceFinset_insert_of_notMem _ _ _ he]
    have hp : pProbe T (insert e X) n ≤ pProbe T X n + 1 := by
      dsimp [pProbe]
      have hc : ((traceFinset (blockPrefix n) (insert e X)).card : ℝ) ≤
          (traceFinset (blockPrefix n) X).card + 1 := by
        exact_mod_cast trace_card_insert_le (blockPrefix n) X e
      linarith
    dsimp [fProbe, tailSup, tailInf]
    rw [ht]
    linarith
  · have hp : pProbe T (insert e X) n = pProbe T X n := by
      simp [pProbe, traceFinset_insert_of_notMem _ _ _ ((mem_prefix e n).not.mpr hen)]
    have hd : ∀ m ≥ n, dProbe T (insert e X) m ≤
        dProbe T X m + 1 / (wBlock e.1.1).card := by
      intro m hm
      by_cases hem : e.1.1 = m
      · subst m
        dsimp [dProbe, density]
        linarith [finiteDensity_insert_le (wBlock e.1.1) X e]
      · have he : e ∉ wBlock m := (mem_wBlock e m).not.mpr hem
        dsimp [dProbe, density, finiteDensity]
        rw [traceFinset_insert_of_notMem _ _ _ he]
        have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (wBlock e.1.1).card := by positivity
        linarith
    have hs := tailSup_le_add (dProbe_bddAbove T X) hd

lower endpoint or by the finite prefix. -/
def deletePrefix (I X : Set ℕ) (m k : ℕ) : Set ℕ :=
  {x | x ∈ X ∧ (x ∈ I ∨ x < m ∨ k ≤ x)}

lemma deletePrefix_zero (I X : Set ℕ) (m : ℕ) : deletePrefix I X m 0 = X := by
  ext x
  simp [deletePrefix]

lemma subset_deletePrefix {I X : Set ℕ} (hIX : I ⊆ X) (m k : ℕ) :
    I ⊆ deletePrefix I X m k := by
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨hIX hx, Or.inl hx⟩

    deletePrefix I X m k ⊆ X := fun _ h ↦ h.1

    Antitone (deletePrefix I X m) := by
  intro a b hab x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨hx, hi | hm | hb⟩
  · exact ⟨hx, Or.inl hi⟩
  · exact ⟨hx, Or.inr (Or.inl hm)⟩
  · exact ⟨hx, Or.inr (Or.inr (hab.trans hb))⟩

lemma deletePrefix_agree (I X : Set ℕ) (m k : ℕ) :

  intro x hx
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h, Or.inr (Or.inl hx)⟩, fun h ↦ h.1⟩

lemma deletePrefix_step (I X : Set ℕ) (m k : ℕ) :
    deletePrefix I X m k ⊆ insert k (deletePrefix I X m (k+1)) := by
  intro x hx
  by_cases h : x = k
  · exact Or.inl h
  · right
    refine ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩
    rcases hx.2 with hi | hm | hk
    · exact Or.inl hi
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hm)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by omega))

lemma deletePrefix_finite (I X : Set ℕ) (m k : ℕ) :

  by_contra hn
  exact hx.2 ⟨hx.1, Or.inr (Or.inr (by omega))⟩

/-- Two subsets of ℕ agree on the first `m` labels. -/
def AgreeBelow (X Y : Set ℕ) (m : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x < m, (x ∈ X ↔ x ∈ Y)

def CylinderContinuous (f : ℕ → Set ℕ → ℝ) (I Y : Set ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ε, 0 < ε → ∃ m, ∀ X Z,
    I ⊆ X → X ⊆ Y → I ⊆ Z → Z ⊆ Y → AgreeBelow X Z m →
    ∀ n < j, |f n X - f n Z| < ε

/-- Delete, in the usual order of ℕ, the labels not reserved by the
lower endpoint or by the finite prefix. -/
def deletePrefix (I X : Set ℕ) (m k : ℕ) : Set ℕ :=
  {x | x ∈ X ∧ (x ∈ I ∨ x < m ∨ k ≤ x)}

lemma deletePrefix_zero (I X : Set ℕ) (m : ℕ) : deletePrefix I X m 0 = X := by
  ext x
  simp [deletePrefix]

lemma subset_deletePrefix {I X : Set ℕ} (hIX : I ⊆ X) (m k : ℕ) :
    I ⊆ deletePrefix I X m k := by
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨hIX hx, Or.inl hx⟩

lemma deletePrefix_subset (I X : Set ℕ) (m k : ℕ) :
    deletePrefix I X m k ⊆ X := fun _ h ↦ h.1

lemma deletePrefix_antitone (I X : Set ℕ) (m : ℕ) :
    Antitone (deletePrefix I X m) := by
  intro a b hab x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨hx, hi | hm | hb⟩
  · exact ⟨hx, Or.inl hi⟩
  · exact ⟨hx, Or.inr (Or.inl hm)⟩
  · exact ⟨hx, Or.inr (Or.inr (hab.trans hb))⟩

lemma deletePrefix_agree (I X : Set ℕ) (m k : ℕ) :
    AgreeBelow X (deletePrefix I X m k) m := by
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h, Or.inr (Or.inl hx)⟩, fun h ↦ h.1⟩

lemma deletePrefix_step (I X : Set ℕ) (m k : ℕ) :
    deletePrefix I X m k ⊆ insert k (deletePrefix I X m (k+1)) := by
  intro x hx
  by_cases h : x = k
  · exact Or.inl h
  · right
    refine ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩
    rcases hx.2 with hi | hm | hk
    · exact Or.inl hi
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hm)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by omega))

lemma deletePrefix_finite (I X : Set ℕ) (m k : ℕ) :
    (X \ deletePrefix I X m k).Finite := by
  apply (finite_Iio k).subset
  intro x hx
  simp only [mem_Iio]
  by_contra hn
  exact hx.2 ⟨hx.1, Or.inr (Or.inr (by omega))⟩

/-- The limit after every eligible label has been deleted. -/
def deleteTail (I X : Set ℕ) (m : ℕ) : Set ℕ :=
  {x | x ∈ X ∧ (x ∈ I ∨ x < m)}

lemma subset_deleteTail {I X : Set ℕ} (hIX : I ⊆ X) (m : ℕ) :
    I ⊆ deleteTail I X m := fun _ hx ↦ ⟨hIX hx, Or.inl hx⟩

lemma deleteTail_subset (I X : Set ℕ) (m : ℕ) :
    deleteTail I X m ⊆ X := fun _ h ↦ h.1

lemma deleteTail_finite (I X : Set ℕ) (m : ℕ) :
    (deleteTail I X m \ I).Finite := by
  apply (finite_Iio m).subset
  intro x hx
  exact hx.1.2.resolve_left hx.2

lemma deletePrefix_agree_tail (I X : Set ℕ) (m k : ℕ) :
    AgreeBelow (deletePrefix I X m k) (deleteTail I X m) k := by
  intro x hx
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hX, hi | hm | hk⟩
    · exact ⟨hX, Or.inl hi⟩
    · exact ⟨hX, Or.inr hm⟩
    · omega
  · rintro ⟨hX, hi | hm⟩
    · exact ⟨hX, Or.inl hi⟩
    · exact ⟨hX, Or.inr (Or.inl hm)⟩

/-- One stage of the infinite-endpoint interpolation: the stopping time
is finite, all late probes are reset above -1, and earlier probes lose
less than the prescribed tolerance. -/
lemma deletion_stage
    {f : ℕ → Set ℕ → ℝ} {I Y X : Set ℕ}
    (hcc : CylinderContinuous f I Y)
    (hone : ∀ n A B, I ⊆ A → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ Y →
      (∃ e, B ⊆ insert e A) → f n B ≤ f n A + 1)
    (hlow : ∀ Z, I ⊆ Z → Z ⊆ Y → (Z \ I).Finite →
      ∀ j, ∃ n ≥ j, f n Z < 0)
    (hIX : I ⊆ X) (hXY : X ⊆ Y) (j : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ Z, I ⊆ Z ∧ Z ⊆ X ∧ (X \ Z).Finite ∧
      (∃ n ≥ j, f n Z ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ n < j, |f n X - f n Z| < ε) ∧
      (Z = X ∨ ∀ n ≥ j, -1 ≤ f n Z) := by
  classical
  by_cases hex : ∃ n ≥ j, f n X ≤ 0
  · refine ⟨X, hIX, Subset.rfl, ?_, hex, ?_, Or.inl rfl⟩
    · simp
    · intro n hn
      simpa using hε
  have hpos : ∀ n ≥ j, 0 < f n X := by
    intro n hn
    exact lt_of_not_ge (fun h ↦ hex ⟨n, hn, h⟩)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hcc j ε hε
  let T := deleteTail I X m
  have hIT : I ⊆ T := subset_deleteTail hIX m
  have hTY : T ⊆ Y := (deleteTail_subset I X m).trans hXY
  obtain ⟨n, hnj, hn⟩ := hlow T hIT hTY (deleteTail_finite I X m) j
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hcc (n+1) (-f n T) (neg_pos.mpr hn)
  have happrox := hk (deletePrefix I X m k) T (subset_deletePrefix hIX m k)
    ((deletePrefix_subset I X m k).trans hXY) hIT hTY
    (deletePrefix_agree_tail I X m k) n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
  have hstop : ∃ k, ∃ n ≥ j, f n (deletePrefix I X m k) ≤ 0 := by
    refine ⟨k, n, hnj, ?_⟩
    have := (abs_lt.mp happrox).2
    linarith
  let k := Nat.find hstop
  have hkstop : ∃ n ≥ j, f n (deletePrefix I X m k) ≤ 0 := Nat.find_spec hstop
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
    intro hk0
    obtain ⟨n, hnj, hn⟩ := hkstop
    rw [hk0, deletePrefix_zero] at hn
    exact (hpos n hnj).not_ge hn
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hk0
  have hprev : ∀ n ≥ j, 0 < f n (deletePrefix I X m r) := by
    intro n hnj
    apply lt_of_not_ge
    intro hn
    have hrk : r < k := by omega
    exact Nat.find_min hstop hrk ⟨n, hnj, hn⟩
  refine ⟨deletePrefix I X m k, subset_deletePrefix hIX m k,
    deletePrefix_subset I X m k, deletePrefix_finite I X m k, hkstop, ?_, Or.inr ?_⟩
  · exact hm X (deletePrefix I X m k) hIX hXY (subset_deletePrefix hIX m k)
      ((deletePrefix_subset I X m k).trans hXY) (deletePrefix_agree I X m k)
  · intro n hnj
    have h1 := hone n (deletePrefix I X m (r+1)) (deletePrefix I X m r)
      (subset_deletePrefix hIX m (r+1))
      (deletePrefix_antitone I X m (Nat.le_succ r))
      ((deletePrefix_subset I X m r).trans hXY)
      ⟨r, deletePrefix_step I X m r⟩
    rw [hr]
    have := hprev n hnj
    linarith

lemma antitone_agree_iInter {X : ℕ → Set ℕ} (hX : Antitone X) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ k, ∀ l ≥ k, AgreeBelow (X l) (⋂ j, X j) m := by
  classical
  induction m with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, fun _ _ _ hx ↦ by omega⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih
    by_cases hm : m ∈ ⋂ j, X j
    · refine ⟨k, fun l hl x hx ↦ ?_⟩
      by_cases hxm : x < m
      · exact hk l hl x hxm
      · have hxm : x = m := by omega
        subst x
        exact ⟨fun _ ↦ hm, fun _ ↦ mem_iInter.mp hm l⟩
    · simp only [mem_iInter, not_forall] at hm
      obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := hm
      refine ⟨max k k', fun l hl x hx ↦ ?_⟩
      by_cases hxm : x < m
      · exact hk l ((le_max_left _ _).trans hl) x hxm
      · have hxm : x = m := by omega
        subst x
        have hml : m ∉ X l := fun h ↦ hk' (hX ((le_max_right _ _).trans hl) h)
        exact ⟨fun h ↦ (hml h).elim, fun h ↦ mem_iInter.mp h l⟩

lemma CylinderContinuous.tendsto_iInter {f : ℕ → Set ℕ → ℝ} {I Y : Set ℕ}

lemma exists_strictMono_choice (P : ℕ → ℕ → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ j M, ∃ m, M ≤ m ∧ P j m) :
    ∃ m : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono m ∧ ∀ j, P j (m j) := by
  classical
  choose pick hpick using hP
  let m : ℕ → ℕ := Nat.rec (pick 0 0) (fun j prev ↦ pick (j+1) (prev+1))
  have he0 : m 0 = pick 0 0 := rfl
  have hes (j : ℕ) : m (j+1) = pick (j+1) (m j+1) := rfl
  refine ⟨m, strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ (fun j ↦ ?_), ?_⟩
  · rw [hes]
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self _) (hpick (j+1) (m j+1)).1
  · intro j
    cases j with
    | zero => exact (hpick 0 0).2

/-- Polynomial encoding preserves the independent factor permutations of each row. -/
theorem polynomial_row_permute {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] {r b : ℕ}
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) b V) (e : κ → V)
    (l : Fin (r+1) × Fin b → Block r)
    (σ : Fin (r+1) → Equiv.Perm (Fin b)) :
    multilinearPolynomial (flattenedSymmetricForm T) e
        (fun p => l (p.1, σ p.1 p.2)) =
      multilinearPolynomial (flattenedSymmetricForm T) e l := by
  apply MvPolynomial.funext
  intro z
  simp only [eval_multilinearPolynomial]
  exact flattenedSymmetricForm_inner_permute T σ
    (fun p => ∑ j : κ, z (l p,j) • e j)

/-- A single unfinished row can be recovered from its one-step progressed state. -/
theorem polynomial_step {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] {r b : ℕ}
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) b V) (e : κ → V)
    (hb : r * (r+1) ≤ b) (k : Fin r → ℕ) (hk : ∀ j, k j ≤ r)
    (i : Fin r) (hi : k i < r)
    (hnext : multilinearPolynomial (flattenedSymmetricForm T) e
      (label (Function.update k i (k i+1))) = 0) :
    multilinearPolynomial (flattenedSymmetricForm T) e (label k) = 0 := by
  classical
  apply multilinearPolynomial_eq_zero_of_replacements
    (flattenedSymmetricForm T) e (label k) (some i.succ) none (by simp)
  · have hd := destination_occurrences_lt_source (b := b) k hb hk i hi
    simpa only [Finset.card_filter] using hd
  · rintro ⟨row,j⟩ hp
    obtain ⟨hrow,hj⟩ := (label_eq_source_iff k i (row,j)).mp hp
    change row = i.succ at hrow
    change k i ≤ j.val at hj
    subst row
    have hrb : r ≤ b := by nlinarith
    have hki : k i < b := lt_of_lt_of_le hi hrb
    have heq := invariant_update_label_eq_progress
      (fun l => multilinearPolynomial (flattenedSymmetricForm T) e l)
      (polynomial_row_permute T e) k i hki j hj
    exact heq.trans hnext

theorem multilinearPolynomial_eq_slotPolynomial
    {S K B V : Type*} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] [Fintype K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (T : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : S => V) ℂ) (e : K → V) (l : S → B) :

private theorem swap_pair_same_row {A B : Type*} [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B]
    (i : A) (j k : B) (p : A × B) :
    Equiv.swap (i, j) (i, k) p =
      (p.1, if p.1 = i then Equiv.swap j k p.2 else p.2) := by
  rcases p with ⟨q, t⟩
  by_cases hq : q = i
  · subst q
    by_cases htj : t = j
    · subst t
      simp
    · by_cases htk : t = k
      · subst t
        simp
      · simp [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne, htj, htk]
  · have h1 : (q,t) ≠ (i,j) := by intro h; exact hq (congrArg Prod.fst h)
    have h2 : (q,t) ≠ (i,k) := by intro h; exact hq (congrArg Prod.fst h)
    simp [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h1 h2, hq]

/-- The flattened form is invariant under swapping two factors in a single row. -/
theorem flattenedForm_swap_row (a b : ℕ) (V : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (i : Fin a) (j k : Fin b) (x : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedForm T (x ∘ Equiv.swap (i,j) (i,k)) =
      flattenedForm T x := by
  classical
  have h := flattenedForm_factor_perm T
    (fun q => if q = i then Equiv.swap j k else Equiv.refl _) x
  convert h using 1
  congr 1
  funext p
  rw [Function.comp_apply, swap_pair_same_row]
  by_cases hp : p.1 = i <;> simp [hp]

/-- If the source label occurs only in one row, every occurrence gives the same
coordinate-polynomial derivative term, by symmetry of factors in that row. -/
theorem flattened_derivative_eq_card_smul
    (a b : ℕ) (V K B : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq B]
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V) (e : K → V)
    (l : Fin a × Fin b → B) (src dst : B) (i : Fin a) (j : Fin b)
    (hj : l (i,j) = src)
    (hrow : ∀ p, l p = src → p.1 = i)
    (D : Derivation ℂ (MvPolynomial (B × K) ℂ) (MvPolynomial (B × K) ℂ))
    (hD : ∀ q k, D (MvPolynomial.X (q,k)) =
      if q = src then MvPolynomial.X (dst,k) else 0) :
    D (multilinearPolynomial (flattenedForm T) e l) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => l p = src)).card •
        multilinearPolynomial (flattenedForm T) e
          (Function.update l (i,j) dst) := by
  classical
  let c : ((Fin a × Fin b) → K) → ℂ :=
    fun k => flattenedForm T (fun p => e (k p))
  have hc : ∀ p, l p = src → ∀ k, c (k ∘ Equiv.swap p (i,j)) = c k := by
    intro p hp k
    rcases p with ⟨q,t⟩
    have hq := hrow (q,t) hp
    dsimp at hq
    subst q
    exact flattenedForm_swap_row a b V T i t j (fun p => e (k p))
  have h := SlotPolynomial.derivation_polynomial_eq_card_smul
    c l src dst (i,j) hj D hD hc
  rw [multilinearPolynomial_eq_slotPolynomial, multilinearPolynomial_eq_slotPolynomial]
  exact h

noncomputable def cellRows {α β : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (r : α → Equiv.Perm β) (b : β × β) : Finset α :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun i => r i b.1 = b.2)

noncomputable def clumpCount {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (H : ℝ) (r : α → Equiv.Perm β) : ℕ :=
  ∑ b : β × β, if H < (cellRows r b).card then (cellRows r b).card else 0

lemma protected_mass_le {A D : ℕ} (a : Grid A D) (ha : Compatible a.1 a.2)
    (j k : Fin D) (B : Law (Fin A)) (b : ℝ) (hb : ∀ w, B.mass w ≤ b) :
    B.prob (fun w => columnFor a ha j w = k) ≤ (cellRows a.1 (j,k)).card * b := by
  have he : B.prob (fun w => columnFor a ha j w = k) =
      ∑ h ∈ cellRows a.1 (j,k), B.mass (outputEquiv a ha j h) := by
    unfold Law.prob
    rw [cellRows, Finset.sum_filter]
    symm
    apply Fintype.sum_equiv (outputEquiv a ha j)
    intro h
    simp only [columnFor_output]
    by_cases hh : a.1 h j = k <;> simp [hh]
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _h ∈ cellRows a.1 (j,k), b := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun h _ => hb _)
    _ = _ := by simp

lemma light_restrict_mass_le {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (P : Law α) {b : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hL : 1/2 ≤ P.prob (fun w => P.mass w ≤ b)) (w : α) :
    (P.restrict (fun w => P.mass w ≤ b)).mass w ≤ 2 * b := by
  have hp : 0 < P.prob (fun w => P.mass w ≤ b) := by linarith
  rw [P.restrict_mass _ hp]
  split_ifs with hw
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hp).mpr
    nlinarith
  · simp [mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2) hb]

noncomputable def entryClumpSize {A D : ℕ} (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) (a : Grid A D) : ℕ :=
  (cellRows a.1 ((a.1 i).symm k, k)).card

noncomputable def exposureError (A D : ℕ) (H K : ℝ) (i : Fin A) : ℝ :=
  (1 + Real.log (D : ℝ)) / D +
    (2 * K * H / ((A - (i : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (1 + Real.log (D : ℝ))

lemma exposureError_nonneg {A D : ℕ} (hD : 1 ≤ D) {H K : ℝ} (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (i : Fin A) : 0 ≤ exposureError A D H K i := by
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log (D : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hD)
  unfold exposureError
  positivity

noncomputable def clumpWeight {α : Type*} (H z : ℝ) (s : Finset α) : ℝ :=
  if s = ∅ then 1 else if H < s.card then Real.exp (z * s.card) else 0

lemma clumpWeight_nonneg {α : Type*} (H z : ℝ) (s : Finset α) :
    0 ≤ clumpWeight H z s := by
  unfold clumpWeight
  split_ifs <;> positivity

lemma cell_clump_exp_le {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (H z : ℝ) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (r : α → Equiv.Perm β) (b : β × β) :
    Real.exp (z * (if H < (cellRows r b).card then ((cellRows r b).card : ℝ) else 0)) ≤
      ∑ s : Finset α, clumpWeight H z s *
        (if ∀ i ∈ s, r i b.1 = b.2 then 1 else 0) := by
  let W : Finset α → ℝ := fun s => clumpWeight H z s *
    (if ∀ i ∈ s, r i b.1 = b.2 then 1 else 0)
  change Real.exp _ ≤ ∑ s, W s
  have hW (s : Finset α) : 0 ≤ W s :=
    mul_nonneg (clumpWeight_nonneg _ _ _) (by split_ifs <;> norm_num)
  by_cases h : H < (cellRows r b).card
  · have hs : cellRows r b ≠ ∅ := by
      intro he
      simp [he] at h
      linarith
    have hp : ∀ i ∈ cellRows r b, r i b.1 = b.2 := by
      intro i hi
      simpa only [cellRows, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using hi
    calc
      _ = W (cellRows r b) := by
        dsimp [W]
        rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left hp]
        simp [clumpWeight, hs, h]
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.single_le_sum (fun s _ => hW s) (Finset.mem_univ _)
  · calc
      _ = W ∅ := by
        dsimp [W]
        simp [clumpWeight, h]
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.single_le_sum (fun s _ => hW s) (Finset.mem_univ _)

lemma clump_expansion {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (H z : ℝ) (r : α → Equiv.Perm β) :
    (∏ b : β × β, ∑ s : Finset α, clumpWeight H z s *
      (if ∀ i ∈ s, r i b.1 = b.2 then 1 else 0)) =
    ∑ S : β × β → Finset α, (∏ b, clumpWeight H z (S b)) *
      (if MeetsLists S r then 1 else 0) := by
  rw [Fintype.prod_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro S _
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_boole]
  have hiff : (∀ b : β × β, ∀ i ∈ S b, r i b.1 = b.2) ↔ MeetsLists S r := by
    simp [MeetsLists, Prod.forall]
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, forall_const]
  by_cases h : MeetsLists S r
  · rw [ite_eq_left (hiff.mpr h), ite_eq_left h]
  · rw [ite_eq_right (fun hh => h (hiff.mp hh)), ite_eq_right h]

lemma cellRows_weight_sum {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (r : α → Equiv.Perm β) (v : β × β → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : α, ∑ j : β, v (j, r i j)) =
      ∑ b : β × β, (cellRows r b).card * v b := by
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  calc
    _ = ∑ i : α, ∑ k : β, if r i j = k then v (j,k) else 0 := by simp
    _ = ∑ k : β, ∑ i : α, if r i j = k then v (j,k) else 0 := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      have he : (∑ i : α, if r i j = k then v (j,k) else 0) =
          ∑ _i ∈ cellRows r (j,k), v (j,k) := by
        rw [cellRows, Finset.sum_filter]
      rw [he]
      simp

lemma clumpCount_eq_entries {A D : ℕ} (K : ℝ) (a : Grid A D) :
    (∑ k : Fin D, ∑ i : Fin A, if K < (entryClumpSize k i a : ℝ) then 1 else 0) =
      (clumpCount K a.1 : ℝ) := by
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have he (i : Fin A) :
      (∑ k : Fin D, if K < (entryClumpSize k i a : ℝ) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      ∑ j : Fin D, if K < ((cellRows a.1 (j, a.1 i j)).card : ℝ) then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    apply Fintype.sum_equiv (a.1 i).symm
    intro k
    simp only [entryClumpSize, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    by_cases hk : K < ((cellRows a.1 ((a.1 i).symm k, k)).card : ℝ) <;> simp [hk]
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [cellRows_weight_sum a.1
    (fun b => if K < ((cellRows a.1 b).card : ℝ) then (1 : ℝ) else 0)]
  unfold clumpCount
  push_cast
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  split_ifs <;> simp

lemma mean_clumpCount_eq_entries {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (K : ℝ) :
    (∑ k : Fin D, ∑ i : Fin A,
      Q.mean (fun a => if K < (entryClumpSize k i a : ℝ) then 1 else 0)) =
      Q.mean (fun a => (clumpCount K a.1 : ℝ)) := by
  rw [show Q.mean (fun a => (clumpCount K a.1 : ℝ)) =
      Q.mean (fun a => ∑ k : Fin D, ∑ i : Fin A,
        if K < (entryClumpSize k i a : ℝ) then 1 else 0) by
    congr 1
    funext a
    exact (clumpCount_eq_entries K a).symm]
  simp_rw [Law.mean_sum]

noncomputable def totalExposureError (A D : ℕ) (H K : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  A * (1 + Real.log (D : ℝ)) +
    2 * D * K * H * (1 + Real.log (D : ℝ)) * (harmonic A : ℝ)

lemma sum_exposureError {A D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (H K : ℝ) :
    (∑ _ : Fin D, ∑ i : Fin A, exposureError A D H K i) =
      totalExposureError A D H K := by
  have he (i : Fin A) : exposureError A D H K i =
      (1 + Real.log (D : ℝ)) / D +
      (2 * K * H * (1 + Real.log (D : ℝ))) * (1 / ((A - (i : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    unfold exposureError
    ring
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, sum_inv_sub]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  unfold totalExposureError
  have hD0 : (D : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hD)
  field_simp [hD0]

noncomputable def prob (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) : ℝ :=
  ∑ a, if S a then P.mass a else 0

lemma prob_nonneg (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) : 0 ≤ P.prob S := by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all [P.nonneg]

lemma prob_le_one (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) : P.prob S ≤ 1 := by
  rw [← P.total]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all [P.nonneg]

lemma prob_mono (P : Law α) {S T : α → Prop} (h : ∀ a, S a → T a) :
    P.prob S ≤ P.prob T := by
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro a _
  by_cases hs : S a
  · simp [hs, h a hs]
  · simp [hs]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all [P.nonneg]

lemma mass_le_prob (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) {a : α} (ha : S a) :
    P.mass a ≤ P.prob S := by
  have h := Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
    (f := fun b => if S b then P.mass b else 0)
    (fun b _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all [P.nonneg]) (Finset.mem_univ a)
  simpa [ha, prob] using h

lemma prob_not (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) : P.prob (fun a => ¬S a) = 1 - P.prob S := by
  have h : P.prob (fun a => ¬S a) + P.prob S = 1 := by
    rw [prob, prob, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← P.total]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    by_cases ha : S a <;> simp [ha]
  linarith

lemma prob_eq_mean (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) [DecidablePred S] :
    P.prob S = P.mean (fun a => if S a then 1 else 0) := by
  unfold prob mean
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  by_cases ha : S a <;> simp [ha]

noncomputable def lightRescale (P : Law α) (L S : α → Prop) : Law α :=
  if h : 0 < P.prob (fun a => L a ∧ S a) then {
    mass := fun a => (if L a ∧ S a then P.mass a else 0) *
      (P.prob L / P.prob (fun b => L b ∧ S b)) + (if ¬L a then P.mass a else 0)
    nonneg := fun a => add_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (by split_ifs <;> simp_all [P.nonneg])
        (div_nonneg (P.prob_nonneg L) h.le))
      (by split_ifs <;> simp_all [P.nonneg])
    total := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      have ha : (∑ a, if L a ∧ S a then P.mass a else 0) = P.prob (fun a => L a ∧ S a) := by
        unfold prob
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _
        by_cases ha : L a ∧ S a <;> simp [ha]
      have hb : (∑ a, if ¬L a then P.mass a else 0) = P.prob (fun a => ¬L a) := by
        unfold prob
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _
        by_cases ha : L a <;> simp [ha]
      rw [ha, hb, P.prob_not L]
      field_simp
      ring
  } else P

lemma lightRescale_mass_of_not (P : Law α) (L S : α → Prop) {a : α} (ha : ¬L a) :
    (P.lightRescale L S).mass a = P.mass a := by
  unfold lightRescale
  split_ifs <;> simp [ha]

lemma lightRescale_mass_of_mem (P : Law α) (L S : α → Prop) {a : α}
    (hp : 0 < P.mass a) (hL : L a) (hS : S a) :
    (P.lightRescale L S).mass a = P.mass a * P.prob L / P.prob (fun a => L a ∧ S a) := by
  have hA : 0 < P.prob (fun a => L a ∧ S a) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hp (P.mass_le_prob _ ⟨hL, hS⟩)
  simp [lightRescale, hA, hL, hS, mul_div_assoc]

lemma lightRescale_pos (P : Law α) (L S : α → Prop) {a : α}
    (hp : 0 < P.mass a) (hS : S a) : 0 < (P.lightRescale L S).mass a := by
  by_cases hL : L a
  · rw [P.lightRescale_mass_of_mem L S hp hL hS]
    exact div_pos (mul_pos hp (lt_of_lt_of_le hp (P.mass_le_prob L hL)))
      (lt_of_lt_of_le hp (P.mass_le_prob _ ⟨hL, hS⟩))
  · simpa [P.lightRescale_mass_of_not L S hL] using hp

lemma lightRescale_log (P : Law α) (L S : α → Prop) {a : α}
    (hp : 0 < P.mass a) (hS : S a) :
    Real.log ((P.lightRescale L S).mass a) = Real.log (P.mass a) -
      (if L a then Real.log (P.prob (fun b => L b ∧ S b) / P.prob L) else 0) := by
  by_cases hL : L a
  · have hA : 0 < P.prob (fun b => L b ∧ S b) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hp (P.mass_le_prob _ ⟨hL, hS⟩)
    have hB : 0 < P.prob L := lt_of_lt_of_le hp (P.mass_le_prob L hL)
    rw [P.lightRescale_mass_of_mem L S hp hL hS, ite_eq_left hL,
      Real.log_div (mul_pos hp hB).ne' hA.ne', Real.log_mul hp.ne' hB.ne',
      Real.log_div hA.ne' hB.ne']
    ring
  · rw [P.lightRescale_mass_of_not L S hL, ite_eq_right hL, sub_zero]

lemma light_cost_nonneg (P : Law α) (L S : α → Prop) :
    0 ≤ -Real.log (P.prob (fun b => L b ∧ S b) / P.prob L) := by
  apply neg_nonneg.mpr
  apply Real.log_nonpos (div_nonneg (P.prob_nonneg _) (P.prob_nonneg _))
  by_cases hL : P.prob L = 0
  · simp [hL]
  · exact (div_le_one (lt_of_le_of_ne (P.prob_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hL))).mpr
      (P.prob_mono fun _ h => h.1)

def MeetsLists {α β : Type*} (S : β × β → Finset α) (r : α → Equiv.Perm β) : Prop :=
  ∀ j k i, i ∈ S (j, k) → r i j = k

lemma lists_incidence_count {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]

    (S : β × β → Finset α) (r : α → Equiv.Perm β) (hr : MeetsLists S r) :
    ∑ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => i ∈ S (j, r i j))).card =
      ∑ b, (S b).card := by
  have hk (i : α) (j k : β) : i ∈ S (j, k) ↔ k = r i j ∧ i ∈ S (j, r i j) := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨(hr j k i h).symm, by simpa [hr j k i h] using h⟩
    · rintro ⟨rfl, h⟩
      exact h
  have hc (s : Finset α) : s.card = ∑ i, if i ∈ s then 1 else 0 := by simp
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, if i ∈ S (j, k) then 1 else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [Finset.card_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      symm
      calc
        _ = ∑ k, if k = r i j then (if i ∈ S (j, r i j) then 1 else 0) else 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro k _
          by_cases he : k = r i j
          · subst k
            simp
          · have hmem : i ∉ S (j, k) := fun h => he (hr j k i h).symm
            simp [he, hmem]
        _ = _ := by simp
    _ = ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ i, if i ∈ S (j, k) then 1 else 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ = _ := by simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, hc]

section BraidAlgebra

variable {G : Type*} [Group G]

/-- The length-three and distant commutation relations on m successive letters.
The letters are zero-indexed here. -/
def BraidRelations (m : ℕ) (s : ℕ → G) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, i + 1 < m → s i * s (i+1) * s i = s (i+1) * s i * s (i+1)) ∧
  (∀ i j, i < m → j < m → i + 2 ≤ j → Commute (s i) (s j))

def braidLoop (s : ℕ → G) : ℕ → G
  | 0 => 1
  | n+1 => s n * braidLoop s n * s n

def braidCenter (s : ℕ → G) : ℕ → G
  | 0 => 1
  | n+1 => braidCenter s n * braidLoop s (n+1)

def braidDelta (s : ℕ → G) : ℕ → G
  | 0 => 1
  | n+1 => braidDelta s n * s n

lemma commute_braidLoop {g : G} {s : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ i < n, Commute g (s i)) : Commute g (braidLoop s n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Commute.one_right g
  | succ n ih =>
    exact ((hc n (by omega)).mul_right (ih (fun i hi => hc i (by omega)))).mul_right
      (hc n (by omega))

lemma commute_braidCenter {g : G} {s : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ i < n, Commute g (s i)) : Commute g (braidCenter s n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Commute.one_right g
  | succ n ih =>
    exact (ih (fun i hi => hc i (by omega))).mul_right (commute_braidLoop hc)

lemma commute_braidDelta {g : G} {s : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ i < n, Commute g (s i)) : Commute g (braidDelta s n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Commute.one_right g
  | succ n ih =>
    exact (ih (fun i hi => hc i (by omega))).mul_right (hc n (by omega))

lemma braid_loop_step {a b C : G} (hab : a*b*a = b*a*b) (hbC : Commute b C) :
    Commute a (b * (a*C*a) * b) := by
  change a * (b * (a*C*a) * b) = b * (a*C*a) * b * a
  calc
    a * (b * (a*C*a) * b) = (a*b*a)*C*a*b := by group
    _ = (b*a*b)*C*a*b := by rw [hab]
    _ = b*a*(b*C)*a*b := by group
    _ = b*a*(C*b)*a*b := by rw [hbC.eq]
    _ = b*a*C*(b*a*b) := by group
    _ = b*a*C*(a*b*a) := by rw [← hab]
    _ = b * (a*C*a) * b * a := by group

lemma braidLoop_commute {s : ℕ → G} {m : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s)
    {n i : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ m) (hi : i + 1 < n) : Commute (s i) (braidLoop s n) := by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => omega
  | one => omega
  | more k ih₀ ih₁ =>
    by_cases h : i + 1 < k+1
    · exact ((hs.2 i (k+1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)).mul_right
        (ih₁ (by omega) h)).mul_right (hs.2 i (k+1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega))
    · have he : i = k := by omega
      subst i
      exact braid_loop_step (hs.1 k (by omega))
        (commute_braidLoop (fun j hj => (hs.2 j (k+1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)).symm))

lemma braidLoops_commute {s : ℕ → G} {m : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s)
    {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j ≤ k) (hk : k ≤ m) : Commute (braidLoop s j) (braidLoop s k) := by
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hjk with hlt | rfl
  · exact (commute_braidLoop (fun i hi => (braidLoop_commute hs hk (by omega)).symm)).symm
  · exact Commute.refl _

lemma braid_center_step {s L : G} (hc : Commute L (s*L*s)) :
    Commute s (L*(s*L*s)) := by
  change L*(s*L*s) = (s*L*s)*L at hc
  change s * (L * (s*L*s)) = L * (s*L*s) * s
  calc
    s * (L * (s*L*s)) = ((s*L*s)*L)*s := by group
    _ = (L*(s*L*s))*s := by rw [← hc]

lemma braidCenter_commute {s : ℕ → G} {m : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s)
    {n i : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ m) (hi : i < n) : Commute (s i) (braidCenter s n) := by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => omega
  | one =>
    have he : i = 0 := by omega
    subst i
    simp only [braidCenter, braidLoop, mul_one, one_mul]
    exact (Commute.refl _).mul_right (Commute.refl _)
  | more k ih₀ ih₁ =>
    by_cases h : i < k+1
    · exact (ih₁ (by omega) h).mul_right (braidLoop_commute hs hn (by omega))
    · have he : i = k+1 := by omega
      subst i
      have hpre : Commute (s (k+1)) (braidCenter s k) :=
        commute_braidCenter (fun j hj => (hs.2 j (k+1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)).symm)
      have hlast := braid_center_step (braidLoops_commute hs (j := k+1) (k := k+2) (by omega) hn)
      simpa only [braidCenter, braidLoop, mul_assoc] using hpre.mul_right hlast

lemma braidDelta_shift {s : ℕ → G} {m : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s)
    {n i : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ m) (hi : i + 1 < n) :
    braidDelta s n * s i = s (i+1) * braidDelta s n := by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => omega
  | one => omega
  | more k ih₀ ih₁ =>
    by_cases h : i+1 < k+1
    · rw [braidDelta, mul_assoc, ← (hs.2 i (k+1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)).eq,
        ← mul_assoc, ih₁ (by omega) h, mul_assoc]
    · have he : i = k := by omega
      subst i
      have hc : Commute (s (k+1)) (braidDelta s k) :=
        commute_braidDelta (fun j hj => (hs.2 j (k+1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)).symm)
      simp only [braidDelta]
      calc
        braidDelta s k * s k * s (k+1) * s k = braidDelta s k * (s k*s (k+1)*s k) := by group
        _ = braidDelta s k * (s (k+1)*s k*s (k+1)) := by rw [hs.1 k (by omega)]
        _ = (braidDelta s k * s (k+1)) * s k * s (k+1) := by group
        _ = (s (k+1) * braidDelta s k) * s k * s (k+1) := by rw [hc.symm.eq]
        _ = s (k+1) * (braidDelta s k * s k * s (k+1)) := by group

lemma braidDelta_conjugate {s : ℕ → G} {m : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i + 1 < m) :
    braidDelta s m * s i * (braidDelta s m)⁻¹ = s (i+1) := by
  rw [braidDelta_shift hs (le_refl m) hi]
  group

lemma braid_conjugate {a b : G} (h : a*b*a = b*a*b) : (a*b)*a*(a*b)⁻¹ = b := by
  rw [h]
  group

lemma braidCenter_two {s : ℕ → G} (h : s 0*s 1*s 0 = s 1*s 0*s 1) :
    braidCenter s 2 = (s 0*s 1)^3 := by
  simp only [braidCenter, braidLoop, mul_one, one_mul]
  calc
    s 0*s 0*(s 1*(s 0*s 0)*s 1) = s 0*(s 0*s 1*s 0)*s 0*s 1 := by group
    _ = s 0*(s 1*s 0*s 1)*s 0*s 1 := by rw [h]
    _ = (s 0*s 1)^3 := by simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero]; group

lemma braidLoop_congr {s t : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ} (he : ∀ i < n, s i = t i) :
    braidLoop s n = braidLoop t n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [braidLoop, he n (by omega), ih (fun i hi => he i (by omega))]

lemma braidCenter_congr {s t : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ} (he : ∀ i < n, s i = t i) :
    braidCenter s n = braidCenter t n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [braidCenter, braidLoop_congr he, ih (fun i hi => he i (by omega))]

lemma map_braidLoop {H : Type*} [Group H] (f : G →* H) (s : ℕ → G) (n : ℕ) :
    f (braidLoop s n) = braidLoop (fun i => f (s i)) n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact f.map_one
  | succ n ih => simp only [braidLoop, map_mul, ih]

lemma map_braidCenter {H : Type*} [Group H] (f : G →* H) (s : ℕ → G) (n : ℕ) :
    f (braidCenter s n) = braidCenter (fun i => f (s i)) n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact f.map_one
  | succ n ih => simp only [braidCenter, map_mul, map_braidLoop, ih]

lemma braidDelta_pow_conjugate {s : ℕ → G} {m : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s)
    {i k : ℕ} (hik : i+k < m) :
    (braidDelta s m)^k * s i * ((braidDelta s m)^k)⁻¹ = s (i+k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have hi := ih (by omega)
    calc
      (braidDelta s m)^(k+1) * s i * ((braidDelta s m)^(k+1))⁻¹ =
        braidDelta s m * ((braidDelta s m)^k * s i * ((braidDelta s m)^k)⁻¹) *
          (braidDelta s m)⁻¹ := by rw [pow_succ']; group
      _ = braidDelta s m * s (i+k) * (braidDelta s m)⁻¹ := by rw [hi]
      _ = s (i+(k+1)) := by simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using braidDelta_conjugate hs (by omega : i+k+1 < m)

lemma braidCenter_shift_conjugate {s : ℕ → G} {m : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s)
    {n k : ℕ} (hnk : n+k ≤ m) :
    (braidDelta s m)^k * braidCenter s n * ((braidDelta s m)^k)⁻¹ =
      braidCenter (fun i => s (i+k)) n := by
  let f : G →* G := (MulAut.conj ((braidDelta s m)^k)).toMonoidHom
  change f (braidCenter s n) = _
  rw [map_braidCenter]
  apply braidCenter_congr
  intro i hi
  exact braidDelta_pow_conjugate hs (by omega)

end BraidAlgebra

variable {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MetricSpace X] [MulAction G X]
  [ProperSpace X] [Nonempty X]

lemma lengthPairing_braid_equal (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {g a b : G} (hga : Commute g a) (hgb : Commute g b) (hab : a*b*a = b*a*b) :
    lengthPairing x g a = lengthPairing x g b := by
  have he : lengthPairing x g (a*b*a) = lengthPairing x g (b*a*b) := congrArg _ hab
  rw [lengthPairing_centralizer hG x (hga.mul_right hgb) hga,
    lengthPairing_centralizer hG x hga hgb,
    lengthPairing_centralizer hG x (hgb.mul_right hga) hgb,
    lengthPairing_centralizer hG x hgb hga] at he
  linarith

lemma lengthPairing_braid_constant (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {g : G} {s : ℕ → G} {m n : ℕ} (hs : BraidRelations m s) (hn : n ≤ m)
    (hc : ∀ i < n, Commute g (s i)) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < n) :
    lengthPairing x g (s i) = lengthPairing x g (s 0) := by
  induction i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [← lengthPairing_braid_equal hG x (hc i (by omega)) (hc (i+1) hi) (hs.1 i (by omega))]
    exact ih (by omega)

lemma lengthPairing_braidLoop (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)
    {g : G} {s : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ} {α : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i < n, Commute g (s i)) (he : ∀ i < n, lengthPairing x g (s i) = α) :
    lengthPairing x g (braidLoop s n) = 2 * (n : ℝ) * α := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [braidLoop, lengthPairing_one hG.2.1]
  | succ n ih =>

    {g : G} {s : ℕ → G} {n : ℕ} {α : ℝ}

lemma braidCenter_length_sq (hG : GeometricAction G X) (x : X)

    intro j hj

      lengthPairing_braid_constant hG x hs hn hc hi]

        (braidLoop_commute hs (by omega) (by omega)),

lemma rounded_edge_bound (y : X) (q : Vertex H N → X) (v : Vertex H N → G)
    {E B : ℝ} (hq : ∀ p, dist (q p) (v p•y)≤E)
    {p r : Vertex H N} (hpr : dist (q p) (q r)≤B) :
    dist (v p•y) (v r•y)≤B+2*E := by
  have hh := dist_triangle4 (v p•y) (q p) (q r) (v r•y)
  have hp := hq p
  rw [dist_comm] at hp
  linarith [hq r]

lemma cone_fill (hX : CAT0 X) (y : X) (base : G) (boundary : Fin N → G)
    {E A B R L : ℝ} (hE : 0≤E) (hA : 0≤A) (hB : 0≤B) (hL : 0≤L)
    (hdense : ∀ x, ∃ g : G, dist x (g•y)≤E)
    (hstep : ∀ i, dist (boundary i•y) (boundary (i+1)•y)≤A)
    (hspan : ∀ i, dist (base•y) (boundary i•y)≤(H+1:ℕ)*B)
    (hspan' : ∀ i, dist (base•y) (boundary i•y)≤L)
    (hbase : R≤dist y (base•y)) (hboundary : ∀ i, R≤dist y (boundary i•y)) :
    ∃ v : Vertex H N → G,
      (∀ i, v (Sum.inl (Fin.last (H+1),i)) = boundary i) ∧
      (∀ f k, dist (v (tail H N (f,k))•y) (v (tail H N (f,k+1))•y)≤A+B+4*E) ∧
      (∀ p, R-L/2-E≤dist y (v p•y)) := by
  choose round hround using hdense
  choose γ hγ using fun i => hX.1 (base•y) (boundary i•y)
  let v : Vertex H N → G := coneLabel base boundary γ round
  let q : Vertex H N → X := conePoint y base γ
  have hq : ∀ p, dist (q p) (v p•y)≤E := cone_approx y base boundary γ round hγ hE hround
  refine ⟨v,coneLabel_outer base boundary γ round,?_,?_⟩
  · have hh : ∀ f k, dist (v (tail H N (f,k))•y) (v (tail H N (f,k+1))•y)≤
        (A+2*E)+(B+2*E) := by
      apply edges_bound (fun p => v p•y) (by linarith) (by linarith)
      · intro r i
        exact rounded_edge_bound y q v hq (conePoint_horizontal y base boundary γ hγ hX hstep r i)
      · intro r i
        exact rounded_edge_bound y q v hq (conePoint_radial y base boundary γ hγ hspan r i)
      · intro i
        apply rounded_edge_bound y q v hq
        change dist (conePoint y base γ (Sum.inl (0,i) : Vertex H N)) (conePoint y base γ (Sum.inr ()))≤B
        rw [conePoint_center y base boundary γ hγ,dist_self]
        exact hB
    intro f k
    exact (hh f k).trans_eq (by ring)
  · exact coneLabel_radius y base boundary γ round hγ hE hround hbase hboundary hspan' hL

open SectorMetric
variable {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [MulAction TriangleGroup X]

abbrev AngularSize (n : ℕ) := 3*(2*(n+1))

def angularEquiv (n : ℕ) : Fin (AngularSize n) ≃ Fin (6*(n+1)) := finCongr (by dsimp [AngularSize]; omega)

@[simp] lemma angularEquiv_val (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (AngularSize n)) : (angularEquiv n i).val=i.val := rfl
@[simp] lemma angularEquiv_add (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin (AngularSize n)) :
    angularEquiv n (i+j) = angularEquiv n i+angularEquiv n j := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change (i.val+j.val) % (3*(2*(n+1))) = (i.val+j.val) % (6*(n+1))
  congr 1; omega

@[simp] lemma angularEquiv_one (n : ℕ) : angularEquiv n 1=1 := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change 1%(3*(2*(n+1)))=1%(6*(n+1))
  congr 1; omega

noncomputable def circleAt (y : X) (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (i : Fin (AngularSize n)) : TriangleGroup :=
  ringCircle y (n+1) R (angularEquiv n i)

noncomputable def innerLabel (y : X) (n : ℕ) : GridDisk.Vertex n (AngularSize n) → TriangleGroup
  | Sum.inl (r,i) => circleAt y n r.val i
  | Sum.inr _ => 1

@[simp] lemma circleAt_zero (y : X) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (AngularSize n)) : circleAt y n 0 i=1 := by
  simp [circleAt,ringCircle,circle,axis]

variable [ProperSpace X] [Nonempty X]
variable (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y)
  {C : ℝ} (hC : 0≤C)
  (hchart : ∀ i p q, |dist (chart y i p•y) (chart y i q•y)-
      ‖vec (cosine y i) (q.1-p.1,q.2-p.2)‖|≤C)
include hG hR hC hchart

omit hC in
lemma circleAt_step (n : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hR0 : 0≤R) (i : Fin (AngularSize n)) :
    dist (circleAt y n R i•y) (circleAt y n R (i+1)•y)≤20*R/(n+1:ℕ)+C := by
  simp only [circleAt,angularEquiv_add,angularEquiv_one]
  exact ringCircle_step hG y hR hchart (n+1) hR0 _

lemma innerLabel_edges (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ f k, dist (innerLabel y n (GridDisk.tail n (AngularSize n) (f,k))•y)
      (innerLabel y n (GridDisk.tail n (AngularSize n) (f,k+1))•y)≤21+2*C := by
  have hn : (0:ℝ)<(n+1:ℕ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (by omega)
  have hh : ∀ f k, dist (innerLabel y n (GridDisk.tail n (AngularSize n) (f,k))•y)
      (innerLabel y n (GridDisk.tail n (AngularSize n) (f,k+1))•y) ≤(20+C)+(1+C) := by
    apply GridDisk.edges_bound (fun p => innerLabel y n p•y) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    · intro r i
      have hh := circleAt_step hG y hR hchart n (Nat.cast_nonneg r.val) i
      have hr : (r.val:ℝ)≤(n+1:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (show r.val≤n+1 by omega)
      change dist (circleAt y n r.val i•y) (circleAt y n r.val (i+1)•y)≤20+C
      apply hh.trans
      have hs : 20*(r.val:ℝ)/(n+1:ℕ)≤20 := (div_le_iff₀ hn).mpr (by nlinarith)
      linarith
    · intro r i
      have hh := ringCircle_radial hG y hR hchart (n+1) (r.succ.val) (r.castSucc.val) (angularEquiv n i)
      change dist (circleAt y n r.succ.val i•y) (circleAt y n r.castSucc.val i•y)≤1+C
      simpa only [circleAt,Fin.val_succ,Fin.val_castSucc,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,add_sub_cancel_left,abs_one] using hh
    · intro i
      simp only [innerLabel,Fin.val_zero,Nat.cast_zero,circleAt_zero,one_smul,dist_self]
      linarith
  intro f k
  exact (hh f k).trans_eq (by ring)

omit hC hchart in
lemma innerLabel_chart (n : ℕ) (p : GridDisk.Vertex n (AngularSize n)) :
    ∃ i q, 0≤q.1 ∧ 0≤q.2 ∧ innerLabel y n p=chart y i q := by
  rcases p with ⟨r,j⟩|u
  · let e := finProdFinEquiv.symm (angularEquiv n j)
    let t : ℝ := e.2.val/(n+1:ℕ)
    have hp := unit_nonneg (cosine_lower hG y hR e.1).le (cosine_le_one hG y hR e.1)
      (angular_parameter e.2)
    exact ⟨e.1,((r.val:ℝ)*(unit (cosine y e.1) t).1,(r.val:ℝ)*(unit (cosine y e.1) t).2),
      mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hp.1,mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hp.2,rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨0,(0,0),le_rfl,le_rfl,(chart_zero y 0).symm⟩

noncomputable def shifted (w : ℝ) (p : Point) : Point := (p.1-w,p.2-w)

lemma edge_chain_equal {K : ℕ} (p : Fin (K+1) → Point)
    (hp : (∀ i, 0<(p i).1+(p i).2) ∨ (∀ i, (p i).1<0) ∨ (∀ i, (p i).2≤0)) :
    (∑ j : Fin K, edge (p j.castSucc) (p j.succ)) = edge (p 0) (p (Fin.last K)) := by
  rcases hp with h|h|h
  · rw [edge_chain_diagonal p h,edge_diagonal (h 0) (h (Fin.last K))]
  · rw [edge_chain_left p h,edge_left (h 0) (h (Fin.last K))]
  · rw [edge_chain_low p h,edge_low (h 0) (h (Fin.last K))]
end RayIndex

lemma edgeFlux_equal (p : Vertex M P S → Point) (q : V → Point) (f : F) (i : Fin 3)
    (hc : ∀ j, p (vertex M P S (f,S.point (j,0))) = q (M.tail (f,j)))
    (hp : (∀ j, 0<(p (vertex M P S (f,S.point (i,j)))).1+(p (vertex M P S (f,S.point (i,j)))).2) ∨
      (∀ j, (p (vertex M P S (f,S.point (i,j)))).1<0) ∨

    edgeFlux M P S p f i = edge (q (M.tail (f,i))) (q (M.tail (f,i+1))) := by
  rw [edgeFlux,edge_chain_equal _ hp,hc]
  rw [S.ends,hc]

lemma chart_plane_other_uniform (y : X) (i : Fin 6) (hi : i≠0) :
    (∀ p, (mirrorPlane (chart y i p)).1=0) ∨ (∀ p, (mirrorPlane (chart y i p)).2=0) := by
  simp_rw [chart,lattice_plane]
  fin_cases i <;> simp_all [planeRay]

variable [ProperSpace X] [Nonempty X]
variable (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y)
include hG hR

lemma ringCircle_next_product (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (R : ℝ) (a : Fin 6) (j : Fin N) :
    ringCircle y N R (finProdFinEquiv (a,j)+1) = circle y R a ((j.val+1:ℕ)/N) := by
  rw [product_next]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact ringCircle_product y N R a ⟨j.val+1,h⟩
  · have hj : j.val+1=N := by omega
    rw [ringCircle_product,hj,div_self (by exact_mod_cast (NeZero.ne N)),circle_one hG y hR]
    simp only [Fin.val_zero,Nat.cast_zero,zero_div,circle_zero]

lemma circle_shift_diagonal {R w t : ℝ} (hR0 : 0≤R) (ht : t∈Set.Icc 0 1)
    (hlarge : (rayLength y 0+rayLength y 1)*(2*w+2)<R) :
    0<(shifted w (mirrorPlane (circle y R 0 t))).1+
      (shifted w (mirrorPlane (circle y R 0 t))).2 := by
  have hh := circle_first_sum hG y hR hR0 ht
  have hL : 0<rayLength y 0+rayLength y 1 := add_pos (ray_length_pos hG y hR 0) (ray_length_pos hG y hR 1)
  dsimp only [shifted]
  have hs : 2*w < (mirrorPlane (circle y R 0 t)).1+(mirrorPlane (circle y R 0 t)).2 := by
    nlinarith
  linarith

lemma circle_chain_index (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {R w : ℝ} (hR0 : 0≤R) (hw : 0<w)
    (hlarge : (rayLength y 0+rayLength y 1)*(2*w+2)<R) (a : Fin 6) :
    (∑ j : Fin N, edge (shifted w (mirrorPlane (circle y R a (j.val/N))))
      (shifted w (mirrorPlane (circle y R a ((j.val+1:ℕ)/N))))) = if a=0 then 1 else 0 := by
  let p : Fin (N+1) → RayIndex.Point := fun j => shifted w (mirrorPlane (circle y R a (j.val/N)))
  have ht (j : Fin (N+1)) : (j.val/(N:ℝ))∈Set.Icc 0 1 := by
    have hN : (0:ℝ)<N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (NeZero.pos N)
    exact ⟨div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hN.le,(div_le_iff₀ hN).mpr (by rw [one_mul]; exact_mod_cast (show j.val≤N by omega))⟩
  change (∑ j : Fin N, edge (p j.castSucc) (p j.succ)) = _
  by_cases ha : a=0
  · subst a
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl,edge_chain_diagonal p (fun j => circle_shift_diagonal hG y hR hR0 (ht j) hlarge)]
    have hp0 : (p 0).2 = -w := by
      dsimp only [p,shifted]
      simp only [Fin.val_zero,Nat.cast_zero,zero_div,circle_zero]
      rw [← chart_axis1 y 0 R,chart_plane_first]
      simp
    have hplast : (p (Fin.last N)).1 = -w := by
      dsimp only [p,shifted]
      rw [Fin.val_last,div_self (by exact_mod_cast (NeZero.ne N)),circle_one hG y hR]
      rw [← chart_axis2 y 0 R,chart_plane_first]
      simp
    have hd := circle_shift_diagonal hG y hR hR0 (ht (Fin.last N)) hlarge
    change 0<(p (Fin.last N)).1+(p (Fin.last N)).2 at hd
    rw [hplast] at hd
    have hp : 0<(p (Fin.last N)).2 := by linarith
    simp [above,hp,hp0,hw.le]
  · rw [ite_eq_right ha]
    rcases chart_plane_other_uniform y a ha with h|h
    · apply edge_chain_left p
      intro j
      change (mirrorPlane (chart y a _)).1-w<0
      rw [h]
      linarith
    · apply edge_chain_low p
      intro j
      change (mirrorPlane (chart y a _)).2-w≤0
      rw [h]
      linarith

lemma ringCircle_index (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] {R w : ℝ} (hR0 : 0≤R) (hw : 0<w)
    (hlarge : (rayLength y 0+rayLength y 1)*(2*w+2)<R) :
    (∑ j : Fin (6*N), edge (shifted w (mirrorPlane (ringCircle y N R j)))
      (shifted w (mirrorPlane (ringCircle y N R (j+1))))) = 1 := by
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp finProdFinEquiv]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp_rw [ringCircle_product,ringCircle_next_product hG y hR]
  simp_rw [circle_chain_index hG y hR N hR0 hw hlarge]
  simp

variable (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N]
lemma sum_index_boundary (p : Vertex H N → Point) :
    (∑ f, face (fun i => p (tail H N (f,i)))) = ∑ j : Fin N,
      edge (p (Sum.inl (Fin.last (H+1),j))) (p (Sum.inl (Fin.last (H+1),j+1))) := by
  classical
  let w (d : Face H N × Fin 3) := edge (p (tail H N d)) (p (tail H N (d.1,d.2+1)))
  have ha (d) (hd : ¬(patch H N).Boundary d) : w ((patch H N).mate d) = -w d := by
    dsimp only [w]
    change edge (p ((patch H N).tail ((patch H N).mate d)))
      (p ((patch H N).tail (((patch H N).mate d).1,((patch H N).mate d).2+1))) = _
    rw [(patch H N).tail_mate d hd,(patch H N).tail_rotate_mate d hd]
    exact edge_reverse _ _
  change (∑ f, ∑ i, w (f,i)) = _
  rw [(patch H N).sum_faces_boundary w ha,← Finset.sum_filter]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun j _ => (A H N (Fin.last H) j,0))
  · intro j _
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,(boundary_iff H N _).mpr ⟨j,rfl⟩⟩
  · intro j _ k _ hjk
    simpa only [Prod.mk.injEq,A,Sum.inl.injEq,true_and,and_true] using hjk
  · intro d hd
    obtain ⟨j,rfl⟩ := (boundary_iff H N _).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hd).2
    exact ⟨j,Finset.mem_univ _,rfl⟩
  · intro j _
    rfl
end ArtinCAT0.GridDisk

lemma cap_exists (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ v : GridDisk.Vertex n (AngularSize n) → TriangleGroup,
      (∀ i, v (Sum.inl (Fin.last (n+1),i)) = circleAt y n (n+1:ℕ) (-i)) ∧
      (∀ f k, dist (v (GridDisk.tail n (AngularSize n) (f,k))•y)
        (v (GridDisk.tail n (AngularSize n) (f,k+1))•y)≤22+4*C+4*E) ∧
      (∀ p, (1-d/2)*(n+1:ℕ)-5*C/2-E≤dist y (v p•y)) := by
  let R : ℝ := (n+1:ℕ)
  have hR1 : 1≤R := by dsimp [R]; exact_mod_cast (show 1≤n+1 by omega)
  have hR0 : 0≤R := by linarith
  let b : Fin (AngularSize n) → TriangleGroup := fun i => circleAt y n R (-i)
  have hstep (i) : dist (b i•y) (b (i+1)•y)≤20+C := by
    have hh := circleAt_step hG y hR hchart n hR0 (-i-1)
    have he : -i-1+1 = -i := sub_add_cancel _ _
    rw [he] at hh
    change dist (circleAt y n R (-i)•y) (circleAt y n R (-(i+1))•y)≤20+C
    rw [dist_comm]
    have hz : -(i+1) = -i-1 := by abel
    rw [hz]
    apply hh.trans
    have hRp : R ≠ 0 := by linarith
    change 20*R/R+C≤20+C
    rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ 20 hRp]
  have hspan' (i) : dist (axis y 0 R•y) (b i•y)≤d*R+3*C :=
    hdetour R hR0 _ _ (angular_parameter _)
  have hspan (i) : dist (axis y 0 R•y) (b i•y)≤(n+1:ℕ)*(2+3*C) := by
    have hh := hspan' i
    have hmul := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hR1) hC

namespace OAI

namespace ArtinCAT0

/-- A triangular disk may have unpaired boundary darts. No topological theorem
is hidden in this interface: exactness is required and subsequently proved for
the explicit grid disks used in the controlled-diagram construction. -/
structure TrianglePatch (F V : Type*) where
  mate : Equiv.Perm (F × Fin 3)
  mate_involutive : Function.Involutive mate
  tail : F × Fin 3 → V
  tail_mate : ∀ d, mate d ≠ d → tail (mate d) = tail (d.1,d.2+1)

namespace TrianglePatch
variable {F V : Type*} (M : TrianglePatch F V)

def Boundary (d : F × Fin 3) : Prop := M.mate d = d

def Exact : Prop :=
  ∀ w : F × Fin 3 → ℝ,
    (∀ d, ¬ M.Boundary d → w (M.mate d) = -w d) →
    (∀ f, ∑ i : Fin 3, w (f,i) = 0) →
    ∃ p : V → ℝ, ∀ d, w d = p (M.tail (d.1,d.2+1)) - p (M.tail d)

@[simp] lemma mate_mate (d : F × Fin 3) : M.mate (M.mate d) = d := M.mate_involutive d

lemma tail_rotate_mate (d : F × Fin 3) (hd : ¬ M.Boundary d) :
    M.tail ((M.mate d).1,(M.mate d).2+1) = M.tail d := by
  rw [← M.tail_mate (M.mate d) (by intro h; exact hd (M.mate.injective h)), M.mate_mate]

end TrianglePatch

namespace GridDisk
variable (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N]

abbrev Face := (Fin (H+1) × Fin N × Bool) ⊕ Fin N
abbrev Vertex := (Fin (H+2) × Fin N) ⊕ Unit
abbrev A (r : Fin (H+1)) (i : Fin N) : Face H N := Sum.inl (r,i,false)
abbrev B (r : Fin (H+1)) (i : Fin N) : Face H N := Sum.inl (r,i,true)
abbrev C (i : Fin N) : Face H N := Sum.inr i

def mateFun : Face H N × Fin 3 → Face H N × Fin 3
  | (Sum.inl (r,i,false),k) =>
      if k = 0 then
        if h : r.val+1 < H+1 then (B H N ⟨r.val+1,h⟩ i,1) else (A H N r i,0)
      else if k = 1 then (B H N r (i+1),2) else (B H N r i,0)
  | (Sum.inl (r,i,true),k) =>
      if k = 0 then (A H N r i,2)
      else if k = 1 then
        if h : r.val = 0 then (C H N i,0) else (A H N ⟨r.val-1,by omega⟩ i,0)
      else (A H N r (i-1),1)
  | (Sum.inr i,k) =>
      if k = 0 then (B H N 0 i,1)
      else if k = 1 then (C H N (i+1),2) else (C H N (i-1),1)

lemma mateFun_involutive : Function.Involutive (mateFun H N) := by
  rintro ⟨f,k⟩
  rcases f with ⟨r,i,b⟩ | i
  · cases b <;> fin_cases k <;> simp only [mateFun]
    all_goals split_ifs <;> simp_all [A,B]
    all_goals split_ifs <;> simp_all only [Prod.mk.injEq, Sum.inl.injEq, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero]
    all_goals try simp only [and_true]
    all_goals omega
  · fin_cases k <;> simp [mateFun,B,C]

def tail : Face H N × Fin 3 → Vertex H N
  | (Sum.inl (r,i,false),k) =>
      if k = 0 then Sum.inl (r.succ,i)
      else if k = 1 then Sum.inl (r.succ,i+1) else Sum.inl (r.castSucc,i+1)
  | (Sum.inl (r,i,true),k) =>
      if k = 0 then Sum.inl (r.succ,i)
      else if k = 1 then Sum.inl (r.castSucc,i+1) else Sum.inl (r.castSucc,i)
  | (Sum.inr i,k) =>
      if k = 0 then Sum.inl (0,i)
      else if k = 1 then Sum.inl (0,i+1) else Sum.inr ()

lemma tail_mateFun (d : Face H N × Fin 3) (hd : mateFun H N d ≠ d) :
    tail H N (mateFun H N d) = tail H N (d.1,d.2+1) := by
  rcases d with ⟨f,k⟩
  rcases f with ⟨r,i,b⟩ | i
  · cases b <;> fin_cases k <;> simp only [mateFun] at hd ⊢
    all_goals split_ifs at hd ⊢ <;> simp_all [tail,A,B,C,Fin.add_def]
    all_goals simp only [Fin.ext_iff,Fin.val_zero,Fin.val_succ,Fin.val_castSucc] at *
    all_goals omega
  · fin_cases k <;> simp [mateFun,tail,B,C,Fin.add_def]

def patch : TrianglePatch (Face H N) (Vertex H N) where
  mate := ⟨mateFun H N, mateFun H N, mateFun_involutive H N, mateFun_involutive H N⟩
  mate_involutive := mateFun_involutive H N
  tail := tail H N
  tail_mate := tail_mateFun H N

noncomputable def upper (w : Face H N × Fin 3 → ℝ) (r : Fin (H+1)) (i : Fin N) : ℝ :=
  if h : r.val = 0 then w (C H N i,0) else w (A H N ⟨r.val-1,by omega⟩ i,0)

noncomputable def potential (w : Face H N × Fin 3 → ℝ) : ℕ → Fin N → ℝ
  | 0,i => w (C H N i,2)
  | k+1,i => potential w k i + if h : k < H+1 then w (B H N ⟨k,h⟩ i,2) else 0

omit [NeZero N] in
lemma potential_succ (w : Face H N × Fin 3 → ℝ) (r : Fin (H+1)) (i : Fin N) :
    potential H N w (r.val+1) i = potential H N w r.val i + w (B H N r i,2) := by
  simp [potential,r.isLt]

lemma cocycle_relations (w : Face H N × Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ d, ¬ (patch H N).Boundary d → w ((patch H N).mate d) = -w d) :
    (∀ r i, w (A H N r i,1) = -w (B H N r (i+1),2)) ∧
    (∀ r i, w (A H N r i,2) = -w (B H N r i,0)) ∧
    (∀ r i, w (B H N r i,1) = -upper H N w r i) ∧
    (∀ i, w (C H N i,1) = -w (C H N (i+1),2)) := by
  have hh (d) (hd : mateFun H N d ≠ d) : w (mateFun H N d) = -w d := ha d hd
  constructor
  · intro r i
    have h := hh (A H N r i,1) (by simp [mateFun,A,B])
    simp only [mateFun,A,B,Fin.isValue,Fin.reduceEq,ite_false,ite_true] at h
    linarith
  constructor
  · intro r i
    have h := hh (A H N r i,2) (by simp [mateFun,A,B])
    simp only [mateFun,A,B,Fin.isValue,Fin.reduceEq,ite_false] at h
    linarith
  constructor
  · intro r i
    have h := hh (B H N r i,1) (by simp [mateFun,A,B,C]; split_ifs <;> simp)
    by_cases hr : r.val = 0 <;> simp [mateFun,A,B,C,hr,upper] at h ⊢ <;> linarith
  · intro i
    have h := hh (C H N i,1) (by simp [mateFun,C])
    simp only [mateFun,C,Fin.isValue,Fin.reduceEq,ite_false,ite_true] at h
    linarith

namespace OAI

namespace ArtinCAT0

/-- A triangular disk may have unpaired boundary darts. No topological theorem
is hidden in this interface: exactness is required and subsequently proved for
the explicit grid disks used in the controlled-diagram construction. -/
structure TrianglePatch (F V : Type*) where
  mate : Equiv.Perm (F × Fin 3)
  mate_involutive : Function.Involutive mate
  tail : F × Fin 3 → V
  tail_mate : ∀ d, mate d ≠ d → tail (mate d) = tail (d.1,d.2+1)

namespace TrianglePatch
variable {F V : Type*} (M : TrianglePatch F V)

def Boundary (d : F × Fin 3) : Prop := M.mate d = d

def Exact : Prop :=
  ∀ w : F × Fin 3 → ℝ,
    (∀ d, ¬ M.Boundary d → w (M.mate d) = -w d) →
    (∀ f, ∑ i : Fin 3, w (f,i) = 0) →
    ∃ p : V → ℝ, ∀ d, w d = p (M.tail (d.1,d.2+1)) - p (M.tail d)

@[simp] lemma mate_mate (d : F × Fin 3) : M.mate (M.mate d) = d := M.mate_involutive d

lemma tail_rotate_mate (d : F × Fin 3) (hd : ¬ M.Boundary d) :
    M.tail ((M.mate d).1,(M.mate d).2+1) = M.tail d := by
  rw [← M.tail_mate (M.mate d) (by intro h; exact hd (M.mate.injective h)), M.mate_mate]

end TrianglePatch

namespace GridDisk
variable (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N]

abbrev Face := (Fin (H+1) × Fin N × Bool) ⊕ Fin N
abbrev Vertex := (Fin (H+2) × Fin N) ⊕ Unit
abbrev A (r : Fin (H+1)) (i : Fin N) : Face H N := Sum.inl (r,i,false)
abbrev B (r : Fin (H+1)) (i : Fin N) : Face H N := Sum.inl (r,i,true)
abbrev C (i : Fin N) : Face H N := Sum.inr i

def mateFun : Face H N × Fin 3 → Face H N × Fin 3
  | (Sum.inl (r,i,false),k) =>
      if k = 0 then
        if h : r.val+1 < H+1 then (B H N ⟨r.val+1,h⟩ i,1) else (A H N r i,0)
      else if k = 1 then (B H N r (i+1),2) else (B H N r i,0)
  | (Sum.inl (r,i,true),k) =>
      if k = 0 then (A H N r i,2)
      else if k = 1 then
        if h : r.val = 0 then (C H N i,0) else (A H N ⟨r.val-1,by omega⟩ i,0)
      else (A H N r (i-1),1)
  | (Sum.inr i,k) =>
      if k = 0 then (B H N 0 i,1)
      else if k = 1 then (C H N (i+1),2) else (C H N (i-1),1)

lemma mateFun_involutive : Function.Involutive (mateFun H N) := by
  rintro ⟨f,k⟩
  rcases f with ⟨r,i,b⟩ | i
  · cases b <;> fin_cases k <;> simp only [mateFun]
    all_goals split_ifs <;> simp_all [A,B]
    all_goals split_ifs <;> simp_all only [Prod.mk.injEq, Sum.inl.injEq, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero]
    all_goals try simp only [and_true]
    all_goals omega
  · fin_cases k <;> simp [mateFun,B,C]

def tail : Face H N × Fin 3 → Vertex H N
  | (Sum.inl (r,i,false),k) =>
      if k = 0 then Sum.inl (r.succ,i)
      else if k = 1 then Sum.inl (r.succ,i+1) else Sum.inl (r.castSucc,i+1)
  | (Sum.inl (r,i,true),k) =>
      if k = 0 then Sum.inl (r.succ,i)
      else if k = 1 then Sum.inl (r.castSucc,i+1) else Sum.inl (r.castSucc,i)
  | (Sum.inr i,k) =>
      if k = 0 then Sum.inl (0,i)
      else if k = 1 then Sum.inl (0,i+1) else Sum.inr ()

lemma tail_mateFun (d : Face H N × Fin 3) (hd : mateFun H N d ≠ d) :
    tail H N (mateFun H N d) = tail H N (d.1,d.2+1) := by
  rcases d with ⟨f,k⟩
  rcases f with ⟨r,i,b⟩ | i
  · cases b <;> fin_cases k <;> simp only [mateFun] at hd ⊢
    all_goals split_ifs at hd ⊢ <;> simp_all [tail,A,B,C,Fin.add_def]
    all_goals simp only [Fin.ext_iff,Fin.val_zero,Fin.val_succ,Fin.val_castSucc] at *
    all_goals omega
  · fin_cases k <;> simp [mateFun,tail,B,C,Fin.add_def]

def patch : TrianglePatch (Face H N) (Vertex H N) where
  mate := ⟨mateFun H N, mateFun H N, mateFun_involutive H N, mateFun_involutive H N⟩
  mate_involutive := mateFun_involutive H N
  tail := tail H N
  tail_mate := tail_mateFun H N

noncomputable def upper (w : Face H N × Fin 3 → ℝ) (r : Fin (H+1)) (i : Fin N) : ℝ :=
  if h : r.val = 0 then w (C H N i,0) else w (A H N ⟨r.val-1,by omega⟩ i,0)

noncomputable def potential (w : Face H N × Fin 3 → ℝ) : ℕ → Fin N → ℝ
  | 0,i => w (C H N i,2)
  | k+1,i => potential w k i + if h : k < H+1 then w (B H N ⟨k,h⟩ i,2) else 0

omit [NeZero N] in
lemma potential_succ (w : Face H N × Fin 3 → ℝ) (r : Fin (H+1)) (i : Fin N) :
    potential H N w (r.val+1) i = potential H N w r.val i + w (B H N r i,2) := by
  simp [potential,r.isLt]

lemma cocycle_relations (w : Face H N × Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ d, ¬ (patch H N).Boundary d → w ((patch H N).mate d) = -w d) :
    (∀ r i, w (A H N r i,1) = -w (B H N r (i+1),2)) ∧
    (∀ r i, w (A H N r i,2) = -w (B H N r i,0)) ∧
    (∀ r i, w (B H N r i,1) = -upper H N w r i) ∧
    (∀ i, w (C H N i,1) = -w (C H N (i+1),2)) := by
  have hh (d) (hd : mateFun H N d ≠ d) : w (mateFun H N d) = -w d := ha d hd
  constructor
  · intro r i
    have h := hh (A H N r i,1) (by simp [mateFun,A,B])
    simp only [mateFun,A,B,Fin.isValue,Fin.reduceEq,ite_false,ite_true] at h
    linarith
  constructor
  · intro r i
    have h := hh (A H N r i,2) (by simp [mateFun,A,B])
    simp only [mateFun,A,B,Fin.isValue,Fin.reduceEq,ite_false] at h
    linarith
  constructor
  · intro r i
    have h := hh (B H N r i,1) (by simp [mateFun,A,B,C]; split_ifs <;> simp)
    by_cases hr : r.val = 0 <;> simp [mateFun,A,B,C,hr,upper] at h ⊢ <;> linarith
  · intro i
    have h := hh (C H N i,1) (by simp [mateFun,C])
    simp only [mateFun,C,Fin.isValue,Fin.reduceEq,ite_false,ite_true] at h
    linarith

/-- Exactness of the explicit capped cylindrical disk. The proof constructs a
potential by integrating vertically downward from the cap; the square and cap
relations verify every horizontal edge. -/
theorem exact : (patch H N).Exact := by
  intro w ha hc
  obtain ⟨hA₁,hA₂,hB₁,hC₁⟩ := cocycle_relations H N w ha
  have hc' (f) : w (f,0) + w (f,1) + w (f,2) = 0 := by
    simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_three] using hc f
  have hcap (i) : w (C H N i,0) = potential H N w 0 (i+1) - potential H N w 0 i := by
    have h := hc' (C H N i)
    rw [hC₁] at h
    simpa only [potential] using (show w (C H N i,0) = w (C H N (i+1),2)-w (C H N i,2) by linarith)
  have hstep (r : Fin (H+1))
      (hu : ∀ i, upper H N w r i = potential H N w r.val (i+1) - potential H N w r.val i) :
      ∀ i, w (A H N r i,0) = potential H N w (r.val+1) (i+1) - potential H N w (r.val+1) i := by
    intro i
    have hA := hc' (A H N r i)
    have hB := hc' (B H N r i)
    rw [hA₁,hA₂] at hA
    rw [hB₁,hu] at hB
    rw [potential_succ,potential_succ]
    linarith
  have hrow : ∀ k, ∀ hk : k < H+1, ∀ i,
      w (A H N ⟨k,hk⟩ i,0) = potential H N w (k+1) (i+1) - potential H N w (k+1) i := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro hk
      apply hstep
      intro i
      simpa [upper] using hcap i
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      apply hstep
      intro i
      simpa [upper] using ih (by omega) i
  have hu (r : Fin (H+1)) (i : Fin N) :
      upper H N w r i = potential H N w r.val (i+1) - potential H N w r.val i := by
    by_cases hr : r.val = 0
    · simpa [upper,hr] using hcap i
    · simpa [upper,hr,Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ r.val)] using
        hrow (r.val-1) (by omega) i
  let p : Vertex H N → ℝ := fun v => match v with
    | Sum.inl (r,i) => potential H N w r.val i
    | Sum.inr _ => 0
  refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨f,k⟩
  change w (f,k) = p (tail H N (f,k+1)) - p (tail H N (f,k))
  rcases f with ⟨r,i,b⟩ | i
  · have hA := hc' (A H N r i)
    have hB := hc' (B H N r i)
    have hb₁ := hB₁ r i
    rw [hu] at hb₁
    have ha₁ := hA₁ r i
    have ha₂ := hA₂ r i
    have ha₀ := hrow r.val r.isLt i
    have hp := potential_succ H N w r i
    have hp' := potential_succ H N w r (i+1)
    cases b
    · fin_cases k
      · change w (A H N r i,0) = potential H N w (r.val+1) (i+1) - potential H N w (r.val+1) i
        exact ha₀
      · change w (A H N r i,1) = potential H N w r.val (i+1) - potential H N w (r.val+1) (i+1)
        linarith
      · change w (A H N r i,2) = potential H N w (r.val+1) i - potential H N w r.val (i+1)
        linarith
    · fin_cases k
      · change w (B H N r i,0) = potential H N w r.val (i+1) - potential H N w (r.val+1) i
        linarith
      · change w (B H N r i,1) = potential H N w r.val i - potential H N w r.val (i+1)
        linarith
      · change w (B H N r i,2) = potential H N w (r.val+1) i - potential H N w r.val i
        linarith
  · have h₀ := hcap i
    have h₁ := hC₁ i
    fin_cases k
    · change w (C H N i,0) = potential H N w 0 (i+1) - potential H N w 0 i
      exact h₀
    · change w (C H N i,1) = 0 - w (C H N (i+1),2)
      simpa using h₁
    · change w (C H N i,2) = w (C H N i,2) - 0
      ring
