variable {A U : Type*}

/-- Three marked, equally subdivided sides of a triangular patch. The marks
are combinatorial; the vertices and faces need not be mapped injectively. -/
structure Sides (P : TrianglePatch A U) (K : ℕ) where
  dart : Fin 3 × Fin K → A × Fin 3
  point : Fin 3 × Fin (K+1) → U
  dart_injective : Function.Injective dart
  fixed : ∀ e, P.Boundary (dart e)
  complete : ∀ d, P.Boundary d → ∃ e, dart e = d
  tail : ∀ i j, P.tail (dart (i,j)) = point (i,j.castSucc)
  head : ∀ i j, P.tail ((dart (i,j)).1,(dart (i,j)).2+1) = point (i,j.succ)
  ends : ∀ i, point (i,Fin.last K) = point (i+1,0)

lemma boundary_mate (P : TrianglePatch A U) (d : A × Fin 3) :
    P.Boundary (P.mate d) ↔ P.Boundary d := by
  unfold Boundary
  rw [P.mate_mate]
  exact eq_comm

namespace Sides
variable {P : TrianglePatch A U} {K : ℕ} [NeZero K] (S : P.Sides K)
noncomputable def index (d : A × Fin 3) : Fin 3 × Fin K := by
  classical
  exact if h : P.Boundary d then (S.complete d h).choose else (0,0)

@[simp] lemma index_dart (e : Fin 3 × Fin K) : S.index (S.dart e) = e := by
  classical
  apply S.dart_injective
  simp only [index,dite_eq_left (S.fixed e)]
  exact (S.complete _ (S.fixed e)).choose_spec

lemma dart_index (d : A × Fin 3) (h : P.Boundary d) : S.dart (S.index d) = d := by
  classical
  simp only [index,dite_eq_left h]
  exact (S.complete d h).choose_spec

end Sides
end TrianglePatch

lemma reverse_chain_difference {K : ℕ} (a b : Fin (K+1) → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ j : Fin K, a j.succ - a j.castSucc = b j.rev.castSucc - b j.rev.succ) :
    ∀ j, a j - a 0 = b j.rev - b (Fin.last K) := by
  intro j
  induction j using Fin.induction with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    have hh := h j
    rw [Fin.rev_castSucc] at ih
    rw [Fin.rev_succ]
    linarith

namespace TriangleMesh
variable {F V A U : Type*} (M : TriangleMesh F V) (P : TrianglePatch A U)
  {K : ℕ} [NeZero K] (S : P.Sides K)

namespace Replacement

noncomputable def mateFun (d : (F × A) × Fin 3) : (F × A) × Fin 3 := by
  classical
  exact if h : P.Boundary (d.1.2,d.2) then
    let e := S.index (d.1.2,d.2)
    let m := M.mate (d.1.1,e.1)
    let t := S.dart (m.2,e.2.rev)
    ((m.1,t.1),t.2)
  else
    let t := P.mate (d.1.2,d.2)
    ((d.1.1,t.1),t.2)

@[simp] lemma mate_boundary (f : F) (i : Fin 3) (j : Fin K) :
    mateFun M P S ((f,(S.dart (i,j)).1),(S.dart (i,j)).2) =
      (((M.mate (f,i)).1, (S.dart ((M.mate (f,i)).2,j.rev)).1),
        (S.dart ((M.mate (f,i)).2,j.rev)).2) := by
  classical
  simp only [mateFun,Prod.mk.eta,S.fixed,dite_eq_left,S.index_dart]

lemma mate_internal (f : F) (d : A × Fin 3) (hd : ¬ P.Boundary d) :
    mateFun M P S ((f,d.1),d.2) = ((f,(P.mate d).1),(P.mate d).2) := by
  classical
  simp [mateFun,hd]

lemma mateFun_involutive : Function.Involutive (mateFun M P S) := by
  rintro ⟨⟨f,a⟩,k⟩
  by_cases hd : P.Boundary (a,k)
  · obtain ⟨⟨i,j⟩,he⟩ := S.complete _ hd
    have hd' : ((f,a),k) = ((f,(S.dart (i,j)).1),(S.dart (i,j)).2) := by rw [he]
    rw [hd',mate_boundary,mate_boundary,M.mate_mate,Fin.rev_rev]
  · rw [mate_internal M P S f (a,k) hd,
      mate_internal M P S f (P.mate (a,k)) (by simpa only [P.boundary_mate] using hd),
      P.mate_mate]

lemma mateFun_ne (d : (F × A) × Fin 3) : mateFun M P S d ≠ d := by
  rcases d with ⟨⟨f,a⟩,k⟩
  by_cases hd : P.Boundary (a,k)
  · obtain ⟨⟨i,j⟩,he⟩ := S.complete _ hd
    have hd' : ((f,a),k) = ((f,(S.dart (i,j)).1),(S.dart (i,j)).2) := by rw [he]
    rw [hd',mate_boundary]
    intro h
    have hface := congrArg (fun d : (F×A)×Fin 3 => d.1.1) h
    have hdart := congrArg (fun d : (F×A)×Fin 3 => (d.1.2,d.2)) h
    dsimp only at hdart hface
    have hi := congrArg Prod.fst (S.dart_injective hdart)
    exact M.mate_ne (f,i) (Prod.ext hface hi)
  · rw [mate_internal M P S f (a,k) hd]
    intro h
    apply hd
    exact congrArg (fun d : (F×A)×Fin 3 => (d.1.2,d.2)) h

/-- Boundary vertices glued with opposite side parametrizations. -/
def Seam (u v : F × U) : Prop :=
  ∃ f i j, u = (f,S.point (i,j)) ∧
    v = ((M.mate (f,i)).1,S.point ((M.mate (f,i)).2,j.rev))

abbrev Vertex := Quot (Seam M P S)

def vertex (x : F × U) : Vertex M P S := Quot.mk _ x

omit [NeZero K] in
lemma vertex_seam (f : F) (i : Fin 3) (j : Fin (K+1)) :
    vertex M P S (f,S.point (i,j)) =
      vertex M P S ((M.mate (f,i)).1,S.point ((M.mate (f,i)).2,j.rev)) :=
  Quot.sound ⟨f,i,j,rfl,rfl⟩

def tail (d : (F × A) × Fin 3) : Vertex M P S :=
  vertex M P S (d.1.1,P.tail (d.1.2,d.2))

lemma tail_mateFun (d : (F × A) × Fin 3) :
    tail M P S (mateFun M P S d) = tail M P S (d.1,d.2+1) := by
  rcases d with ⟨⟨f,a⟩,k⟩
  by_cases hd : P.Boundary (a,k)
  · obtain ⟨⟨i,j⟩,he⟩ := S.complete _ hd
    have hd' : ((f,a),k) = ((f,(S.dart (i,j)).1),(S.dart (i,j)).2) := by rw [he]
    rw [hd',mate_boundary]
    change vertex M P S ((M.mate (f,i)).1,P.tail (S.dart ((M.mate (f,i)).2,j.rev))) =
      vertex M P S (f,P.tail ((S.dart (i,j)).1,(S.dart (i,j)).2+1))
    rw [S.tail,S.head,vertex_seam M P S f i j.succ,Fin.rev_succ]
  · rw [mate_internal M P S f (a,k) hd]
    change vertex M P S (f,P.tail (P.mate (a,k))) = vertex M P S (f,P.tail (a,k+1))
    rw [P.tail_mate _ hd]

noncomputable def mesh : TriangleMesh (F × A) (Vertex M P S) where
  mate := ⟨mateFun M P S,mateFun M P S,mateFun_involutive M P S,mateFun_involutive M P S⟩
  mate_involutive := mateFun_involutive M P S
  mate_ne := mateFun_ne M P S
  tail := tail M P S
  tail_mate := tail_mateFun M P S

open SectorMetric

variable {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [MulAction TriangleGroup X] [ProperSpace X] [Nonempty X]

noncomputable def rayLength (y : X) (i : Fin 6) := stableLengthAt y (ray i)
noncomputable def chart (y : X) (i : Fin 6) (p : Point) : TriangleGroup :=
  lattice (ray i) (ray (i+1)) (rayLength y i) (rayLength y (i+1)) p
noncomputable def axis (y : X) (i : Fin 6) (R : ℝ) : TriangleGroup := (ray i)^⌊R/rayLength y i⌋
noncomputable def circle (y : X) (R : ℝ) (i : Fin 6) (t : ℝ) : TriangleGroup :=
  chart y i (R*(unit (cosine y i) t).1,R*(unit (cosine y i) t).2)

omit [ProperSpace X] [Nonempty X] in
@[simp] lemma chart_zero (y : X) (i : Fin 6) : chart y i (0,0) = 1 := lattice_origin _ _ _ _
omit [ProperSpace X] [Nonempty X] in
@[simp] lemma chart_axis1 (y : X) (i : Fin 6) (R : ℝ) : chart y i (R,0) = axis y i R := by
  simp [chart,lattice,axis]
omit [ProperSpace X] [Nonempty X] in
@[simp] lemma chart_axis2 (y : X) (i : Fin 6) (R : ℝ) : chart y i (0,R) = axis y (i+1) R := by
  simp [chart,lattice,axis]

lemma cosine_abs (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y) (i : Fin 6) :
    |cosine y i| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [cosine_lower hG y hR i],cosine_le_one hG y hR i⟩

omit [ProperSpace X] [Nonempty X] in
lemma circle_zero (y : X) (R : ℝ) (i : Fin 6) : circle y R i 0 = axis y i R := by
  simp [circle]
lemma circle_one (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y)
    (R : ℝ) (i : Fin 6) : circle y R i 1 = axis y (i+1) R := by
  simp [circle,unit_one _ (cosine_abs hG y hR i)]

theorem chart_uniform (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0≤C ∧ ∀ i p q,
      |dist (chart y i p • y) (chart y i q • y)-‖vec (cosine y i) (q.1-p.1,q.2-p.2)‖| ≤ C := by
  have hh i : ∃ C : ℝ, 0≤C ∧ ∀ p q : Point,
      |dist (chart y i p • y) (chart y i q • y)-‖vec (cosine y i) (q.1-p.1,q.2-p.2)‖| ≤ C := by
    apply lattice_metric hG y (ray_length_pos hG y hR i) (ray_length_pos hG y hR (i+1))
      (ray_commute i) (cosine_abs hG y hR i)
    unfold cosine
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (ray_length_pos hG y hR i),ne_of_gt (ray_length_pos hG y hR (i+1))]
  choose C hC hh using hh
  refine ⟨∑ i, C i,Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hC i),?_⟩
  intro i p q
  exact (hh i p q).trans (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hC j) (Finset.mem_univ i))

section Estimates
variable (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y)
  {C : ℝ} (hC : 0≤C)
  (hchart : ∀ i p q, |dist (chart y i p • y) (chart y i q • y)-
    ‖vec (cosine y i) (q.1-p.1,q.2-p.2)‖| ≤ C)
include hG hR hchart

lemma circle_radius {R : ℝ} (hR0 : 0≤R) (i : Fin 6) {t : ℝ} (ht : t∈Set.Icc 0 1) :
    |dist y (circle y R i t • y)-R| ≤ C := by
  have h := hchart i (0,0) (R*(unit (cosine y i) t).1,R*(unit (cosine y i) t).2)
  rw [chart_zero,one_smul] at h
  simp only [sub_zero] at h
  rw [vec_mul,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hR0,
    unit_vec (cosine_lower hG y hR i).le (cosine_le_one hG y hR i) ht,mul_one] at h
  exact h

lemma circle_lipschitz {R : ℝ} (hR0 : 0≤R) (i : Fin 6) {s t : ℝ}
    (hs : s∈Set.Icc 0 1) (ht : t∈Set.Icc 0 1) :
    dist (circle y R i s • y) (circle y R i t • y) ≤ 20*R*|s-t|+C := by
  have h := (abs_le.mp (hchart i (R*(unit (cosine y i) s).1,R*(unit (cosine y i) s).2)
    (R*(unit (cosine y i) t).1,R*(unit (cosine y i) t).2))).2
  have hb := vec_bound (cosine y i) (cosine_abs hG y hR i)
    (R*(unit (cosine y i) t).1-R*(unit (cosine y i) s).1,
      R*(unit (cosine y i) t).2-R*(unit (cosine y i) s).2)
  have hu := unit_lipschitz (cosine_lower hG y hR i).le (cosine_le_one hG y hR i) ht hs
  simp only [← mul_sub,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg hR0] at hb
  rw [abs_sub_comm t s] at hu
  change dist (circle y R i s • y) (circle y R i t • y)-_ ≤ C at h
  simp only [← mul_sub] at h
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu.1 hR0,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu.2 hR0]

lemma axis_radius {R : ℝ} (hR0 : 0≤R) (i : Fin 6) :
    |dist y (axis y i R • y)-R| ≤ C := by
  simpa only [circle_zero] using circle_radius hG y hR hchart hR0 i (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)∈Set.Icc 0 1)

lemma circle_axis_chord {c r R : ℝ} (hc : ∀ i, c≤cosine y i) (hr : 0≤r) (hR0 : 0≤R)
    (i : Fin 6) {t : ℝ} (ht : t∈Set.Icc 0 1) :
    dist (axis y i (r*R) • y) (circle y R i t • y) ≤ R*Real.sqrt (1+r^2-2*c*r)+C ∧
    dist (axis y (i+1) (r*R) • y) (circle y R i t • y) ≤ R*Real.sqrt (1+r^2-2*c*r)+C := by
  have hca := (cosine_lower hG y hR i).le
  have hcb := cosine_le_one hG y hR i
  have h1 := chord_axis1 hca hcb ht hr
  have h2 := chord_axis2 hca hcb ht hr
  have hd : 1+r^2-2*cosine y i*r ≤ 1+r^2-2*c*r := by nlinarith [hc i]
  have hn1 : ‖vec (cosine y i) ((unit (cosine y i) t).1-r,(unit (cosine y i) t).2)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (1+r^2-2*c*r) := by
    exact (Real.le_sqrt (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith [sq_nonneg ‖vec (cosine y i) ((unit (cosine y i) t).1-r,(unit (cosine y i) t).2)‖])).mpr (h1.trans hd)
  have hn2 : ‖vec (cosine y i) ((unit (cosine y i) t).1,(unit (cosine y i) t).2-r)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (1+r^2-2*c*r) := by
    exact (Real.le_sqrt (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith [sq_nonneg ‖vec (cosine y i) ((unit (cosine y i) t).1,(unit (cosine y i) t).2-r)‖])).mpr (h2.trans hd)
  constructor
  · have h := (abs_le.mp (hchart i (r*R,0) (R*(unit (cosine y i) t).1,R*(unit (cosine y i) t).2))).2
    rw [chart_axis1] at h
    change dist (axis y i (r*R) • y) (circle y R i t • y)-_ ≤ C at h
    rw [show R*(unit (cosine y i) t).1-r*R = R*((unit (cosine y i) t).1-r) by ring,
      sub_zero,vec_mul (cosine y i) R ((unit (cosine y i) t).1-r,(unit (cosine y i) t).2),norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hR0] at h
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn1 hR0]
  · have h := (abs_le.mp (hchart i (0,r*R) (R*(unit (cosine y i) t).1,R*(unit (cosine y i) t).2))).2
    rw [chart_axis2] at h
    change dist (axis y (i+1) (r*R) • y) (circle y R i t • y)-_ ≤ C at h
    rw [show R*(unit (cosine y i) t).2-r*R = R*((unit (cosine y i) t).2-r) by ring,
      sub_zero,vec_mul (cosine y i) R ((unit (cosine y i) t).1,(unit (cosine y i) t).2-r),norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hR0] at h
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn2 hR0]

lemma axis_adjacent {R : ℝ} (hR0 : 0≤R) (i : Fin 6) :
    dist (axis y i R • y) (axis y (i+1) R • y) ≤ R+C := by
  have h := (abs_le.mp (hchart i (R,0) (0,R))).2
  rw [chart_axis1,chart_axis2] at h
  have hs := vec_sq (cosine y i) (cosine_abs hG y hR i) (0-R,R-0)
  have hl := cosine_lower hG y hR i
  have hn : ‖vec (cosine y i) (0-R,R-0)‖ ≤ R := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hl.le) (sq_nonneg R),norm_nonneg (vec (cosine y i) (0-R,R-0))]
  linarith

end Estimates

lemma common_cosine (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 1/2<c ∧ c≤1 ∧ ∀ i, c≤cosine y i := by
  classical
  let c := Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty (cosine y)
  refine ⟨c,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · exact (Finset.lt_inf'_iff _).mpr (fun i _ => cosine_lower hG y hR i)
  · exact (Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin 6))).trans (cosine_le_one hG y hR 0)
  · intro i
    exact Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ i)

lemma circle_detour (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0≤C)
    (hchart : ∀ i p q, |dist (chart y i p • y) (chart y i q • y)-
      ‖vec (cosine y i) (q.1-p.1,q.2-p.2)‖| ≤ C)
    {c r R : ℝ} (hc : ∀ i, c≤cosine y i) (hr : 0≤r) (hR0 : 0≤R)
    (i : Fin 6) {t : ℝ} (ht : t∈Set.Icc 0 1) :
    dist (axis y 0 R • y) (circle y R i t • y) ≤
      (2*Real.sqrt (1+r^2-2*c*r)+r)*R+3*C := by
  have hleft : dist (axis y 0 R • y) (axis y 1 (r*R) • y) ≤ R*Real.sqrt (1+r^2-2*c*r)+C := by
    have h := (circle_axis_chord hG y hR hchart hc hr hR0 0 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)∈Set.Icc 0 1)).2
    simpa only [circle_zero,Fin.reduceAdd,dist_comm] using h
  have hright : dist (axis y 0 R • y) (axis y 5 (r*R) • y) ≤ R*Real.sqrt (1+r^2-2*c*r)+C := by
    have h := (circle_axis_chord hG y hR hchart hc hr hR0 5 (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)∈Set.Icc 0 1)).1
    simpa only [circle_one hG y hR,Fin.reduceAdd,dist_comm] using h
  have h12 := axis_adjacent hG y hR hchart (mul_nonneg hr hR0) 1
  have h45 := axis_adjacent hG y hR hchart (mul_nonneg hr hR0) 4
  have hi := circle_axis_chord hG y hR hchart hc hr hR0 i ht
  rcases hi with ⟨hia,hib⟩
  fin_cases i
  · change dist (axis y 0 R • y) (circle y R 0 t • y) ≤ _
    change dist (axis y 0 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 0 t • y) ≤ _ at hia
    change dist (axis y 1 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 0 t • y) ≤ _ at hib
    have hh := dist_triangle (axis y 0 R • y) (axis y 1 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 0 t • y)
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hr hR0]
  · change dist (axis y 0 R • y) (circle y R 1 t • y) ≤ _
    change dist (axis y 1 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 1 t • y) ≤ _ at hia
    change dist (axis y 2 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 1 t • y) ≤ _ at hib
    have hh := dist_triangle (axis y 0 R • y) (axis y 1 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 1 t • y)
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hr hR0]
  · change dist (axis y 0 R • y) (circle y R 2 t • y) ≤ _
    change dist (axis y 2 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 2 t • y) ≤ _ at hia
    change dist (axis y 3 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 2 t • y) ≤ _ at hib
    have hh := dist_triangle4 (axis y 0 R • y) (axis y 1 (r*R) • y) (axis y 2 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 2 t • y)
    change dist (axis y 1 (r*R) • y) (axis y 2 (r*R) • y) ≤ r*R+C at h12
    nlinarith
  · change dist (axis y 0 R • y) (circle y R 3 t • y) ≤ _
    change dist (axis y 3 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 3 t • y) ≤ _ at hia
    change dist (axis y 4 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 3 t • y) ≤ _ at hib
    have hh := dist_triangle4 (axis y 0 R • y) (axis y 5 (r*R) • y) (axis y 4 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 3 t • y)
    change dist (axis y 4 (r*R) • y) (axis y 5 (r*R) • y) ≤ r*R+C at h45
    rw [dist_comm (axis y 4 (r*R) • y)] at h45
    nlinarith
  · change dist (axis y 0 R • y) (circle y R 4 t • y) ≤ _
    change dist (axis y 4 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 4 t • y) ≤ _ at hia
    change dist (axis y 5 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 4 t • y) ≤ _ at hib
    have hh := dist_triangle (axis y 0 R • y) (axis y 5 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 4 t • y)
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hr hR0]
  · change dist (axis y 0 R • y) (circle y R 5 t • y) ≤ _
    change dist (axis y 5 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 5 t • y) ≤ _ at hia
    change dist (axis y 0 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 5 t • y) ≤ _ at hib
    have hh := dist_triangle (axis y 0 R • y) (axis y 5 (r*R) • y) (circle y R 5 t • y)
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hr hR0]

namespace ArtinCAT0.WordDiagram

lemma eval_surjective : Function.Surjective eval := by
  let H : Subgroup TriangleGroup :=
    { carrier := Set.range eval
      one_mem' := ⟨1,map_one eval⟩
      mul_mem' := by rintro a b ⟨u,rfl⟩ ⟨v,rfl⟩; exact ⟨u*v,map_mul eval u v⟩
      inv_mem' := by rintro a ⟨u,rfl⟩; exact ⟨inverseWord u,eval_inverseWord u⟩ }
  have hh (i : Fin 3) : (PresentedGroup.of i : TriangleGroup) ∈ H := by
    refine ⟨positive i,?_⟩
    simp [positive,eval,signed,triangleGen]
  intro g
  exact PresentedGroup.generated_by triangleRelators H hh g

noncomputable def representative (g : TriangleGroup) : Word := (eval_surjective g).choose
@[simp] lemma eval_representative (g : TriangleGroup) : eval (representative g) = g :=
  (eval_surjective g).choose_spec

section FiniteLibrary
variable {E : Type*} [Fintype E] (e : E → TriangleGroup)

abbrev SmallSide := E × Bool
noncomputable def smallSide (s : SmallSide (E:=E)) : Side := (representative (e s.1),s.2)
def smallFlip (s : SmallSide (E:=E)) : SmallSide (E:=E) := (s.1,!s.2)

omit [Fintype E] in
@[simp] lemma smallSide_flip (s : SmallSide (E:=E)) :
    smallSide e (smallFlip s) = sideFlip (smallSide e s) := rfl

abbrev SmallLoop := {s : Fin 3 → SmallSide (E:=E) // closedSides (smallSide e ∘ s)}

noncomputable instance : Fintype (SmallLoop e) := Fintype.ofFinite _

noncomputable def loopSides (s : SmallLoop e) : Fin 3 → Side := smallSide e ∘ s.val
omit [Fintype E] in
lemma loops_closed (s : SmallLoop e) : closedSides (loopSides e s) := s.property

lemma finite_short_elements (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0≤B) : {g : TriangleGroup | dist y (g•y) ≤ B}.Finite := by
  have h := finite_movers_of_compact hG.2.2.1 (isCompact_singleton : IsCompact ({y}:Set X)) y B hB

variable (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0≤B)
abbrev ShortElement := {g : TriangleGroup // dist y (g•y) ≤ B}
@[instance_reducible] noncomputable def shortElementFintype : Fintype (ShortElement y B) :=
  (finite_short_elements hG y B hB).fintype

omit [ProperSpace X] in
include hG in
lemma action_displacement (g h : TriangleGroup) :
    dist y ((g⁻¹*h)•y) = dist (g•y) (h•y) := (action_dist hG.2.1 y g h).symm

section Orient
variable {F V : Type*} [Fintype F] (M : TriangleMesh F V) (z : V → TriangleGroup)
  (hz : ∀ f i, dist (z (M.tail (f,i))•y) (z (M.tail (f,i+1))•y) ≤ B)

noncomputable def chooseForward (d : F × Fin 3) : Bool := by
  classical
  exact decide (Fintype.equivFin (F × Fin 3) d < Fintype.equivFin (F × Fin 3) (M.mate d))

lemma chooseForward_mate (d : F × Fin 3) : chooseForward M (M.mate d) = !chooseForward M d := by
  classical
  simp only [chooseForward,M.mate_involutive d]
  have hn : Fintype.equivFin (F × Fin 3) d ≠ Fintype.equivFin (F × Fin 3) (M.mate d) :=
    fun h => (M.mate_ne d).symm ((Fintype.equivFin _).injective h)
  by_cases h : Fintype.equivFin (F × Fin 3) d < Fintype.equivFin (F × Fin 3) (M.mate d)
  · simp [h,not_lt.mpr h.le]
  · have h' := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h) hn.symm
    simp [h,h']

noncomputable def orientedSide (d : F × Fin 3) : ShortElement y B × Bool :=
  if chooseForward M d then
    (⟨(z (M.tail d))⁻¹*z (M.tail (d.1,d.2+1)),by rw [action_displacement hG y]; exact hz _ _⟩,false)
  else
    (⟨(z (M.tail (d.1,d.2+1)))⁻¹*z (M.tail d),by
      rw [action_displacement hG y,dist_comm]; exact hz _ _⟩,true)

omit [ProperSpace X] in
lemma orientedSide_mate (d : F × Fin 3) :
    orientedSide hG y B M z hz (M.mate d) = smallFlip (orientedSide hG y B M z hz d) := by
  classical
  unfold orientedSide
  rw [chooseForward_mate]
  have ht := M.tail_mate d
  have hh := M.tail_rotate_mate d
  change M.tail ((M.mate d).1,(M.mate d).2+1) = M.tail d at hh
  cases h : chooseForward M d <;> simp [smallFlip,ht,hh]

omit [ProperSpace X] in
lemma orientedSide_value (d : F × Fin 3) :
    eval (sideWord (smallSide (Subtype.val : ShortElement y B → TriangleGroup)
      (orientedSide hG y B M z hz d))) = (z (M.tail d))⁻¹*z (M.tail (d.1,d.2+1)) := by
  classical
  unfold orientedSide
  cases h : chooseForward M d <;> simp [smallSide,sideWord,mul_inv_rev]

open Complex
abbrev Point := ℝ × ℝ

noncomputable def vec (c : ℝ) (p : Point) : ℂ :=
  (p.1 + c*p.2) + (Real.sqrt (1-c^2)*p.2)*I

@[simp] lemma vec_zero (c : ℝ) : vec c (0,0) = 0 := by simp [vec]
lemma vec_add (c : ℝ) (p q : Point) : vec c (p.1+q.1,p.2+q.2) = vec c p + vec c q := by
  simp only [vec,ofReal_add]
  ring
lemma vec_sub (c : ℝ) (p q : Point) : vec c (p.1-q.1,p.2-q.2) = vec c p - vec c q := by
  simp only [vec,ofReal_sub]
  ring
lemma vec_mul (c a : ℝ) (p : Point) : vec c (a*p.1,a*p.2) = (a : ℂ)*vec c p := by
  simp only [vec,ofReal_mul]
  ring

lemma vec_sq (c : ℝ) (hc : |c| ≤ 1) (p : Point) :
    ‖vec c p‖^2 = p.1^2+p.2^2+2*c*p.1*p.2 := by
  have hcs : 0 ≤ 1-c^2 := by nlinarith [sq_abs c,abs_nonneg c]
  rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  simp only [vec,Complex.normSq_apply,add_re,ofReal_re,mul_re,I_re,ofReal_im,I_im,
    zero_mul,mul_zero,sub_zero,add_zero,add_im,mul_im,zero_add,ofReal_im]
  nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hcs]

lemma vec_basis1 (c : ℝ) : ‖vec c (1,0)‖ = 1 := by simp [vec]
lemma vec_basis2 (c : ℝ) (hc : |c| ≤ 1) : ‖vec c (0,1)‖ = 1 := by
  have h := vec_sq c hc (0,1)
  have hs : ‖vec c (0,1)‖^2 = 1 := by simpa only [zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0),one_pow,mul_zero,zero_mul,zero_add,add_zero] using h
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (vec c (0,1))]

lemma vec_bound (c : ℝ) (hc : |c| ≤ 1) (p : Point) : ‖vec c p‖ ≤ |p.1|+|p.2| := by
  have he : vec c p = (p.1 : ℂ)*vec c (1,0)+(p.2 : ℂ)*vec c (0,1) := by
    simp [vec]
    ring
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(p.1 : ℂ)*vec c (1,0)‖ + ‖(p.2 : ℂ)*vec c (0,1)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = _ := by simp [vec_basis1,vec_basis2 c hc,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs]

lemma vec_lipschitz (c : ℝ) (hc : |c| ≤ 1) (p q : Point) :
    |‖vec c p‖-‖vec c q‖| ≤ |p.1-q.1|+|p.2-q.2| := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖vec c p-vec c q‖ := abs_norm_sub_norm_le _ _
    _ = ‖vec c (p.1-q.1,p.2-q.2)‖ := congrArg norm (vec_sub c p q).symm
    _ ≤ _ := vec_bound c hc _

noncomputable def mixNorm (c t : ℝ) : ℝ := ‖vec c (1-t,t)‖
noncomputable def unit (c t : ℝ) : Point := ((1-t)/mixNorm c t,t/mixNorm c t)

lemma mixNorm_bounds {c t : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    1/2 ≤ mixNorm c t ∧ mixNorm c t ≤ 1 := by
  have hca : |c| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith,hc'⟩
  have hsq := vec_sq c hca (1-t,t)
  have hnon : 0 ≤ mixNorm c t := norm_nonneg _
  constructor
  · have hre : (vec c (1-t,t)).re = 1-t+c*t := by simp [vec]
    have hr := Complex.re_le_norm (vec c (1-t,t))
    rw [hre] at hr
    dsimp only [mixNorm]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hc) ht.1]
  · have h := vec_bound c hca (1-t,t)
    simpa only [mixNorm,abs_of_nonneg ht.1,abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2),sub_add_cancel] using h

lemma unit_vec {c t : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    ‖vec c (unit c t)‖ = 1 := by
  have hm := mixNorm_bounds hc hc' ht
  have hp : 0 < mixNorm c t := by linarith
  simp only [unit,div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [mul_comm (1-t),mul_comm t]
  rw [vec_mul c (mixNorm c t)⁻¹ (1-t,t),norm_mul]
  simp only [Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hp)]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hp)

lemma unit_nonneg {c t : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    0 ≤ (unit c t).1 ∧ 0 ≤ (unit c t).2 := by
  have hm := mixNorm_bounds hc hc' ht
  exact ⟨div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2) (by linarith),div_nonneg ht.1 (by linarith)⟩

lemma unit_sum {c t : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    1 ≤ (unit c t).1+(unit c t).2 ∧ (unit c t).1+(unit c t).2 ≤ 2 := by
  have hm := mixNorm_bounds hc hc' ht
  have hp : 0 < mixNorm c t := by linarith
  change 1 ≤ (1-t)/mixNorm c t+t/mixNorm c t ∧ (1-t)/mixNorm c t+t/mixNorm c t ≤ 2
  rw [← add_div,sub_add_cancel]
  constructor
  · exact (le_div_iff₀ hp).mpr (by linarith)
  · exact (div_le_iff₀ hp).mpr (by linarith)

lemma unit_pairing1 {c t : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    c ≤ (unit c t).1+c*(unit c t).2 := by
  have hm := mixNorm_bounds hc hc' ht
  have hp : 0 < mixNorm c t := by linarith
  change c ≤ (1-t)/mixNorm c t+c*(t/mixNorm c t)
  rw [← mul_div_assoc,← add_div]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hp).mpr
  have h1 : c*mixNorm c t ≤ c := mul_le_of_le_one_right (by linarith) hm.2
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hc') (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2)]

lemma unit_pairing2 {c t : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    c ≤ c*(unit c t).1+(unit c t).2 := by
  have hm := mixNorm_bounds hc hc' ht
  have hp : 0 < mixNorm c t := by linarith
  change c ≤ c*((1-t)/mixNorm c t)+t/mixNorm c t
  rw [← mul_div_assoc,← add_div]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hp).mpr
  have h1 : c*mixNorm c t ≤ c := mul_le_of_le_one_right (by linarith) hm.2
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hc') ht.1]

/-- The short chord needed for the outside cap, with no trigonometry. -/
lemma detour_gap {c : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 < c) (hc' : c ≤ 1) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < 1 ∧ 0 < 1+r^2-2*c*r ∧
      2*Real.sqrt (1+r^2-2*c*r)+r < 2 := by
  let r := (2*c-1)/4
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  have hr1 : r ≤ 1/4 := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  have hpos : 0 < 1+r^2-2*c*r := by nlinarith
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le
  have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (1+r^2-2*c*r)
  have hcR : 4*r = 2*c-1 := by dsimp [r]; ring
  refine ⟨r,hr,by linarith,hpos,?_⟩
  nlinarith

lemma quotient_lipschitz {a b u v : ℝ} (_ha : |a| ≤ 1) (hb : |b| ≤ 1)
    (hu : 1/2 ≤ u) (hv : 1/2 ≤ v) :
    |a/u-b/v| ≤ 2*|a-b|+4*|u-v| := by
  have hup : 0 < u := by linarith
  have hvp : 0 < v := by linarith
  have he : a/u-b/v = (a-b)/u+b*(v-u)/(u*v) := by field_simp; ring
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ |(a-b)/u|+|b*(v-u)/(u*v)| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ = |a-b|/u + |b| * |u-v|/(u*v) := by
      rw [abs_div,abs_div,abs_mul,abs_mul,abs_of_pos hup,abs_of_pos hvp,abs_sub_comm v u]
    _ ≤ 2*|a-b|+4*|u-v| := by
      have h1 : |a-b|/u ≤ 2*|a-b| := (div_le_iff₀ hup).mpr (by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (a-b)])
      have huv : 1/4 ≤ u*v := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hu) (sub_nonneg.mpr hv)]
      have h2 : |b| * |u-v|/(u*v) ≤ 4*|u-v| :=
        (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hup hvp)).mpr (by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (u-v)])
      linarith

lemma mixNorm_lipschitz {c : ℝ} (hc : |c| ≤ 1) (s t : ℝ) :
    |mixNorm c s-mixNorm c t| ≤ 2*|s-t| := by
  have h := vec_lipschitz c hc (1-s,s) (1-t,t)
  have he : (1-s)-(1-t) = -(s-t) := by ring
  simpa only [mixNorm,he,abs_neg,two_mul] using h

lemma unit_lipschitz {c s t : ℝ} (hc : 1/2 ≤ c) (hc' : c ≤ 1)
    (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    |(unit c s).1-(unit c t).1| ≤ 10*|s-t| ∧
    |(unit c s).2-(unit c t).2| ≤ 10*|s-t| := by
  have hms := (mixNorm_bounds hc hc' hs).1
  have hmt := (mixNorm_bounds hc hc' ht).1
  have hca : |c| ≤ 1 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith,hc'⟩
  have hm := mixNorm_lipschitz hca s t
  have h0 := quotient_lipschitz
    (show |1-s| ≤ 1 by rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hs.2)]; linarith [hs.1])
    (show |1-t| ≤ 1 by rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2)]; linarith [ht.1]) hms hmt

variable {G X : Type*} [Group G] [MetricSpace X] [MulAction G X]
  [ProperSpace X] [Nonempty X]

lemma lengthPairing_abs_le (hG : GeometricAction G X) (y : X) {g h : G} (hc : Commute g h) :
    |lengthPairing y g h| ≤ stableLengthAt y g * stableLengthAt y h := by
  by_cases hz : stableLengthAt y g = 0
  · rw [hz,zero_mul,lengthPairing_zero_of_length_zero hG.1 hG.2.1 y hc hz,abs_zero]
  · have hp : 0 < stableLengthAt y g := lt_of_le_of_ne (stableLength_nonneg hG.2.1 y g) (Ne.symm hz)
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := exists_displacement_minimizer hG g
    have hxL : dist x (g • x) = stableLengthAt y g := by
      rw [← stableLength_minimizer hG.1 hG.2.1 g hx]
      exact stableLength_basepoint hG.2.1 x y g
    have ha (n : ℕ) : dist x ((g^n) • x) = n*stableLengthAt y g := by
      rw [minimizer_displacement_pow hG.1 hG.2.1 g hx,hxL]
    rw [← lengthPairing_basepoint hG.2.1 x y g h,
      lengthPairing_eq_orbitCharacter hG.1 hG.2.1 x g _ hp ha
        (stableLength_basepoint hG.2.1 x y g) hc,abs_mul,abs_of_pos hp]
    rw [← stableLength_basepoint hG.2.1 x y h]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (orbitCharacter_abs_le hG.1 hG.2.1 x g _ hp ha hc) hp.le

end PairingCauchy

section BraidThree
variable {G : Type*} [Group G] {a b : G}

def twoBraid (a b : G) (i : ℕ) : G := if i = 0 then a else b
lemma twoBraid_relations (h : a*b*a = b*a*b) : BraidRelations 2 (twoBraid a b) := by
  constructor
  · intro i hi
    have he : i = 0 := by omega
    subst i
    simpa [twoBraid] using h
  · intro i j hi hj hij
    omega

lemma braid_three_commute (h : a*b*a = b*a*b) : Commute a ((a*b)^3) ∧ Commute b ((a*b)^3) := by
  have hc (i : ℕ) (hi : i < 2) := braidCenter_commute (twoBraid_relations h) (by omega : 2 ≤ 2) hi
  have he : braidCenter (twoBraid a b) 2 = (a*b)^3 := by
    simpa [twoBraid] using braidCenter_two (s := twoBraid a b) (by simpa [twoBraid] using h)
  exact ⟨by simpa [he,twoBraid] using hc 0 (by decide),
    by simpa [he,twoBraid] using hc 1 (by decide)⟩

variable {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [MulAction G X] [ProperSpace X] [Nonempty X]
lemma braid_three_pairing (hG : GeometricAction G X) (y : X) (h : a*b*a = b*a*b) :
    lengthPairing y (a^2) ((a*b)^3) = stableLengthAt y ((a*b)^3)^2/3 ∧
    lengthPairing y (b^2) ((a*b)^3) = stableLengthAt y ((a*b)^3)^2/3 := by
  have hs := twoBraid_relations h
  have he : braidCenter (twoBraid a b) 2 = (a*b)^3 := by
    simpa [twoBraid] using braidCenter_two (s := twoBraid a b) (by simpa [twoBraid] using h)
  have h0 := braidCenter_length_sq hG y hs (by omega : 2 ≤ 2) (by decide : 0 < 2)
  have h1 := braidCenter_length_sq hG y hs (by omega : 2 ≤ 2) (by decide : 1 < 2)
  simp only [he,twoBraid,ite_true,show ¬(1 = (0 : ℕ)) by decide,ite_false] at h0 h1
  have hc := braid_three_commute h
  rw [lengthPairing_pow_left hG.1 hG.2.1 y hc.1,
    lengthPairing_pow_left hG.1 hG.2.1 y hc.2]
  norm_num at h0 h1 ⊢
  constructor <;> linarith
end BraidThree

namespace SixSector

def ray (i : Fin 6) : TriangleGroup :=
  if i.val % 2 = 0 then triangleGen ⟨i.val/2,by omega⟩ ^ 2
    else triangleH ⟨i.val/2,by omega⟩ ^ 3

lemma ray_even (i : Fin 3) : ray ⟨2*i.val,by omega⟩ = triangleGen i ^ 2 := by
  simp only [ray,Nat.mul_mod_right,ite_true]
  congr 2
  apply Fin.ext
  change 2*i.val/2 = i.val
  omega
lemma ray_odd (i : Fin 3) : ray ⟨2*i.val+1,by omega⟩ = triangleH i ^ 3 := by
  simp only [ray,show (2*i.val+1)%2 = 1 by omega,show ¬(1 = (0 : ℕ)) by decide,ite_false]
  congr 2
  apply Fin.ext
  change (2*i.val+1)/2 = i.val
  omega

lemma ray_commute (i : Fin 6) : Commute (ray i) (ray (i+1)) := by
  have h0 := braid_three_commute (triangle_braid 0)
  have h1 := braid_three_commute (triangle_braid 1)
  have h2 := braid_three_commute (triangle_braid 2)
  fin_cases i
  · exact h0.1.pow_left 2
  · exact (h0.2.pow_left 2).symm
  · exact h1.1.pow_left 2
  · exact (h1.2.pow_left 2).symm
  · exact h2.1.pow_left 2
  · exact (h2.2.pow_left 2).symm

section Action
variable {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [MulAction TriangleGroup X] [ProperSpace X] [Nonempty X]

lemma generator_square_length_pos (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (i : Fin 3) :
    0 < stableLengthAt y (triangleGen i ^ 2) := by
  have hp : 0 < stableLengthAt y (triangleGen i) := by
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne (stableLength_nonneg hG.2.1 y _)
    intro h
    exact triangle_generator_infinite_order i ((stableLength_eq_zero_iff_finiteOrder hG y _).mp h.symm)
  rw [stableLength_pow hG.2.1]
  positivity

omit [ProperSpace X] [Nonempty X] in
lemma adjacent_square_length (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (i : Fin 3) :
    stableLengthAt y (triangleGen (i+1)^2) = stableLengthAt y (triangleGen i^2) := by
  rw [stableLength_pow hG.2.1,stableLength_pow hG.2.1,← braid_conjugate (triangle_braid i),
    stableLength_conjugate hG.2.1]

def StrictRatios (y : X) : Prop := ∀ i : Fin 3,
  (1 : ℝ)/2 < stableLengthAt y (triangleH i^3)/(3*stableLengthAt y (triangleGen i^2))

lemma ray_length_pos (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y) (i : Fin 6) :
    0 < stableLengthAt y (ray i) := by
  have he k := generator_square_length_pos hG y k
  have ho k : 0 < stableLengthAt y (triangleH k^3) := by
    have h := (lt_div_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) (generator_square_length_pos hG y k) : 0 < 3*stableLengthAt y (triangleGen k^2))).mp (hR k)
    linarith [he k]
  fin_cases i
  · exact he 0
  · exact ho 0
  · exact he 1
  · exact ho 1
  · exact he 2
  · exact ho 2

noncomputable def cosine (y : X) (i : Fin 6) : ℝ :=
  lengthPairing y (ray i) (ray (i+1))/(stableLengthAt y (ray i)*stableLengthAt y (ray (i+1)))

lemma cosine_lower (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y) (i : Fin 6) :
    1/2 < cosine y i := by
  have hL k := ray_length_pos hG y hR k
  have hc (k : Fin 3) :
      lengthPairing y (triangleGen k^2) (triangleH k^3) = stableLengthAt y (triangleH k^3)^2/3 ∧
      lengthPairing y (triangleGen (k+1)^2) (triangleH k^3) = stableLengthAt y (triangleH k^3)^2/3 :=
    braid_three_pairing hG y (triangle_braid k)
  have hcomm (k : Fin 3) : Commute (triangleH k^3) (triangleGen (k+1)^2) :=
    ((braid_three_commute (triangle_braid k)).2.pow_left 2).symm
  have hp (k : Fin 3) : 3*stableLengthAt y (triangleGen k^2)/2 < stableLengthAt y (triangleH k^3) := by
    have h := (lt_div_iff₀ (mul_pos (by norm_num) (generator_square_length_pos hG y k) : 0 < 3*stableLengthAt y (triangleGen k^2))).mp (hR k)
    linarith
  have hnext k := adjacent_square_length hG y k
  unfold cosine
  apply (lt_div_iff₀ (mul_pos (hL i) (hL (i+1)))).mpr
  have hpair (k : Fin 3) :
      stableLengthAt y (triangleGen k^2)*stableLengthAt y (triangleH k^3)/2 <
        stableLengthAt y (triangleH k^3)^2/3 := by
    have hz := ray_length_pos hG y hR ⟨2*k.val+1,by omega⟩
    rw [ray_odd] at hz
    nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (hp k)) hz]
  fin_cases i
  · change 1/2*(stableLengthAt y (triangleGen 0^2)*stableLengthAt y (triangleH 0^3)) <
      lengthPairing y (triangleGen 0^2) (triangleH 0^3)
    rw [(hc 0).1]
    linarith [hpair 0]
  · change 1/2*(stableLengthAt y (triangleH 0^3)*stableLengthAt y (triangleGen (0+1)^2)) <
      lengthPairing y (triangleH 0^3) (triangleGen (0+1)^2)
    rw [lengthPairing_symmetric y (hcomm 0),
      (hc 0).2,hnext 0]
    nlinarith [hpair 0]
  · change 1/2*(stableLengthAt y (triangleGen 1^2)*stableLengthAt y (triangleH 1^3)) <
      lengthPairing y (triangleGen 1^2) (triangleH 1^3)
    rw [(hc 1).1]
    linarith [hpair 1]
  · change 1/2*(stableLengthAt y (triangleH 1^3)*stableLengthAt y (triangleGen (1+1)^2)) <
      lengthPairing y (triangleH 1^3) (triangleGen (1+1)^2)
    rw [lengthPairing_symmetric y (hcomm 1),
      (hc 1).2,hnext 1]
    nlinarith [hpair 1]
  · change 1/2*(stableLengthAt y (triangleGen 2^2)*stableLengthAt y (triangleH 2^3)) <
      lengthPairing y (triangleGen 2^2) (triangleH 2^3)
    rw [(hc 2).1]
    linarith [hpair 2]
  · change 1/2*(stableLengthAt y (triangleH 2^3)*stableLengthAt y (triangleGen (2+1)^2)) <
      lengthPairing y (triangleH 2^3) (triangleGen (2+1)^2)
    rw [lengthPairing_symmetric y (hcomm 2),
      (hc 2).2,hnext 2]
    nlinarith [hpair 2]

lemma cosine_le_one (hG : GeometricAction TriangleGroup X) (y : X) (hR : StrictRatios y) (i : Fin 6) :
    cosine y i ≤ 1 := by
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos (ray_length_pos hG y hR i) (ray_length_pos hG y hR (i+1)))).mpr
  simpa only [one_mul] using
    (le_abs_self (lengthPairing y (ray i) (ray (i+1)))).trans (lengthPairing_abs_le hG y (ray_commute i))

lemma floor_error {L : ℝ} (hL : 0<L) (x : ℝ) :

  have h2 : x/L < (⌊x/L⌋ : ℝ)+1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _

  have h4 := (div_lt_iff₀ hL).mp h2

lemma powers_difference {g h : G} (hc : Commute g h) (i j k l : ℤ) :
    (g^i*h^j)⁻¹*(g^k*h^l) = g^(k-i)*h^(l-j) := by
  calc
    _ = h^(-j) * g^(k-i) * h^l := by simp only [zpow_sub,zpow_neg]; group
    _ = g^(k-i) * h^(-j) * h^l := by rw [(hc.zpow_zpow (k-i) (-j)).eq]
    _ = _ := by simp only [zpow_sub,zpow_neg]; group

lemma lattice_length (hG : GeometricAction G X) (y : X) {g h : G}
    (hcomm : Commute g h) {c : ℝ} (hc : |c| ≤ 1)
    (hp : lengthPairing y g h = c*stableLengthAt y g*stableLengthAt y h) (i j : ℤ) :
    stableLengthAt y (g^i*h^j) =
      ‖vec c ((i:ℝ)*stableLengthAt y g,(j:ℝ)*stableLengthAt y h)‖ := by
  have he := stableLength_product_sq y (g^i) (h^j)
  rw [stableLength_zpow hG.2.1,stableLength_zpow hG.2.1,
    lengthPairing_zpow_left hG.1 hG.2.1 y (hcomm.zpow_right j),
    lengthPairing_zpow_right hG.1 hG.2.1 y hcomm,hp] at he
  have hv := vec_sq c hc ((i:ℝ)*stableLengthAt y g,(j:ℝ)*stableLengthAt y h)
  have hsq : stableLengthAt y (g^i*h^j)^2 =
      ‖vec c ((i:ℝ)*stableLengthAt y g,(j:ℝ)*stableLengthAt y h)‖^2 := by
    rw [he,hv]
    simp only [mul_pow,sq_abs]
    ring
  nlinarith [stableLength_nonneg hG.2.1 y (g^i*h^j),
    norm_nonneg (vec c ((i:ℝ)*stableLengthAt y g,(j:ℝ)*stableLengthAt y h))]

/-- Strict exponent gaps absorb every fixed multiplicative constant. -/
lemma eventually_power_le {s t : ℝ} (hst : s < t) (C : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, C * (N : ℝ) ^ s ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ t := by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (N : ℝ) ^ (t - s)) atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_rpow_atTop (sub_pos.2 hst)).comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually_ge_atTop C, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN h1
  have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < N by omega)
  calc
    C * (N : ℝ) ^ s ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (t - s) * (N : ℝ) ^ s :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN (Real.rpow_nonneg hN0.le _)
    _ = (N : ℝ) ^ t := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hN0]; congr 1; ring

/-- The same strict gap absorbs a logarithm, with no change to the exponent. -/
lemma eventually_power_log_le {s t : ℝ} (hst : s < t) (C : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, C * (N : ℝ) ^ s * Real.log N ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ t := by
  have h := ((isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop (sub_pos.2 hst)).const_mul_left C).bound
    (c := 1) zero_lt_one
  have hn := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.eventually h
  filter_upwards [hn, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN h1
  have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < N by omega)
  have hbound : C * Real.log N ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (t - s) := by
    have hN' : |C * Real.log N| ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (t - s) := by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, one_mul,
        abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hN0.le (t - s))] using hN
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans hN'
  calc
    C * (N : ℝ) ^ s * Real.log N = (C * Real.log N) * (N : ℝ) ^ s := by ring
    _ ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (t - s) * (N : ℝ) ^ s :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbound (Real.rpow_nonneg hN0.le _)
    _ = (N : ℝ) ^ t := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hN0]; congr 1; ring

lemma ceil_rpow_bounds {N : ℕ} {a : ℝ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (N : ℝ) ^ a ≤ (⌈(N : ℝ) ^ a⌉₊ : ℝ) ∧
    (⌈(N : ℝ) ^ a⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ a := by
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hp1 : 1 ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ a := Real.one_le_rpow h1 ha
  constructor
  · exact Nat.le_ceil _
  · have h := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg N) a)
    linarith

lemma ceil_rpow_log {N : ℕ} {b : ℝ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    Real.log (⌈(N : ℝ) ^ b⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ (b + 1) * Real.log N := by
  have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < N by omega)
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hbounds := ceil_rpow_bounds (show 1 ≤ N by omega) hb
  have hceil0 : (0 : ℝ) < ⌈(N : ℝ) ^ b⌉₊ :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hN0 _) hbounds.1
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.log (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ b) := Real.log_le_log hceil0 hbounds.2
    _ = Real.log 2 + b * Real.log N := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hN0 _)),
        Real.log_rpow hN0]
    _ ≤ (b + 1) * Real.log N := by
      have := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) h2
      nlinarith


lemma approx_weight_exp {N r k : ℕ} {v u : ℝ} (hN : 6 ≤ N)
    (hsum : (r : ℝ) + k ≤ 4 * (N : ℝ) ^ v)
    (hcostN : 8 * (N : ℝ) ^ v * Real.log N ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ u) :
    (1 + (N : ℝ)) ^ r * (7 + 4 * (N : ℝ)) ^ k ≤ Real.exp ((N : ℝ) ^ u) := by
  have hN6R : (6 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hlogN : 0 ≤ Real.log N := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hlog1 : Real.log (1 + (N : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * Real.log N := by
    have h := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : 0 < 1 + (N : ℝ))
      (show 1 + (N : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ 2 by nlinarith only [hN6R])
    simpa only [Real.log_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using h
  have hlog2 : Real.log (7 + 4 * (N : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * Real.log N := by
    have h := Real.log_le_log (by positivity : 0 < 7 + 4 * (N : ℝ))
      (show 7 + 4 * (N : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ 2 by nlinarith only [hN6R])
    simpa only [Real.log_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using h
  have hcost : (r : ℝ) * Real.log (1 + (N : ℝ)) +
      (k : ℝ) * Real.log (7 + 4 * (N : ℝ)) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ u := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (r : ℝ) * (2 * Real.log N) + (k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.log N) :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog1 (Nat.cast_nonneg r))
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog2 (Nat.cast_nonneg k))
      _ ≤ 8 * (N : ℝ) ^ v * Real.log N := by
        nlinarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsum hlogN]
      _ ≤ _ := hcostN
  calc
    _ = Real.exp ((r : ℝ) * Real.log (1 + (N : ℝ)) +
        (k : ℝ) * Real.log (7 + 4 * (N : ℝ))) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_nat_mul,
        Real.exp_log (by positivity), Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
    _ ≤ _ := Real.exp_le_exp.2 hcost

lemma approx_decay_exp {r : ℕ} {m z : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hm : 1 ≤ Real.log m)
    (hz : z ≤ r) : 2 * Real.exp (-(3 * (r : ℝ) * Real.log m)) ≤ Real.exp (-z) := by
  have hr1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp 1 * Real.exp (-(3 * (r : ℝ) * Real.log m)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Real.exp_nonneg _)
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp 1
      norm_num at this ⊢
      exact this
    _ = Real.exp (1 - 3 * (r : ℝ) * Real.log m) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
      nlinarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm (Nat.cast_nonneg r), hz, hr1]

lemma ceil_approx_condition {N : ℕ} {a b v : ℝ} (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hv : 0 ≤ v)
    (hkN : (8 * (b + 1)) * (N : ℝ) ^ ((a + b) / 2) * Real.log N ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ v) :
    4 * (⌈(N : ℝ) ^ a⌉₊ : ℝ) * Real.log (⌈(N : ℝ) ^ b⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤
      (⌈(N : ℝ) ^ v⌉₊ : ℝ) *
        Real.sqrt ((⌈(N : ℝ) ^ a⌉₊ : ℝ) / (⌈(N : ℝ) ^ b⌉₊ : ℝ)) := by
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ N := by omega
  have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < N by omega)
  let r := ⌈(N : ℝ) ^ a⌉₊
  let m := ⌈(N : ℝ) ^ b⌉₊
  let k := ⌈(N : ℝ) ^ v⌉₊
  have hrap := ceil_rpow_bounds hN1 ha
  have hmbp := ceil_rpow_bounds hN1 hb
  have hkvp := ceil_rpow_bounds hN1 hv
  have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) < m := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hN0 _) hmbp.1
  have hlogm := ceil_rpow_log hN hb
  have hsquare : ((N : ℝ) ^ ((a + b) / 2)) ^ 2 = (N : ℝ) ^ a * (N : ℝ) ^ b := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hN0.le, ← Real.rpow_add hN0]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((r : ℝ) * m) ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ ((a + b) / 2) := by
    apply (Real.sqrt_le_left (by positivity)).2
    have hmul := mul_le_mul hrap.2 hmbp.2 (Nat.cast_nonneg m)
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ a)
    rw [mul_pow, hsquare]
    nlinarith only [hmul]
  have hksqrt : 4 * Real.sqrt ((r : ℝ) * m) * Real.log m ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 4 * (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ ((a + b) / 2)) * ((b + 1) * Real.log N) := by
        apply mul_le_mul _ hlogm (by positivity) (by positivity)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqrt (by norm_num)
      _ = (8 * (b + 1)) * (N : ℝ) ^ ((a + b) / 2) * Real.log N := by ring
      _ ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ v := hkN
      _ ≤ (k : ℝ) := hkvp.1
  have hsqrtmul : Real.sqrt ((r : ℝ) * m) * Real.sqrt ((r : ℝ) / m) = r := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), show (r : ℝ) * m * ((r : ℝ) / m) = (r : ℝ)^2 by
      field_simp, Real.sqrt_sq (Nat.cast_nonneg r)]
  calc
    _ = (4 * Real.sqrt ((r : ℝ) * m) * Real.log m) * Real.sqrt ((r : ℝ) / m) := by
      calc
        _ = 4 * Real.log m * (Real.sqrt ((r : ℝ) * m) * Real.sqrt ((r : ℝ) / m)) := by
          rw [hsqrtmul]; ring
        _ = _ := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hksqrt (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

lemma conjugate_finset_sum {A ι : Type*} [CStarAlgebra A] (U : A) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → A) :
    conjugate U (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, conjugate U (f i) := by

lemma Count.polynomial_norm_le {N : ℕ} (D : Count N) (p : Polynomial ℝ) :
    ‖D.polynomial p‖ ≤ weight N p := by
  classical
  rw [D.polynomial_eq_sum]
  apply (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
  change (∑ k ∈ p.support, ‖p.coeff k • D.operator^k‖) ≤ ∑ k ∈ p.support, |p.coeff k| *(N:ℝ)^k
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro k _
  rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg _)
  exact (norm_pow_le _ _).trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) D.operator_norm_le _)

lemma Count.monomial_transition {N : ℕ} (D M : Count N) (U : Operator N) (r μ δ : ℝ)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (k : ℕ) (hk : (k:ℝ) ≤ μ)
    (hA : ∀ A : Count N, (A.support.card:ℝ) ≤ μ →
      ‖M.high r*conjugate U A.zero*M.zero‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖M.high r*conjugate U (D.operator^k)*M.zero‖ ≤ (N:ℝ)^k*δ := by
  rw [D.operator_monomials,conjugate_list_sum,← List.sum_map_mul_left,← List.sum_map_mul_right]
  have h := list_norm_sum_le_const (selectionSets D.support k)
    (fun F => M.high r*conjugate U ((D.flip D.support).restrict F).zero*M.zero) δ (by
      intro F hF
      apply hA
      have hc := ((D.flip D.support).restrict_support_card F).trans (selectionSets_card _ _ F hF)
      exact (show (((D.flip D.support).restrict F).support.card:ℝ) ≤ k by exact_mod_cast hc).trans hk)
  apply h.trans
  rw [selectionSets_length]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hδ
  exact_mod_cast Nat.pow_le_pow_left (show D.support.card ≤ N by simpa using Finset.card_le_univ D.support) k

lemma Count.polynomial_transition {N : ℕ} (D M : Count N) (U : Operator N)
    (p : Polynomial ℝ) (r μ δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hp : (p.natDegree:ℝ) ≤ μ)
    (hA : ∀ A : Count N, (A.support.card:ℝ) ≤ μ →
      ‖M.high r*conjugate U A.zero*M.zero‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖M.high r*conjugate U (D.polynomial p)*M.zero‖ ≤ weight N p*δ := by
  classical
  rw [D.polynomial_eq_sum,conjugate_finset_sum,Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_mul]
  simp only [conjugate_smul,mul_smul_comm,smul_mul_assoc]
  apply (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
  change (∑ k ∈ p.support, ‖p.coeff k • (M.high r*conjugate U (D.operator^k)*M.zero)‖) ≤
    (∑ k ∈ p.support, |p.coeff k| *(N:ℝ)^k)*δ
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro k hk
  rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [mul_assoc (|p.coeff k|) ((N:ℝ)^k)]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg _)
  apply D.monomial_transition M U r μ δ hδ k _ hA
  exact (show (k:ℝ) ≤ p.natDegree by exact_mod_cast Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_mem_supp k hk).trans hp

lemma rankOne_sandwich (v w : Bit → ℂ) :
    rankOne v * rankOne w * rankOne v =
      Complex.normSq (star w ⬝ᵥ v) • rankOne v := by
  ext i j
  simp only [rankOne, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.smul_apply,
    Complex.real_smul, ← Complex.mul_conj, dotProduct, Pi.star_apply,
    Fin.sum_univ_two, map_add, map_mul, Complex.conj_conj, Complex.star_def]
  ring

open scoped MatrixOrder in
lemma rankOne_markov_le (v w : Bit → ℂ)
    (hv : ∑ b, Complex.normSq (v b) = 1)
    (hw : ∑ b, Complex.normSq (w b) = 1) :
    rankOne v * rankOne w * ((2:ℝ) • (1 - rankOne v) + rankOne v) * rankOne w * rankOne v ≤ 1 := by
  let P := rankOne v
  let Q := rankOne w
  let c : ℝ := Complex.normSq (star w ⬝ᵥ v)
  have hP := rankOne_projection hv
  have hQ := rankOne_projection hw
  have hPQ : P * Q * P = c • P := rankOne_sandwich v w
  have hid : P * Q * ((2:ℝ) • (1 - P) + P) * Q * P = (2*c-c^2) • P := by
    have h1 : P * Q * Q * P = c • P := by rw [mul_assoc P Q Q, hQ.isIdempotentElem.eq, hPQ]
    have h2 : P * Q * P * Q * P = c^2 • P := by
      rw [hPQ, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc, hPQ, smul_smul, pow_two]
    calc
      _ = (2:ℝ) • (P * Q * Q * P) - P * Q * P * Q * P := by
        simp only [two_smul, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_one]
        abel
      _ = _ := by rw [h1, h2, smul_smul, ← sub_smul]
  change P * Q * ((2:ℝ) • (1 - P) + P) * Q * P ≤ 1
  rw [hid]
  apply sub_nonneg.mp
  have heq : 1 - (2*c-c^2) • P = (1-P) + (1-c)^2 • P := by
    have hc : (1-c)^2 = 1-(2*c-c^2) := by ring
    simp only [hc, sub_smul, one_smul]
    abel
  rw [heq]
  exact add_nonneg hP.one_sub.nonneg (smul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hP.nonneg)

lemma tensorMatrix_pattern_scale {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) (F : Finset (Fin N))
    (hF : F ⊆ M.support) (z : ℝ) :
    tensorMatrix (fun i => if i ∈ M.support then
      (if i ∈ F then z • (1 - rankOne (M.vector i)) else rankOne (M.vector i)) else 1) =
      z ^ F.card • M.pattern F := by
  classical
  have heq : (fun i => if i ∈ M.support then
      (if i ∈ F then z • (1 - rankOne (M.vector i)) else rankOne (M.vector i)) else 1) =
      (fun i => (if i ∈ F then z else 1) •
        (if i ∈ M.support then (if i ∈ F then 1 - rankOne (M.vector i) else rankOne (M.vector i)) else 1)) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hiF : i ∈ F
    · simp [hiF, hF hiF]
    · simp [hiF]
  rw [heq, tensorMatrix_smul]
  congr 1
  simp

/-- The generating function of the mismatch spectral partition. -/
lemma Count.spectral_power_tensor {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) (z : ℝ) :
    (∑ F ∈ M.support.powerset, z ^ F.card • M.pattern F) =
      tensorMatrix (fun i => if i ∈ M.support then
        z • (1 - rankOne (M.vector i)) + rankOne (M.vector i) else 1) := by
  classical
  rw [← tensorMatrix_sum_patterns M.support]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro F hF
  exact (tensorMatrix_pattern_scale M F (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hF) z).symm

open scoped MatrixOrder in
lemma Count.high_le_generating {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) (r : ℝ) :
    M.high r ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-r) •
      (∑ F ∈ M.support.powerset, (2 : ℝ)^F.card • M.pattern F) := by
  classical
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  unfold Count.high
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro F _
  rw [smul_smul]
  by_cases hr : r ≤ F.card
  · rw [ite_eq_left hr]
    nth_rw 1 [← one_smul ℝ (M.pattern F)]
    apply smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right _ (M.pattern_projection F).nonneg
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)]
    exact Real.one_le_rpow (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  · rw [ite_eq_right hr]
    exact smul_nonneg (by positivity) (M.pattern_projection F).nonneg


/-- Single-site factor of a product projection. -/
def Count.site {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) (i : Fin N) : QubitOperator :=
  if i ∈ M.support then rankOne (M.vector i) else 1

lemma Count.site_projection {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) (i : Fin N) : IsStarProjection (M.site i) := by
  classical
  dsimp [Count.site]
  split_ifs with hi
  · exact rankOne_projection (M.normalized i hi)
  · exact IsStarProjection.one _

open scoped MatrixOrder in
lemma projection_markov_nonneg {A : Type*} [Ring A] [StarRing A] [PartialOrder A]
    [StarOrderedRing A] [Algebra ℝ A] [IsOrderedModule ℝ A]
    (P Q : A) (hP : IsStarProjection P) (hQ : IsStarProjection Q) :
    0 ≤ P * Q * ((2:ℝ) • (1-P)+P) * Q * P := by
  have hn : 0 ≤ (2:ℝ) • (1-P)+P :=
    add_nonneg (smul_nonneg (by norm_num) hP.one_sub.nonneg) hP.nonneg
  simpa only [star_mul, hQ.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq, hP.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq, mul_assoc] using
    star_right_conjugate_nonneg hn (P*Q)

lemma projection_markov_self {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Module ℝ A] [SMulCommClass ℝ A A]
    {P : A} (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) : P * ((2:ℝ) • (1-P)+P) * P = P := by
  have hc : P * (1-P) = 0 := by rw [mul_sub,mul_one,hP.eq,sub_self]
  simp only [mul_add, mul_smul_comm, hc, smul_zero, zero_add, hP.eq]

open scoped MatrixOrder in
lemma Count.markov_site_le {N : ℕ} (M D : Count N) (i : Fin N) :
    M.site i * D.site i * ((2:ℝ) • (1-M.site i)+M.site i) * D.site i * M.site i ≤ 1 := by
  classical
  by_cases hM : i ∈ M.support
  · by_cases hD : i ∈ D.support
    · simp only [Count.site, ite_eq_left hM, ite_eq_left hD]
      exact rankOne_markov_le _ _ (M.normalized i hM) (D.normalized i hD)
    · simp only [Count.site, ite_eq_left hM, ite_eq_right hD, mul_one]
      rw [projection_markov_self (rankOne_projection (M.normalized i hM)).isIdempotentElem]
      exact (rankOne_projection (M.normalized i hM)).le_one
  · have heq : M.site i = 1 := ite_eq_right hM
    rw [heq]
    simp only [sub_self, smul_zero, zero_add, one_mul, mul_one,
      (D.site_projection i).isIdempotentElem.eq]
    exact (D.site_projection i).le_one

lemma Count.generating_eq_sites {N : ℕ} (M : Count N) :
    (∑ F ∈ M.support.powerset, (2 : ℝ)^F.card • M.pattern F) =
      tensorMatrix (fun i => (2:ℝ) • (1-M.site i)+M.site i) := by
  classical
  rw [M.spectral_power_tensor]
  congr 1
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i ∈ M.support <;> simp [Count.site,hi]

open scoped MatrixOrder in
lemma Count.markov_sandwich_le {N : ℕ} (M D : Count N) :
    M.zero * D.zero * (∑ F ∈ M.support.powerset, (2 : ℝ)^F.card • M.pattern F) *
      D.zero * M.zero ≤ 1 := by
  rw [M.generating_eq_sites]
  change tensorMatrix M.site * tensorMatrix D.site *
    tensorMatrix (fun i => (2:ℝ) • (1-M.site i)+M.site i) *
    tensorMatrix D.site * tensorMatrix M.site ≤ 1

/-- The uniform estimate, with the eventual quantifier outside all circuit data. -/
def UniformLocalization (d : ℕ) (s t : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ∀ U : Operator N, IsCircuit d U → ∀ M D : Count N,
    ‖M.high ((N:ℝ)^t)*conjugate U D.zero*M.zero‖ ≤ Real.exp (-((N:ℝ)^s))

lemma uniform_zero {s t : ℝ} (hst : s < t) : UniformLocalization 0 s t := by
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  filter_upwards [eventually_power_le hst (2/Real.log 2)] with N hN
  intro U hU M D
  obtain ⟨L,rfl⟩ := hU
  have hb := M.depth_zero_bound (D.rotate L) ((N:ℝ)^t)
  rw [D.rotate_zero L] at hb
  apply hb.trans
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  have h := (div_le_iff₀ hlog).mp (show 2*(N:ℝ)^s/Real.log 2 ≤ (N:ℝ)^t by
    simpa only [div_mul_eq_mul_div] using hN)
  nlinarith only [h]

lemma uniform_large (d : ℕ) {s t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) : UniformLocalization d s t := by
  filter_upwards [eventually_power_le ht 2,Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN hN1
  intro U _ M D
  have hNpos : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < N by omega)
  have hlimit : (N:ℝ) < (N:ℝ)^t := by rw [Real.rpow_one] at hN; linarith only [hN,hNpos]
  rw [M.high_eq_zero hlimit,zero_mul,zero_mul,norm_zero]
  exact (Real.exp_pos _).le

lemma uniform_low_propagation {d : ℕ}
    (ih : ∀ s t : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s < t → UniformLocalization d s t)
    {a s t : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (_hs : 0 ≤ s) (hat : a < t) (hst : s < t) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ∀ U : Operator N, IsCircuit d U → ∀ M D : Count N,
      ‖M.high ((N:ℝ)^t)*conjugate U D.zero*M.low ((N:ℝ)^a)‖ ≤ Real.exp (-((N:ℝ)^s)) := by
  obtain ⟨v,hv,hvt⟩ := exists_between (max_lt hat hst)
  have hav : a < v := (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hv
  have hsv : s < v := (le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hv
  obtain ⟨q,hvq,hqt⟩ := exists_between hvt
  filter_upwards [ih v q (ha.trans hav.le) hvq,
    eventually_two_powers_le hqt hat,eventually_pattern_cost ha hav hsv,
    Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 1] with N hN hp hc hN1
  intro U hU M D
  exact (M.low_propagation_bound (conjugate U D.zero) hN1 (Real.exp_pos _).le hp
    (fun K => hN U hU K D)).trans hc

lemma uniform_small_support {d : ℕ}
    (ih : ∀ s t : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s < t → UniformLocalization d s t)
    {u w t : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (_hw : 0 ≤ w) (hut : u < t) (hwt : w < t) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ∀ U : Operator N, IsCircuit (d+1) U → ∀ M A : Count N,
      (A.support.card:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ)^u →
      ‖M.high ((N:ℝ)^t)*conjugate U A.zero*M.zero‖ ≤ Real.exp (-((N:ℝ)^w)) := by

/-- The measured zero-outcome projector is a product projection on one qubit. -/
def outputZeroCount {N : ℕ} (out : Fin N) : Count N where
  support := {out}
  vector _ := basisVector 0
  normalized _ _ := basisVector_normalized 0

lemma outputZeroCount_diagonal {N : ℕ} (out : Fin N) :
    (outputZeroCount out).zero = Matrix.diagonal (fun z => if z out=0 then 1 else 0) := by
  classical
  have hloc : (fun i : Fin N => if i=out then rankOne (basisVector 0) else (1:QubitOperator)) =
      fun i => Matrix.diagonal (fun b => if i=out → b=0 then (1:ℂ) else 0) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hi : i=out
    · simp [hi,rankOne_basis_diagonal]
    · simp [hi,Matrix.diagonal_one]
  simp only [Count.zero,outputZeroCount,Finset.mem_singleton]
  rw [hloc,tensorMatrix_diagonal]
  congr 1
  funext z
  rw [Fintype.prod_boole]
  simp

/-- Born probability for an arbitrary fixed input basis state. -/
def outputProbability {N : ℕ} (W : Operator N) (out : Fin N) (b : Bit) (z : Word N) : ℝ :=
  ∑ y, if y out=b then Complex.normSq (W y z) else 0

lemma born_zero_diagonal {N : ℕ} (W : Operator N) (out : Fin N) (z : Word N) :
    (star W*(outputZeroCount out).zero*W) z z = (outputProbability W out 0 z:ℂ) := by
  classical
  rw [outputZeroCount_diagonal,Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal,Matrix.star_apply,outputProbability,Complex.ofReal_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y _
  by_cases hy : y out=0
  · simp only [ite_eq_left hy,mul_one,Complex.star_def,← Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]
  · simp [hy]

lemma total_born_probability {N : ℕ} (W : Operator N) (hW : W ∈ unitary (Operator N))
    (z : Word N) : (∑ y, Complex.normSq (W y z))=1 := by
  apply Complex.ofReal_injective
  have h := congrArg (fun A : Operator N => A z z) (Unitary.star_mul_self_of_mem hW)
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply,Matrix.star_apply,Complex.star_def,
    ← Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self,← Complex.ofReal_sum,Matrix.one_apply_eq,Complex.ofReal_one] using h

lemma outputProbability_complement {N : ℕ} (W : Operator N) (hW : W ∈ unitary (Operator N))
    (out : Fin N) (z : Word N) :
    outputProbability W out 0 z+outputProbability W out 1 z=1 := by
  rw [outputProbability,outputProbability,← Finset.sum_add_distrib,← total_born_probability W hW z]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y _
  generalize y out=b
  fin_cases b <;> simp

lemma success_character_lower {n N : ℕ} (W : Operator N) (hW : W ∈ unitary (Operator N))
    (out : Fin N) (x : Word n) {ε : ℝ} (hsuccess : 1/2+ε ≤ successProbability W out x) :
    ε+bitSign (parity x)/2 ≤
      ((bitSign (parity x):ℂ)*(star W*(outputZeroCount out).zero*W) (inputWord x) (inputWord x)).re := by
  rw [born_zero_diagonal,← Complex.ofReal_mul,Complex.ofReal_re]
  have htotal := outputProbability_complement W hW out (inputWord x)
  change 1/2+ε ≤ outputProbability W out (parity x) (inputWord x) at hsuccess
  generalize hp : parity x=b at hsuccess ⊢
  fin_cases b
  · norm_num [bitSign] at *
    linarith only [hsuccess]
  · norm_num [bitSign] at *
    linarith only [hsuccess,htotal]

/-- The coefficient norm required to pay for expanding powers of a count. -/
def weight (R : ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) : ℝ := p.sum fun k c => |c| * R ^ k

lemma weight_nonneg {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (p : ℝ[X]) : 0 ≤ weight R p := by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg hR _)

@[simp] lemma weight_zero (R : ℝ) : weight R 0 = 0 := by simp [weight]
@[simp] lemma weight_monomial (R c : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    weight R (monomial k c) = |c| * R ^ k := by simp [weight]
@[simp] lemma weight_C (R c : ℝ) : weight R (C c) = |c| := by simp [weight]
@[simp] lemma weight_one (R : ℝ) : weight R 1 = 1 := by
  simpa only [map_one, abs_one] using weight_C R 1
@[simp] lemma weight_X (R : ℝ) : weight R X = R := by simp [weight]

lemma weight_add_le {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (p q : ℝ[X]) :
    weight R (p + q) ≤ weight R p + weight R q := by
  let s := p.support ∪ q.support
  have hf : ∀ i : ℕ, |(0 : ℝ)| * R ^ i = 0 := by simp
  have hp : p.support ⊆ s := Finset.subset_union_left
  have hq : q.support ⊆ s := Finset.subset_union_right
  unfold weight
  rw [sum_eq_of_subset _ hf (support_add.trans (Finset.Subset.refl s)),
    sum_eq_of_subset _ hf hp, sum_eq_of_subset _ hf hq, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
    rw [coeff_add, ← add_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (abs_add_le _ _) (pow_nonneg hR _)

@[simp] lemma weight_neg (R : ℝ) (p : ℝ[X]) : weight R (-p) = weight R p := by
  simp [weight, Polynomial.sum]

lemma weight_sub_le {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (p q : ℝ[X]) :
    weight R (p - q) ≤ weight R p + weight R q := by
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, weight_neg] using weight_add_le hR p (-q)

lemma weight_sum_le {ι : Type*} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℝ[X]) :
    weight R (∑ i ∈ s, p i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, weight R (p i) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    simpa only [Finset.sum_insert hi] using
      (weight_add_le hR (p i) (∑ j ∈ s, p j)).trans (add_le_add_right ih _)

lemma weight_mul_le {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (p q : ℝ[X]) :
    weight R (p * q) ≤ weight R p * weight R q := by
  rw [mul_eq_sum_sum]
  apply (weight_sum_le hR _ _).trans
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ p.support, ∑ j ∈ q.support,
        weight R (monomial (i + j) (p.coeff i * q.coeff j)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => weight_sum_le hR _ _
    _ = weight R p * weight R q := by
      simp_rw [weight_monomial, abs_mul, pow_add]
      unfold weight Polynomial.sum
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

lemma weight_prod_le {ι : Type*} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℝ[X]) :
    weight R (∏ i ∈ s, p i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, weight R (p i) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    simp only [Finset.prod_insert hi]
    exact (weight_mul_le hR _ _).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (weight_nonneg hR _))

lemma weight_chebyshev {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (z : ℝ[X]) (k : ℕ) :
    weight R ((Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ k).comp z) ≤ (2 * weight R z + 1) ^ k := by
  let b := weight R z
  let A := 2 * b + 1
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := weight_nonneg hR z
  have hA : 1 ≤ A := by dsimp [A]; linarith
  change weight R ((Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ k).comp z) ≤ A ^ k
  induction k using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp [Polynomial.Chebyshev.T_zero]
  | one => simpa [Polynomial.Chebyshev.T_one, A, b] using (show b ≤ A by dsimp [A]; linarith)
  | more k hk hk1 =>
    have heq : Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (↑(k + 2)) =
        2 * X * Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (↑(k + 1)) - Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ k := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_one] using Polynomial.Chebyshev.T_add_two ℝ (k : ℤ)
    rw [heq, sub_comp, mul_comp, mul_comp, X_comp]
    have htwo : weight R ((2 : ℝ[X]).comp z) = 2 := by
      rw [show (2 : ℝ[X]) = C 2 by exact (map_ofNat C 2).symm, C_comp, weight_C]
      norm_num
    calc
      _ ≤ weight R (((2 : ℝ[X]).comp z) * z * (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (↑(k + 1))).comp z) +
          weight R ((Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (↑k)).comp z) := weight_sub_le hR _ _
      _ ≤ (2 * b) * A ^ (k + 1) + A ^ k := by
        apply add_le_add _ hk
        apply (weight_mul_le hR _ _).trans
        apply mul_le_mul _ hk1 (weight_nonneg hR _) (by positivity)
        simpa only [htwo] using weight_mul_le hR ((2 : ℝ[X]).comp z) z
      _ ≤ A ^ (k + 2) := by
        rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, pow_succ]
        have h : 2 * b * A + 1 ≤ A * A := by dsimp [A]; nlinarith
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (pow_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one hA) k)]


lemma chebyshev_abs_le_one (k : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1) :
    |(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ k).eval x| ≤ 1 := by
  rw [← Real.cos_arccos hx.1 hx.2, Polynomial.Chebyshev.T_real_cos]
  exact Real.abs_cos_le_one _

/-- An elementary hyperbolic lower bound for the Chebyshev denominator. -/
lemma chebyshev_denominator (k : ℕ) {m r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hm : r < m) :
    1 ≤ (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ k).eval ((m + r) / (m - r)) ∧
    Real.exp ((k : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (r / m)) / 2 ≤
      (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ k).eval ((m + r) / (m - r)) := by
  let q := Real.sqrt (r / m)
  have hm0 : 0 < m := lt_trans hr hm
  have hq0 : 0 < q := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos hr hm0)
  have hq1 : q < 1 := by
    dsimp [q]
    apply (Real.sqrt_lt' (by norm_num)).2
    simpa using (div_lt_one hm0).2 hm
  have hq2 : q ^ 2 = r / m := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (div_pos hr hm0))
  let h := (1 + q) / (1 - q)
  have hh0 : 0 < h := div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hlog : q ≤ Real.log h := by
    dsimp [h]
    rw [Real.log_div (by linarith) (by linarith)]
    have hp := Real.log_nonneg (show 1 ≤ 1 + q by linarith)
    have hn := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show 0 < 1 - q by linarith)
    linarith
  have harg : (m + r) / (m - r) = Real.cosh (Real.log h) := by
    rw [Real.cosh_eq, Real.exp_log hh0, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log hh0]
    dsimp [h]
    have hqm : m * q ^ 2 = r := by nlinarith [((eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hm0)).1 hq2)]
    have hmr : m - r ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hqm1 : 1 - q ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hqp1 : 1 + q ≠ 0 := by linarith
    field_simp [hmr, hqm1, hqp1]
    nlinarith
  rw [harg, Polynomial.Chebyshev.T_real_cosh]
  constructor
  · exact Real.one_le_cosh _
  · have he : Real.exp ((k : ℝ) * q) ≤ Real.exp ((k : ℤ) * Real.log h) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.2
      norm_cast
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (Nat.cast_nonneg k)
    rw [Real.cosh_eq]
    exact (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right he (by norm_num)).trans
      (by have := Real.exp_pos (-((k : ℤ) * Real.log h)); linarith)

/-- Exact roots at the first r positive integers. -/
def rootPoly (r : ℕ) : ℝ[X] :=
  ∏ j ∈ Finset.range r, (1 - C ((j + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹) * X)

@[simp] lemma rootPoly_eval_zero (r : ℕ) : (rootPoly r).eval 0 = 1 := by
  simp [rootPoly, eval_prod]

lemma rootPoly_eval_nat {r x : ℕ} (hx0 : 1 ≤ x) (hxr : x ≤ r) :
    (rootPoly r).eval (x : ℝ) = 0 := by
  have hx : x - 1 ∈ Finset.range r := Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)
  have hx1 : x - 1 + 1 = x := by omega
  simp only [rootPoly, Polynomial.eval_prod, eval_sub, eval_one, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X]
  apply Finset.prod_eq_zero hx
  have hxne : (x : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show x ≠ 0 by omega)
  have he : ((x - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = x := by exact_mod_cast hx1
  rw [he, inv_mul_cancel₀ hxne, sub_self]

lemma rootPoly_weight {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (r : ℕ) :
    weight R (rootPoly r) ≤ (1 + R) ^ r := by
  unfold rootPoly
  apply (weight_prod_le hR _ _).trans
  calc
    _ ≤ ∏ _j ∈ Finset.range r, (1 + R) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod₀
      · intro j hj
        exact weight_nonneg hR _
      · intro j hj
        apply (weight_sub_le hR _ _).trans
        simp only [weight_one]
        apply add_le_add_right
        apply (weight_mul_le hR _ _).trans
        rw [weight_C, weight_X, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_left hR (inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by norm_num))
    _ = (1 + R) ^ r := by simp

lemma rootPoly_abs_eval {m x : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hxm : x ≤ m) (r : ℕ) :
    |(rootPoly r).eval x| ≤ m ^ r := by
  simp only [rootPoly, eval_prod, eval_sub, eval_one, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X,
    Finset.abs_prod]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∏ _j ∈ Finset.range r, m := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
      intro j hj
      have hj1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) + 1 := by norm_num
      have hj0 : 0 < (j : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
      have hv0 : 0 ≤ ((j : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ * x := by positivity
      have hv : ((j : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ * x ≤ m :=
        (mul_le_of_le_one_left hx0 (inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hj1)).trans hxm
      exact abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    _ = m ^ r := by simp


lemma rootPoly_degree (r : ℕ) : (rootPoly r).natDegree ≤ r := by
  apply (natDegree_prod_le _ _).trans
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ Finset.range r, 1 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      apply (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans
      apply max_le (by simp)
      exact (natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans (by simp)
    _ = r := by simp

/-- The affine map taking [r,m] onto [1,-1]. -/
def scalePoly (r m : ℝ) : ℝ[X] := C ((m + r) / (m - r)) - C (2 / (m - r)) * X

lemma scalePoly_eval (r m x : ℝ) :
    (scalePoly r m).eval x = (m + r - 2 * x) / (m - r) := by
  simp only [scalePoly, eval_sub, eval_C, eval_mul, eval_X]

  rw [scalePoly_eval]
  constructor
  · apply (le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.2 hrm)).2
    linarith
  · apply (div_le_one (sub_pos.2 hrm)).2
    linarith

lemma scalePoly_degree (r m : ℝ) : (scalePoly r m).natDegree ≤ 1 := by
  apply (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans
  simp only [natDegree_C, Nat.zero_max]

  have hconst : (m + r) / (m - r) ≤ 3 := by

    linarith
  have hlin0 : 0 ≤ 2 / (m - r) := by positivity
  have hlin : 2 / (m - r) ≤ 2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hmr0).2
    linarith
  apply (weight_sub_le hR _ _).trans
  apply (add_le_add_right (weight_mul_le hR _ _) _).trans
  simp only [weight_C, weight_X, abs_of_nonneg hconst0, abs_of_nonneg hlin0]
  exact add_le_add hconst (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlin hR)

/-- The real scalar spelling makes the coefficient budget transparent. -/
def reflect {N : ℕ} (D : Count N) : Operator N := 1 - (2:ℝ) • D.zero

def reflectList {N : ℕ} (l : List (Count N)) : Operator N := (l.map reflect).prod

lemma reflectionMatrix_eq {N : ℕ} (R : ReflectionLayer N) : reflectionMatrix R = reflectList R.gates := by
  unfold reflectionMatrix reflectList
  congr 1

lemma reflect_unitary {N : ℕ} (D : Count N) : reflect D ∈ unitary (Operator N) := by
  simpa only [reflect,two_smul] using reflection_unitary D

lemma reflect_disjoint_commute {N : ℕ} (A B : Count N) (h : Disjoint A.support B.support) :
    Commute (reflect A) (reflect B) := by
  exact (Commute.one_left _).sub_left
    (((Commute.one_right _).sub_right ((A.disjoint_commute B h).smul_right (2:ℝ))).smul_left (2:ℝ))

lemma reflect_disjoint_zero_commute {N : ℕ} (A B : Count N) (h : Disjoint A.support B.support) :
    Commute (reflect A) B.zero :=
  (Commute.one_left _).sub_left ((A.disjoint_commute B h).smul_left (2:ℝ))

def ReflectionLayer.active {N : ℕ} (R : ReflectionLayer N) (A : Count N) : ReflectionLayer N where
  gates := R.gates.filter (fun D => decide (¬Disjoint D.support A.support))
  disjoint := R.disjoint.filter _

lemma ReflectionLayer.active_length {N : ℕ} (R : ReflectionLayer N) (A : Count N) :
    (R.active A).gates.length ≤ A.support.card := by
  apply list_disjoint_hits_length Count.support _ (R.active A).disjoint
  intro D hD
  have h := (List.mem_filter.mp hD).2
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  exact Finset.not_disjoint_iff_nonempty_inter.mp h

lemma ReflectionLayer.active_conjugate {N : ℕ} (R : ReflectionLayer N) (A : Count N) :
    conjugate (reflectionMatrix R) A.zero = conjugate (reflectionMatrix (R.active A)) A.zero := by
  rw [reflectionMatrix_eq,reflectionMatrix_eq]
  apply list_conjugate_filter
  · exact R.disjoint.imp (fun h => reflect_disjoint_commute _ _ h)
  · intro D _; exact reflect_unitary D
  · intro D _ hD
    apply reflect_disjoint_zero_commute
    simpa using hD


/-- Expansion of a disjoint reflection product.  The real coefficients carry
all multiplicities; no commutation of the middle projection is required. -/
def reflectionTerms {N : ℕ} : List (Count N) → List (ℝ × Count N)
  | [] => [(1,Count.empty)]
  | A::l => reflectionTerms l ++ (reflectionTerms l).map (fun p => (-2*p.1,A.join p.2))

lemma reflectionTerms_support {N : ℕ} (l : List (Count N)) :
    ∀ p ∈ reflectionTerms l, ∀ i ∈ p.2.support, ∃ A ∈ l, i ∈ A.support := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [reflectionTerms,Count.empty]
  | cons A l ih =>
    intro p hp i hi
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hp with hp | hp
    · obtain ⟨B,hB,hiB⟩ := ih p hp i hi
      exact ⟨B,List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hB,hiB⟩
    · obtain ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hp
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hi with hi | hi
      · exact ⟨A,List.mem_cons_self ..,hi⟩
      · obtain ⟨B,hB,hiB⟩ := ih q hq i hi
        exact ⟨B,List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hB,hiB⟩

lemma reflectionTerms_disjoint {N : ℕ} (A : Count N) (l : List (Count N))
    (h : ∀ B ∈ l, Disjoint A.support B.support) (p : ℝ × Count N) (hp : p ∈ reflectionTerms l) :
    Disjoint A.support p.2.support := by
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro i hiA hip
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hiB⟩ := reflectionTerms_support l p hp i hip
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (h B hB) hiA hiB

lemma reflectionTerms_sum {N : ℕ} (l : List (Count N))
    (hl : l.Pairwise (fun A B => Disjoint A.support B.support)) :
    ((reflectionTerms l).map (fun p => p.1 • p.2.zero)).sum = reflectList l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [reflectionTerms,reflectList]
  | cons A l ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hl⟩ := List.pairwise_cons.mp hl
    rw [reflectionTerms,List.map_append,List.sum_append,List.map_map]
    have heq : ((reflectionTerms l).map (fun p => (-2*p.1) • (A.join p.2).zero)) =
        (reflectionTerms l).map (fun p => ((-2:ℝ) • A.zero) * (p.1 • p.2.zero)) := by
      apply List.map_congr_left
      intro p hp
      rw [A.join_zero p.2 (reflectionTerms_disjoint A l ha p hp),smul_mul_smul_comm]
    change ((reflectionTerms l).map (fun p => p.1 • p.2.zero)).sum +
      ((reflectionTerms l).map (fun p => (-2*p.1) • (A.join p.2).zero)).sum = _
    rw [heq,List.sum_map_mul_left,ih hl]
    simp only [reflectList,List.map_cons,List.prod_cons,reflect,sub_mul,one_mul,neg_smul,neg_mul]
    abel

lemma reflectionTerms_weight {N : ℕ} (l : List (Count N)) :
    ((reflectionTerms l).map (fun p => |p.1|)).sum = (3:ℝ)^l.length := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [reflectionTerms]
  | cons A l ih =>
    simp only [reflectionTerms,List.map_append,List.sum_append,List.map_map,List.length_cons,pow_succ]
    change ((reflectionTerms l).map (fun p => |p.1|)).sum +
      ((reflectionTerms l).map (fun p => |(-2:ℝ)*p.1|)).sum = _
    simp_rw [abs_mul]
    norm_num only [abs_neg]
    rw [List.sum_map_mul_left,ih]
    ring

lemma star_list_sum {A ι : Type*} [AddMonoid A] [StarAddMonoid A] (l : List ι) (f : ι → A) :
    star (l.map f).sum = (l.map (fun i => star (f i))).sum := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons i l ih => simp [ih]

lemma reflectList_selfAdjoint {N : ℕ} (l : List (Count N))
    (hl : l.Pairwise (fun A B => Disjoint A.support B.support)) :
    star (reflectList l) = reflectList l := by
  rw [← reflectionTerms_sum l hl,star_list_sum]
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro p _
  simp only [star_smul,star_trivial,p.2.zero_projection.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq]


section BilinearBudget
variable {A : Type*} [CStarAlgebra A]

lemma list_sum_sandwich {ι : Type*} (l : List ι) (c : ι → ℝ) (f : ι → A) (L R : A) :
    L * (l.map (fun i => c i • f i)).sum * R =
      (l.map (fun i => c i • (L*f i*R))).sum := by
  simp only [← List.sum_map_mul_left,← List.sum_map_mul_right,mul_smul_comm,smul_mul_assoc]

lemma bilinear_list_bound {ι : Type*} (l : List ι) (c : ι → ℝ) (f : ι → A)
    (H B P : A) (δ : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ l, ∀ j ∈ l, ‖H*f i*B*f j*P‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖H * (l.map (fun i => c i • f i)).sum * B *
      (l.map (fun i => c i • f i)).sum * P‖ ≤ (l.map (fun i => |c i|)).sum^2 * δ := by
  let T := (l.map (fun i => c i • f i)).sum
  let C := (l.map (fun i => |c i|)).sum
  have hj : ∀ i ∈ l, ‖H*f i*B*T*P‖ ≤ C*δ := by
    intro i hi
    rw [show H*f i*B*T*P = (H*f i*B)*T*P by rfl, list_sum_sandwich]
    exact norm_list_smul_sum l c _ δ (h i hi)
  have heq : H*T*B*T*P = (l.map (fun i => c i • (H*f i*B*T*P))).sum := by
    calc
      _ = H*T*(B*T*P) := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [list_sum_sandwich]; simp only [mul_assoc]
  change ‖H*T*B*T*P‖ ≤ C^2*δ
  rw [heq]
  exact (norm_list_smul_sum l c _ (C*δ) hj).trans_eq (by ring)
end BilinearBudget

lemma reflection_conjugate_expansion {N : ℕ} (l : List (Count N))
    (hl : l.Pairwise (fun A B => Disjoint A.support B.support)) (V : Operator N) :
    conjugate V (reflectList l) =
      ((reflectionTerms l).map (fun p => p.1 • conjugate V p.2.zero)).sum := by
  rw [← reflectionTerms_sum l hl,conjugate_list_sum]
  simp only [conjugate_smul]

lemma reflection_transition_bound {N : ℕ} (R : ReflectionLayer N) (V H P : Operator N)
    (A : Count N) (hV : V ∈ unitary (Operator N)) (δ : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ X Y : Count N, ‖H*conjugate V X.zero*conjugate V A.zero*conjugate V Y.zero*P‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖H*conjugate V (conjugate (reflectionMatrix R) A.zero)*P‖ ≤ (9:ℝ)^R.gates.length*δ := by
  rw [reflectionMatrix_eq]
  unfold conjugate at *
  have heq : H*(V*(reflectList R.gates*A.zero*star (reflectList R.gates))*star V)*P =
      H*conjugate V (reflectList R.gates)*conjugate V A.zero*conjugate V (reflectList R.gates)*P := by
    change H*conjugate V (reflectList R.gates*A.zero*star (reflectList R.gates))*P = _
    rw [reflectList_selfAdjoint _ R.disjoint,conjugate_mul hV,conjugate_mul hV]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
  rw [heq,reflection_conjugate_expansion _ R.disjoint V]
  apply (bilinear_list_bound (reflectionTerms R.gates) Prod.fst
    (fun p => conjugate V p.2.zero) H (conjugate V A.zero) P δ (fun i _ j _ => h i.2 j.2)).trans_eq
  rw [reflectionTerms_weight]
  congr 1
  rw [pow_two,← mul_pow]
  norm_num

theorem positive_parallel_of_complex_inner {G q : ℂ} (hG : G ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (horth : inner ℝ G (Complex.I*q) = 0) (hpos : 0 ≤ inner ℝ G q) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ q = t • G := by
  have him : (conj G*q).im = 0 := by
    rw [real_inner_eq_re_inner ℂ,RCLike.inner_apply] at horth
    change ((Complex.I*q)*conj G).re = 0 at horth
    simp only [Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,Complex.conj_re,Complex.conj_im] at horth ⊢
    nlinarith
  have hre : (conj G*q).re = inner ℝ G q := by
    simp [real_inner_eq_re_inner ℂ,RCLike.inner_apply,mul_comm]
  have hnon : inner ℝ G q ≠ 0 := by
    intro hh
    have he : conj G*q = 0 := Complex.ext (by simpa [hre] using hh) (by simpa using him)
    exact mul_ne_zero ((map_ne_zero (starRingEnd ℂ)).mpr hG) hq he
  have hp : 0 < inner ℝ G q := lt_of_le_of_ne hpos (Ne.symm hnon)
  let t := inner ℝ G q/‖G‖^2
  refine ⟨t,div_pos hp (sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hG)),?_⟩
  have hprod : conj G*q = (inner ℝ G q:ℂ) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hre,him]
  have hGG : conj G*G = ((‖G‖^2:ℝ):ℂ) := by
    rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self,Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ ((map_ne_zero (starRingEnd ℂ)).mpr hG : conj G ≠ 0)
  rw [hprod,Complex.real_smul,mul_left_comm,hGG]
  dsimp only [t]
  rw [Complex.ofReal_div,Complex.ofReal_pow,div_mul_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero _ (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hG)))]

abbrev MatrixPolynomial (m : ℕ) := Polynomial (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)

def matrixPolynomialValue {m : ℕ} (z : ℂ) :
    MatrixPolynomial m →+* Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ :=
  Polynomial.eval₂RingHom' (RingHom.id _) (z • 1) (by
    intro C
    change C * (z • 1) = (z • 1) * C
    simp [])

@[simp] theorem matrixPolynomialValue_C {m : ℕ} (z : ℂ)
    (C : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) : matrixPolynomialValue z (Polynomial.C C) = C := by
  exact Polynomial.eval₂_C _ _

@[simp] theorem matrixPolynomialValue_X {m : ℕ} (z : ℂ) :
    matrixPolynomialValue (m := m) z Polynomial.X = z • 1 := by
  exact Polynomial.eval₂_X _ _

theorem continuous_matrixPolynomialValue {m : ℕ} (G : MatrixPolynomial m) :
    Continuous (fun z => matrixPolynomialValue z G) :=
  (G.continuous_eval₂ (RingHom.id _)).comp (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)

def scalarMatrixPolynomial {m : ℕ} (p : Polynomial ℂ) : MatrixPolynomial m :=
  p.map (algebraMap ℂ (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ))

theorem matrixPolynomialValue_scalar {m : ℕ} (p : Polynomial ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    matrixPolynomialValue (m := m) z (scalarMatrixPolynomial p) = p.eval z • 1 := by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq =>
    simp only [scalarMatrixPolynomial,Polynomial.map_add,map_add] at *
    rw [hp,hq,Polynomial.eval_add,add_smul]
  | monomial k c =>
    simp only [scalarMatrixPolynomial,← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial,

  have hb0 : 0 ≤ ∫ t, hsSq (M t) ∂circleMeasure := integral_nonneg (fun _ => hsSq_nonneg _)
  exact (norm_sum_entryPair_sq_le _ C).trans
    ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => hsSq_nonneg _))).trans
